Referenzcode: JR125044 Wer sind wir? Eine Haute-Joaillerie-Haus mit einer starken Tradition, das außergewöhnliches Know-how in einer bezaubernden und kreativen Umgebung fördert. Unser Haus sucht talentierte Persönlichkeiten, die dazu beitragen, ihre Fachkenntnisse mit Sorgfalt und ohne Kompromisse weiterzuentwickeln und zu vermitteln. Bei Van Cleef & Arpels sind Sie von leidenschaftlichen Experten umgeben und tragen zu vielen neuen Projekten bei, die es unserem Haus ermöglichen, sich regelmäßig neu zu erfinden. Bei Van Cleef & Arpels sind wir stolz darauf, Talente aus unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen und Erfahrungen einzustellen. Wir glauben, dass durch die volle Akzeptanz und Förderung von Vielfalt und Inklusion Kreativität und Wissen entstehen, um Exzellenz zu liefern. Entspricht
• Ihr Profil? Sie verfügen über Erfahrung im Bau von Uhrwerken. Ihr methodischer Geist, Ihre Neugier und Kreativität ermöglichen es Ihnen, innovative Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen, die mit der Identität des Hauses in Einklang stehen. Sie beherrschen Mikromechanik (oder ein gleichwertiges Fachgebiet in Präzisionsmechanik oder Uhrentechnologie) sowie eine CAD-Software. Was erwarten wir von Ihnen? Unter der Leitung des Leiters Forschung & Entwicklung Uhrmacherei entwickelt der Uhrwerkbauer (H/F) Uhrwerke oder Mechanismen sowie die zugehörigen technischen Unterlagen für die Uhrmacherei und die Kunstmechanik des Hauses. Die Entwicklungen werden in Zusammenarbeit mit allen relevanten Akteuren der Uhrmacherwerkstätten (Meyrin & Ste Croix), der Abteilung Extraordinary Objects in Paris und externen Partnern durchgeführt. Zu Ihren
• Aufgaben gehören: - Entwerfen und Entwickeln von Uhrwerken, vom Konzept bis zur Produktion. - Durchführen von Machbarkeitsstudien und technischen Analysen. - Erstellen detaillierter Konstruktionspläne und Stücklisten. - Durchführung von Simulationen und Tests zur Validierung der Leistung und Zuverlässigkeit der Uhrwerke. - Zusammenarbeit mit dem Designstudio, der Gehäuseabteilung (Gehäuse) und anderen Konstrukteuren (Gehäuse, Zifferblatt und Uhrwerk), um die Umsetzung neuer Uhrwerke sicherzustellen. - Überwachung technologischer und materialbezogener Entwicklungen im Bereich der Uhrmacherei. - Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Konstruktionsprozesse. Mehr als nur eine Position… wir rekrutieren für eine Karriere! Der Beitritt zu Van Cleef & Arpels bedeutet vor allem, Teil eines Teams zu werden, in dem die Entwicklung der Mitarbeitenden im Mittelpunkt unserer Ambitionen steht. Schon bei Ihrer Einarbeitung tauchen Sie in die Welt des Hauses ein, durch Schulungen zu unserer Geschichte, unserem Know-how und unserer Kultur. Der Einstellungsprozess: Bewerben Sie sich direkt online. Wenn
• Ihr Profil ausgewählt wird, werden Sie vom HR-Team zu einem Gespräch kontaktiert. Sie treffen den Leiter Forschung & Entwicklung Uhrmacherei, gefolgt vom Personalmanager. jobs.title: Logistics Manufacturing Tech Team Lead
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR124697 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. “Join a dynamic Technology and Business environment to help our Manufactures transition into Industry 4.0 tools and practices” CONTEXT Our Manufactures have embarked into a journey with Industry 4.0 to accelerate digitalization and support more connected operational use cases bringing more efficiency and quality, based on latest technologies for Industrial IoT, Automation, No/Low Coding platforms and Analytics. The scope of our manufacturing operations covers 30+ sites in Europe on which 20+ in Switzerland and various business activities mainly based on watchmaking & jewellery, from traditional to more industrialized practices. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The role is embedded in Richemont’s Group Technology Product Domain “Operations & Services” and part of the Manufacturing Product Area. As a Logistic Manufacturing Tech Team Lead, you and your team will be responsible for the analysis, design, deployment and support of the different components of our Logistic Manufacturing Applications Architecture. You will be accountable for the improvements and delivery of the applications according to the roadmap of our “Product Owner” and guidelines of our Architects. Our scope of Logistic Manufacturing includes all business processes of the value chain related to Logistic such as Inbound/Outbound process, inventory management, production integration. This scope is covered by SAP EWM used as a back-End Warehouse Management System, which is exposed to various Logistic Execution Front-End. This decoupling strategy is supported within a modern landscape based on APIs and Event Driven Architecture. Key 
• Responsibilities: Define a technical Vision and maintain the roadmap in alignment with product strategy and enterprise architecture. In charge of managing a Technology Team of experienced Consultants in designing, deploying and supporting our solutions for our Manufactures, according to our Agile practices Lead, Develop and motivate your Team to propose the best solutions and continuously learn new skills and technologies Ensure compliance with architecture and security guardrails. Prepare Budget and plan your team capacity to support all the initiatives requested by our Maisons Liaise and be the key contact to integrate with other teams on all integration topics HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? Master degree / Engineer 7+ years of experience, ideally with a consulting background, in contact with industrial environments in Logistic as well in IT Strong Experience in full Projects lifecycle deploying Manufacturing ERP & WMS from Design to Run Collaborative leadership and coaching mindset. Experience in designing business solutions based on SAP ERP & EWM, with MES related experiences, ideally also with Low Code / No Code platforms Good understanding of architecture design principles and integration technologies such as APIs Good understanding of software development & customizing lifecycle in Agile and Scrum models Experience in Team Management overseeing the Design, Deployment and Support activities, including budget follow up and planning activities Excellent ability and experience to effectively communicate technical information to management, peers and industry partners. Fluent in French and English HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? The role is a perfect mix between designing, building and maintaining new solutions while developing and leading an experienced agile team at the service of all our Maisons’ Manufactures The variety and density of initiatives with our Maisons provides a great portfolio of opportunities to always learn and develop new skills At Richemont we can and do discuss with all levels of technology and business, and your value-added and advice is highly appreciated by the business stakeholders. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call. 2. The next step from there would be a first Technical interview with the Manufacturing Product Area Manager and if there is a match, you will have a personal meeting with him/her and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Production & Maintenance Quality Assurance Engineer Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont New Foundations - S4HANA Transformation Technical Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Supply Chain Business Analyst Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR124697 Richemont possiede alcune delle più importanti Maison di beni di lusso al mondo, con punti di forza particolari in gioielleria, orologi di alta gamma e accessori di lusso. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianato e Richemont si impegna a preservare il patrimonio e l’identità di ciascuna di esse. Allo stesso tempo, siamo impegnati nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che siano in linea con i valori delle nostre Maisons, attraverso un processo di creatività continua. "Unisciti a un ambiente dinamico di Tecnologia e Business per aiutare le nostre Manifatture a passare a strumenti e pratiche Industry 4.0" CONTEXT Le nostre Manifatture hanno intrapreso un percorso con Industry 4.0 per accelerare la digitalizzazione e supportare casi d’uso operativi più connessi, portando maggiore efficienza e qualità, basandosi sulle ultime tecnologie per Industrial IoT, Automazione, piattaforme No/Low Coding e Analytics. L’ambito delle nostre operazioni di produzione copre oltre 30 siti in Europa, di cui più di 20 in Svizzera, con attività principalmente legate all’orologeria e alla gioielleria, dal metodo tradizionale a pratiche più industrializzate. COME AVRAI IMPATTO? Il ruolo è inserito nel Dominio di Prodotto Tecnologico del Gruppo Richemont "Operations & Services" e fa parte dell’Area di Prodotto Manufacturing. Come Responsabile Tecnico del Team Manufacturing Logistico, tu e il tuo team sarete responsabili dell’analisi, progettazione, implementazione e supporto dei diversi componenti dell’Architettura delle Applicazioni di Manufacturing Logistico. Sarai responsabile dei miglioramenti e della consegna delle applicazioni secondo la roadmap del nostro “Product Owner” e le linee guida dei nostri Architetti. Il nostro ambito di Manufacturing Logistico include tutti i processi aziendali della catena del valore legati alla Logistica, come i processi Inbound/Outbound, gestione dell’inventario, integrazione della produzione. Questo ambito è coperto da SAP EWM, utilizzato come sistema di gestione magazzino back-end, esposto a vari front-end di esecuzione logistica. Questa strategia di decoupling è supportata in un panorama moderno basato su API e Architettura Event-Driven. Responsabilità Chiave: - Definire una Visione Tecnica e mantenere la roadmap in allineamento con la strategia di prodotto e l’architettura aziendale. - Gestire un Team Tecnologico di consulenti esperti nella progettazione, implementazione e supporto delle nostre soluzioni per le nostre Manifatture, secondo le pratiche Agile. - Guidare, sviluppare e motivare il team per proporre le migliori soluzioni e apprendere continuamente nuove competenze e tecnologie. - Garantire la conformità con i principi di architettura e sicurezza. - Preparare il Budget e pianificare la capacità del team per supportare tutte le iniziative richieste dalle nostre Maisons. - Collaborare e essere il punto di contatto principale per integrare con altri team su tutte le tematiche di integrazione. Reference code: JR124697 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. “Join a dynamic Technology and Business environment to help our Manufactures transition into Industry 4.0 tools and practices” CONTEXT Our Manufactures have embarked into a journey with Industry 4.0 to accelerate digitalization and support more connected operational use cases bringing more efficiency and quality, based on latest technologies for Industrial IoT, Automation, No/Low Coding platforms and Analytics. The scope of our manufacturing operations covers 30+ sites in Europe on which 20+ in Switzerland and various business activities mainly based on watchmaking & jewellery, from traditional to more industrialized practices. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The role is embedded in Richemont’s Group Technology Product Domain “Operations & Services” and part of the Manufacturing Product Area. As a Logistic Manufacturing Tech Team Lead, you and your team will be responsible for the analysis, design, deployment and support of the different components of our Logistic Manufacturing Applications Architecture. You will be accountable for the improvements and delivery of the applications according to the roadmap of our “Product Owner” and guidelines of our Architects. Our scope of Logistic Manufacturing includes all business processes of the value chain related to Logistic such as Inbound/Outbound process, inventory management, production integration. This scope is covered by SAP EWM used as a back-End Warehouse Management System, which is exposed to various Logistic Execution Front-End. This decoupling strategy is supported within a modern landscape based on APIs and Event Driven Architecture. Key 
• Responsibilities: Define a technical Vision and maintain the roadmap in alignment with product strategy and enterprise architecture. In charge of managing a Technology Team of experienced Consultants in designing, deploying and supporting our solutions for our Manufactures, according to our Agile practices Lead, Develop and motivate your Team to propose the best solutions and continuously learn new skills and technologies Ensure compliance with architecture and security guardrails. Prepare Budget and plan your team capacity to support all the initiatives requested by our Maisons Liaise and be the key contact to integrate with other teams on all integration topics HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? Master degree / Engineer 7+ years of experience, ideally with a consulting background, in contact with industrial environments in Logistic as well in IT Strong Experience in full Projects lifecycle deploying Manufacturing ERP & WMS from Design to Run Collaborative leadership and coaching mindset. Experience in designing business solutions based on SAP ERP & EWM, with MES related experiences, ideally also with Low Code / No Code platforms Good understanding of architecture design principles and integration technologies such as APIs Good understanding of software development & customizing lifecycle in Agile and Scrum models Experience in Team Management overseeing the Design, Deployment and Support activities, including budget follow up and planning activities Excellent ability and experience to effectively communicate technical information to management, peers and industry partners. Fluent in French and English HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? The role is a perfect mix between designing, building and maintaining new solutions while developing and leading an experienced agile team at the service of all our Maisons’ Manufactures The variety and density of initiatives with our Maisons provides a great portfolio of opportunities to always learn and develop new skills At Richemont we can and do discuss with all levels of technology and business, and your value-added and advice is highly appreciated by the business stakeholders. descriptionByLocale.de: Referenzcode: JR124697 Richemont besitzt einige der weltweit führenden Luxusgüterhäuser, mit besonderen Stärken in Schmuck, hochwertigen Uhren und Premium-Accessoires. Jedes Haus repräsentiert eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerkskunst, und Richemont bemüht sich, das Erbe und die Identität jedes Hauses zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig setzen wir auf Innovation und die Entwicklung neuer Produkte, die mit den Werten unserer Maisons im Einklang stehen, durch einen kontinuierlichen Kreativitätsprozess. „Treten Sie in ein dynamisches Technologie- und Geschäftsumfeld ein, um unsere Manufakturen bei der Umstellung auf Industry 4.0-Tools und -Praktiken zu unterstützen“ KONTEXT Unsere Manufakturen haben sich auf eine Reise mit Industry 4.0 begeben, um die Digitalisierung zu beschleunigen und mehr vernetzte operative Anwendungsfälle zu unterstützen, die Effizienz und Qualität steigern, basierend auf den neuesten Technologien für Industrial IoT, Automatisierung, No/Low-Code-Plattformen und Analytics. Der Umfang unserer Fertigungsbetriebe umfasst über 30 Standorte in Europa, davon mehr als 20 in der Schweiz, mit Aktivitäten hauptsächlich im Bereich Uhren- und Schmuckherstellung, vom traditionellen bis zum stärker industrialisierten Ansatz. WIE WIRST DU EINEN IMPACT HABEN? Die Rolle ist im Group Technology Product Domain „Operations & Services“ eingebettet und Teil des Manufacturing Product Area. Als Logistic Manufacturing Tech Team Lead bist du und dein Team verantwortlich für Analyse, Design, Deployment und Support der verschiedenen Komponenten unserer Logistik-Produktarchitektur. Du bist verantwortlich für Verbesserungen und die Lieferung der Anwendungen gemäß der Roadmap unseres „Product Owner“ und den Richtlinien unserer Architekten. Unser Logistik-Produktionsbereich umfasst alle Geschäftsprozesse der Wertschöpfungskette im Zusammenhang mit Logistik, wie Inbound/Outbound-Prozesse, Bestandsverwaltung und Produktionsintegration. Dieser Bereich wird durch SAP EWM als Backend-Lagerverwaltungssystem abgedeckt, das an verschiedene Front-End-Systeme für die Logistik ausgegeben wird. Diese Decoupling-Strategie wird in einer modernen Landschaft mit APIs und Event-Driven-Architektur unterstützt. Wichtige Verantwortlichkeiten: - Entwicklung einer technischen Vision und Pflege der Roadmap in Abstimmung mit der Produktstrategie und der Unternehmensarchitektur. - Leitung eines erfahrenen Technologie-Teams bei der Gestaltung, Implementierung und Unterstützung unserer Lösungen für die Manufakturen, nach agilen Prinzipien. - Führung, Entwicklung und Motivation des Teams, um die besten Lösungen vorzuschlagen und kontinuierlich neue Fähigkeiten und Technologien zu erlernen. - Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Architektur- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien. - Budgetplanung und Kapazitätsplanung des Teams zur Unterstützung aller Initiativen unserer Maisons. - Zusammenarbeit und zentrale Kontaktstelle für die Integration mit anderen Teams bei allen Integrationsfragen. WIE WIRST DU ERFOLG HABEN? - Master-Abschluss / Ingenieur - Mehr als 7 Jahre Erfahrung, idealerweise mit Beratungshintergrund, in industriellen Umgebungen im Bereich Logistik und IT - Umfangreiche Erfahrung im gesamten Projektlebenszyklus bei der Implementierung von Manufacturing ERP & WMS, von Design bis Betrieb - Kollaborative Führungs- und Coaching-Mentalität - Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von Geschäftslösungen auf SAP ERP & EWM, mit MES-Erfahrungen, idealerweise auch mit Low Code / No Code Plattformen - Gutes Verständnis von Architekturdesignprinzipien und Integrationstechnologien wie APIs - Kenntnisse im Softwareentwicklungs- und Customizing-Lifecycle in Agile- und Scrum-Modellen - Erfahrung in der Teamleitung, inklusive Budgetüberwachung und Planung - Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten, technische Informationen effektiv an Management, Kollegen und Branchenpartner zu kommunizieren - Fließend in Französisch und Englisch WIE WERDEN WIR DICH GLÜCKLICH MACHEN? - Die Rolle ist eine perfekte Mischung aus Design, Aufbau und Wartung neuer Lösungen, während du ein erfahrenes agiles Team leitest, das allen unseren Maisons dient. - Die Vielfalt und Dichte der Initiativen mit unseren Maisons bieten ein großes Portfolio an Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. - Bei Richemont können wir auf allen Ebenen mit Technologie und Business sprechen, und dein Mehrwert sowie deine Ratschläge werden von den Stakeholdern sehr geschätzt. DEIN WEG MIT UNS: 1. Wenn deine Bewerbung ausgewählt wird, werden wir uns so schnell wie möglich mit dir für ein informelles Einführungsgespräch in Verbindung setzen. 2. Der nächste Schritt ist ein erstes technisches Interview mit dem Manufacturing Product Area Manager. Bei gegenseitigem Interesse folgt ein persönliches Treffen mit ihm/ihr und unserem HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Ähnliche Jobs: Manufacturing Controlling Tech Team Lead Speichern Meyrin, Schweiz Richemont Digital Manufacturing Tech Team Lead Speichern Meyrin, Schweiz Richemont Definition & Integration der Manufacturing-Prozesse Tech Team Lead Speichern Meyrin, Schweiz Richemont
descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence : JR124697 Richemont possède certaines des Maisons de luxe les plus prestigieuses au monde, avec des forces particulières dans la joaillerie, les montres de luxe et les accessoires haut de gamme. Chaque Maison représente une tradition fière de style, de qualité et d’artisanat, et Richemont s’engage à préserver le patrimoine et l’identité de chacune d’elles. En même temps, nous sommes engagés dans l’innovation et la conception de nouveaux produits en accord avec les valeurs de nos Maisons, à travers un processus de créativité continue. « Rejoignez un environnement dynamique de Technologie et de Business pour aider nos Manufactures à passer aux outils et pratiques Industry 4.0 » CONTEXTE Nos Manufactures ont entamé un parcours avec Industry 4.0 pour accélérer la digitalisation et soutenir des cas d’usage opérationnels plus connectés, apportant plus d’efficacité et de qualité, en s’appuyant sur les dernières technologies pour l’IoT industriel, l’automatisation, les plateformes No/Low Code et l’Analytics. Le périmètre de nos opérations de fabrication couvre plus de 30 sites en Europe, dont plus de 20 en Suisse, avec des activités principalement liées à l’horlogerie et à la joaillerie, du traditionnel à des pratiques plus industrialisées. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Le rôle s’inscrit dans le domaine de produit technologique du Groupe Richemont « Operations & Services » et fait partie de la zone de produit Manufacturing. En tant que Responsable Technique de l’Équipe Manufacturing Logistique, vous et votre équipe serez responsables de l’analyse, de la conception, du déploiement et du support des différents composants de notre architecture applicative logistique. Vous serez responsable des améliorations et de la livraison des applications selon la feuille de route de notre « Product Owner » et les lignes directrices de nos Architectes. Notre périmètre de Manufacturing Logistique inclut tous les processus métier de la chaîne de valeur liés à la logistique, tels que les processus inbound/outbound, la gestion des stocks et l’intégration de la production. Ce périmètre est couvert par SAP EWM, utilisé comme système de gestion d’entrepôt back-end, exposé à divers front-ends d’exécution logistique. Cette stratégie de découplage est soutenue dans un paysage moderne basé sur des API et une architecture événementielle. Responsabilités clés : - Définir une vision technique et maintenir la feuille de route en alignement avec la stratégie produit et l’architecture d’entreprise. - Gérer une équipe technologique expérimentée dans la conception, le déploiement et le support de nos solutions pour nos Manufactures, selon les pratiques Agile. - Diriger, développer et motiver votre équipe pour proposer les meilleures solutions et apprendre continuellement de nouvelles compétences et technologies. - Assurer la conformité avec les règles d’architecture et de sécurité. - Préparer le budget et planifier la capacité de votre équipe pour soutenir toutes les initiatives demandées par nos Maisons. - Collaborer et être le point de contact principal pour l’intégration avec d’autres équipes sur toutes les questions d’intégration. COMMENT MESURER LE SUCCÈS AVEC NOUS ? - Diplôme de Master / Ingénieur - Plus de 7 ans d’expérience, idéalement avec une expérience en conseil, dans des environnements industriels en Logistique et IT - Solide expérience dans le cycle complet de projets déployant ERP de fabrication et WMS, de la conception à l’exploitation - Esprit de leadership collaboratif et de coaching - Expérience dans la conception de solutions métier basées sur SAP ERP & EWM, avec des expériences MES, idéalement aussi avec des plateformes Low Code / No Code - Bonne compréhension des principes de conception d’architecture et des technologies d’intégration telles que les API - Bonne connaissance du cycle de vie du développement logiciel et de la personnalisation en modèles Agile et Scrum - Expérience en gestion d’équipe, incluant le suivi du budget et la planification - Excellentes capacités à communiquer efficacement des informations techniques à la direction, aux collègues et aux partenaires industriels - Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais COMMENT NOUS VOUS FERONS RÊVER ? - Le rôle est un parfait mélange entre la conception, la construction et la maintenance de nouvelles solutions, tout en développant et en dirigeant une équipe agile expérimentée au service de toutes nos Maisons. - La variété et la densité des initiatives avec nos Maisons offrent un large portefeuille d’opportunités pour apprendre et développer de nouvelles compétences. - Chez Richemont, nous pouvons et discutons avec tous les niveaux de technologie et de business, et votre valeur ajoutée ainsi que vos conseils sont très appréciés par les parties prenantes. VOTRE PARCOURS AVEC NOUS : 1. Si votre candidature est retenue, nous vous contacterons dès que possible pour un appel de présentation informel. 2. La prochaine étape sera un premier entretien technique avec le responsable de la zone de produit Manufacturing, et si cela correspond, vous rencontrerez personnellement lui/elle et notre partenaire RH. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Jobs similaires : Manufacturing Controlling Tech Team Lead Sauvegarder Meyrin, Suisse Richemont Digital Manufacturing Tech Team Lead Sauvegarder Meyrin, Suisse Richemont Définition et Intégration des Processus de Manufacturing Tech Team Lead Sauvegarder Meyrin, Suisse Richemont

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR126311 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. Grâce à votre expertise, vous garantirez la maîtrise et l’optimisation des procédés d’usinage, dans le respect des exigences qualité, sécurité et délais. Véritable soutien du Responsable secteur, vous interviendrez directement sur la production et contribuerez à l’amélioration continue des processus, tout en veillant à un bon climat de travail et à l’accompagnement de l’équipe. Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes : Expertise technique et suivi des procédés Être le référent technique en usinage sur l’ensemble du parc machine (tournage, fraisage 3axes) Définir, valider et optimiser les paramètres d’usinage Réaliser et/ou valider les réglages machines pour garantir la conformité et la répétabilité Assurer un niveau de qualité optimal en respectant les standards internes Assurer la préparation et l’entretien des machines et des équipements associés Gestion des priorités et amélioration continue Identifier et résoudre les défauts d’usinage Mettre en place et suivre des actions correctives durables en collaboration avec la production, les méthodes et la qualité Contribuer à l’optimisation des procédés existants Participer à l’industrialisation des nouveaux produits Assurer le respect des délais et la gestion des priorités en lien avec l’ordonnancement Développement des équipes et respect des normes Former et accompagner les collaborateurs pour garantir une montée en compétences y compris les apprentis. Expliquer et faire appliquer les instructions de poste et standards internes. Favoriser un bon climat de travail en encourageant la communication et la coopération entre les équipes Assurer le respect des normes de sécurité, de santé et d’environnement (SST). Sensibiliser les équipes aux bonnes pratiques et contribuer à la prévention des accidents. Superviser les essais des candidats lors des processus de recrutement. Solide compétences sur les moyens d’usinage CNC Usage régulier des commandes Fanuc et Siemens Sens du détail et capacité à diagnostiquer et résoudre rapidement les anomalies de production Aptitude à structurer et transmettre un savoir-faire technique avec pédagogie. Leadership naturel pour accompagner, transmettre, encadrer et motiver les équipes Rigueur, sens de l’analyse et capacité à résoudre des problématiques techniques Esprit équipe et sens de la communication pour favoriser un climat de travail positif et une collaboration efficace Organisation et autonomie dans la gestion des priorités et des tâches quotidienne Engagement fort pour le respect des normes SST et leur application au quotidien. 
• Nous offrons : - Un environnement de travail stimulant, des équipes dynamiques, exigeantes en quête de nouveaux challenges. - Un espace de travail moderne, agréable et de belles prestations sociales - Des horaires flexibles (départ dès 15h00) - Des possibilités d’évolution, développement des compétences #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to attract talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. Internship Assistant Supply Chain Demand Planning – Switzerland (H/F) Start of internship : July 2026 Duration: 6 months - full time Department: Within the Supply Chain Department Location: Meyrin - Switzerland Do you correspond to the profile? Are you a student from a training course with a dominant in Supply Chain/Operations/Logistics? Do you have strong analytical skills and a very good relationship? You appreciate teamwork and are curious, proactive, very rigorous? Do you have computer and reporting skills? (Excel and PowerPoint controlled, SAP and Power BI desired). Do you have a real interest in the luxury, Haute Horlogerie and jewellery sector? Do you speak fluent English? What do we want from you? Within the Operations and Trades department, integrated into the Supply Chain team, you are attached to the Supply Chain Demand Planner. In close collaboration with regional Supply Chain, logistics, production and marketing teams, you will manage specific market and event demands, depending on stock availability, priorities, production outputs and after-sales service. In the various collections of the House and in collaboration with the central and regional teams, you will contribute to the management of stocks of finished products by ensuring good communication and effective coordination. One of your projects will be to optimize collaborative tools and to complete Reporting allowing this steering and thus facilitate better follow-up, from the expression of need to customer billing. Integrated with the Demand Planning team, you will participate in performance analysis and identification of potential improvements. More than just an internship... Experience! jobs.title: Senior Manager, Campuses Operational HSE
jobs.description: Reference code: JR126553 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. This role encompasses direct management of HSE operations across our key campuses and strategic coordination for critical sites: Direct Management: Oversee and lead HSE operations at the Campus Genevois de Haute Horlogerie, Headquarters de Bellevue, and the Campus de Villars-sur-Glâne. Strategic Coordination: Support and guide HSE operations at critical sites as defined by Group Security, ensuring alignment with Group standards and objectives. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? I. Direct HSE Management for Campuses (Meyrin, Bellevue, Villars-sur-Glâne) Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a team comprising 2 internal HSE collaborators, external HSE support, and occupational nurses covering 3 health services across the 3 sites. Foster a culture of excellence and continuous improvement in workplace safety and environmental protection. Operational Oversight: Ensure the delivery of high-quality HSE services and maintain appropriate workplace safety standards for all personnel and assets across the designated campuses. Third-Party Management: Manage relationships with third-party service providers, including contract negotiation, performance monitoring, and ensuring optimal return on investment (ROI). Risk Mitigation & Strategy: Develop, implement, and continuously refine comprehensive mitigation strategies to address identified HSE hazards and environmental impacts. This includes procedural enhancements, technological improvements, and targeted awareness training programs. Compliance & Governance: Ensure strict adherence to all relevant HSE regulations, laws, and industry best practices. Develop and implement corrective action plans to address any identified deficiencies promptly. Incident Management: Oversee the accurate recording, thorough investigation, and detailed assessment of all HSE incidents, near misses, and hazardous situations. Identify root causes and implement effective corrective and preventive actions in line with Group HSE compliance requirements. Audits & Reviews: Conduct regular internal HSE self-assessments and reviews of new processes, facility modifications, and operational changes to ensure ongoing compliance and safety. Budget & Resource Management: Monitor and control HSE expenditures, ensuring efficient resource allocation and suitable ROI for all initiatives. Proactive Monitoring: Stay abreast of emerging HSE risks, threats, and trends, adapting campus HSE strategies and protocols accordingly. On-Site Presence: Maintain a regular physical presence at the CGHH Meyrin and at the Villars-sur-Glâne campus (minimum of 2 days per week per site) to ensure direct oversight and engagement. Stakeholder Engagement: Coordinate effectively with local authorities, professional bodies, and internal stakeholders (e.g., facilities, production, HR) as necessary to ensure integrated HSE management. II. HSE Guidance & Coordination for Critical Sites Strategic Alignment Support: Contribute to the strategic alignment of HSE initiatives for critical sites with Richemont's overall objectives and Group directives, providing expert input and recommendations. Risk Assessment Advisory: Provide guidance and support to critical sites in conducting regular, comprehensive risk assessments and vulnerability analyses to identify potential significant hazards and environmental impacts. Best Practice Facilitation: Establish and facilitate regular team meetings, committees, and task forces to ensure cross-functional alignment, promote best practice sharing, and foster consistent HSE standards across all critical sites. Expert Guidance & Training: Offer expert guidance, advice, and support to site personnel and field HSE managers, actively promoting a proactive culture of HSE awareness and safe behaviour through training and mentorship. Group HSE Liaison: Act as a key liaison with the Group HSE function, actively contributing to the evaluation of new requirements, addressing challenges, and exploring innovative technologies and solutions relevant to critical sites. Oversight & Support Visits: Conduct regular visits to all critical sites, as dictated by risk assessments and business needs, to provide support, monitor implementation of HSE programs, and offer constructive feedback. Emergency Preparedness Support: Assist critical sites in the development, review, and implementation of robust emergency response plans and business continuity measures. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Bachelor’s degree in Health, Safety, and Environmental Management, Occupational Safety, Environmental Science, or a related engineering field. A recognised Swiss HSE qualification/certification (e.g., Federal Diploma for Safety Specialist, OHSAS 18001/ISO 45001 Lead Auditor) is required. Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in HSE management, with a significant focus on operational safety and environmental compliance within complex, multi-site environments. Proven experience in the luxury goods industry, high-value asset environments, or a similar sector with stringent security and safety requirements is highly desirable. Multi-Site Management: demonstrated experience in managing HSE operations across multiple sites, ideally in an international context. Analytical Skills: Strong ability to collect, analyse, and interpret complex data from various sources to identify trends, generate key insights, and present actionable recommendations that facilitate informed decision-making. Leadership: Proven track record of leading, motivating, and developing diverse teams, as well as influencing stakeholders at all organisational levels. Languages: Fluency in French (foremost) and English is required. Proficiency in additional languages (e.g., German) is a significant asset. Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and implement long-term HSE strategies that are fully aligned with Richemont's business objectives and Group Security directives. Risk Management: Expert ability to identify, assess, evaluate, and effectively mitigate a broad spectrum of HSE hazards and environmental impacts. Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the capacity to dissect complex issues and develop innovative, practical, and sustainable solutions. Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex HSE concepts clearly and persuasively to diverse, non-technical audiences. Proven ability to influence and negotiate with internal and external stakeholders. Decision Making: Ability to make sound, timely, and effective decisions under pressure, based on comprehensive information and risk assessment. Regulatory Expertise: In-depth knowledge of Swiss and international HSE regulations, standards, and best practices. Emergency Response: Experience in developing, implementing, and testing emergency preparedness and response plans. Environmental Stewardship: Demonstrated commitment to environmental protection and sustainability initiatives. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Physical Security Coordinator Europe Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont HS&E Specialist Save Milano, Italy Richemont Security System Project Senior Manager/Manager Save Tokyo, Japan Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR126553 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi raffinati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. Questo ruolo comprende la gestione diretta delle operazioni HSE attraverso i nostri campus chiave e il coordinamento strategico per i siti critici: Direzione diretta: supervisionare e guidare le operazioni HSE presso il Campus Genevois de Haute Horlogerie, sede di Bellevue, e il Campus de Villars-sur-Glâne. Coordinamento strategico: Supporta e guida le operazioni HSE nei siti critici definiti dalla Sicurezza del Gruppo, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard e gli obiettivi del Gruppo. Come fai a fare un'infezione? I. Direct HSE Management for Campuses (Meyrin, Bellevue, Villars-sur-Glâne) Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentore, e sviluppare un team composto da 2 collaboratori HSE interni, supporto HSE esterno e infermiere professionali che coprono 3 servizi sanitari in 3 siti. Promuovere una cultura di eccellenza e un continuo miglioramento della sicurezza sul posto di lavoro e della protezione ambientale. Supervisione operativa: Assicurare la consegna di servizi HSE di alta qualità e mantenere adeguati standard di sicurezza sul posto di lavoro per tutto il personale e le attività nei campus designati. Gestione di terze parti: gestire i rapporti con i fornitori di servizi di terze parti, tra cui la negoziazione di contratti, il monitoraggio delle prestazioni e garantire un ritorno ottimale sugli investimenti (ROI). Risk Mitigation & Strategy: Sviluppare, implementare e perfezionare continuamente strategie di mitigazione complete per affrontare i pericoli HSE identificati e gli impatti ambientali. Questo include miglioramenti procedurali, miglioramenti tecnologici e programmi di formazione mirati di consapevolezza. Compliance & Governance: Assicurare una stretta adesione a tutte le normative HSE pertinenti, leggi e best practice del settore. Sviluppare e implementare piani di azione correttiva per affrontare tempestivamente eventuali carenze identificate. Gestione degli incidenti: supervisionare la registrazione accurata, l'indagine approfondita e la valutazione dettagliata di tutti gli incidenti HSE, vicino a errori e situazioni pericolose. Identificare le cause della radice e implementare azioni correttive e preventive efficaci in linea con i requisiti di conformità del Gruppo HSE. Audits & Recensioni: Condurre regolarmente autovalutazioni HSE interne e recensioni di nuovi processi, modifiche delle strutture e modifiche operative per garantire la conformità e la sicurezza in corso. Budget & Resource Management: Monitorare e controllare le spese HSE, garantire l'assegnazione efficiente delle risorse e il ROI adatto per tutte le iniziative. Monitoraggio attivo: Rimani al passo con i rischi, le minacce e le tendenze emergenti, adattando le strategie e i protocolli HSE del campus di conseguenza. Presenza sul posto: Mantenere una presenza fisica regolare presso il CGHH Meyrin e presso il campus Villars-sur-Glâne (minimo di 2 giorni alla settimana per sito) per garantire la supervisione diretta e l'impegno. Stakeholder Engagement: Coordinare efficacemente con le autorità locali, gli organismi professionali e gli stakeholder interni (ad esempio, le strutture, la produzione, le risorse umane) al fine di garantire la gestione integrata dell'HSE. II. HSE Guidance & Coordination for Critical Sites Strategic Alignment Support: Contribuisci all'allineamento strategico delle iniziative HSE per siti critici con gli obiettivi generali e le direttive del Gruppo Richemont, fornendo input e raccomandazioni per esperti. Consulente per la valutazione del rischio: fornire indicazioni e supporto ai siti critici nella conduzione di valutazioni di rischio regolari e complete e analisi di vulnerabilità per identificare potenziali rischi significativi e impatti ambientali. Best Practice Facilitation: Stabilire e facilitare riunioni di squadra regolari, comitati e forze di compito per garantire l'allineamento interfunzionale, promuovere la migliore condivisione delle pratiche e promuovere standard HSE coerenti in tutti i siti critici. Consulenza e formazione degli esperti: offrire una guida esperta, consigli e supporto al personale del sito e ai responsabili HSE del settore, promuovendo attivamente una cultura proattiva della consapevolezza HSE e del comportamento sicuro attraverso la formazione e la mentorship. Gruppo HSE Liaison: agire come un collegamento chiave con la funzione Gruppo HSE, contribuire attivamente alla valutazione di nuovi requisiti, affrontare le sfide, e esplorare tecnologie e soluzioni innovative rilevanti per i siti critici. Visite di supervisione e supporto: condurre visite regolari a tutti i siti critici, come dettato da valutazioni di rischio e esigenze aziendali, per fornire supporto, monitorare l'implementazione dei programmi HSE, e offrire feedback costruttivi. Supporto per la preparazione di emergenza: assistere i siti critici nello sviluppo, nella revisione e nell'attuazione di piani di risposta di emergenza robusti e misure di continuità aziendale. Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Corso di laurea in salute, sicurezza e gestione ambientale, sicurezza sul lavoro, scienza ambientale, o un campo di ingegneria correlato. È richiesta una qualifica/certificazione HSE riconosciuta (ad esempio, il Diploma federale per lo specialista della sicurezza, OHSAS 18001/ISO 45001 Lead Auditor). Minimo di 10 anni di esperienza progressiva nella gestione HSE, con un focus significativo sulla sicurezza operativa e sulla conformità ambientale in ambienti complessi e multi-sito. L'esperienza comprovata nell'industria dei beni di lusso, negli ambienti di asset ad alto valore, o in un settore simile con severi requisiti di sicurezza e sicurezza è altamente auspicabile. Multi-Site Management: esperienza dimostrata nella gestione delle operazioni HSE in più siti, idealmente in un contesto internazionale. Abilità analitiche: forte capacità di raccogliere, analizzare e interpretare i dati complessi da varie fonti per identificare le tendenze, generare intuizioni chiave e presentare raccomandazioni attuabili che facilitano il processo decisionale informato. Leadership: Provato track record di leader, motivare e sviluppare team diversi, così come influenzare gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli organizzativi. Lingue: Fluency in Francese (quasi) e Inglese è richiesto. La competenza in altre lingue (ad esempio in tedesco) è un bene significativo. Strategic Thinking: Capacità di sviluppare e implementare strategie HSE a lungo termine che sono pienamente allineate agli obiettivi aziendali di Richemont e alle direttive di Group Security. Gestione del rischio: Capacità di esperti di identificare, valutare, valutare e mitigare efficacemente un ampio spettro di pericoli HSE e impatti ambientali. Problem Solving: competenze analitiche e problem solving eccezionali, con la capacità di dissezionare questioni complesse e sviluppare soluzioni innovative, pratiche e sostenibili. Comunicazione e influenza: eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali, con la capacità di articolare concetti HSE complessi in modo chiaro e persuasivo a un pubblico diverso e non tecnico. Prove capacità di influenzare e negoziare con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. Decision Making: Capacità di prendere decisioni solide, tempestive ed efficaci sotto pressione, basate su informazioni complete e valutazione dei rischi. Competenza normativa: conoscenza approfondita delle normative, degli standard e delle best practice HSE svizzere e internazionali. Risposta di emergenza: Esperienza nello sviluppo, nell'attuazione e nella sperimentazione di piani di preparazione e risposta di emergenza. jobs.description: Reference code: JR126535 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. CONTEXTE Au sein de notre manufacture joaillère, nous recherchons un/e Stagiaire Excellence Opérationnelle afin de mener des missions d’optimisation des processus et de la performance. Le département Excellence Opérationnelle est garant des démarches d’amélioration continue pour l’ensemble des départements, des ateliers de production aux fonctions support (Logistique, Qualité, Développement, Finance…) COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? En tant que Stagiaire Excellence Opérationnelle, vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes : Piloter une mission d’Excellence Opérationnelle au sein du Pôle Joaillerie Suisse Cadrer : planning, instances de gouvernance, objectifs, livrables Mener la mission selon la démarche DMAIC Coordonner l’avancement du projet avec les différents acteurs Assurer le reporting régulier auprès des instances dédiées Communiquer de manière efficace et accompagner la conduite du changement Garantir l’atteinte des livrables et des résultats Soutenir les départements dans leurs démarches de progrès Mener des chantiers d’amélioration pour soutenir les départements (5S, management visuel, standards de travail, amélioration d’outils) Accompagner ou former les métiers aux méthodologies d’excellence opérationnelle (VSM, DMAIC, Kaizen) Contribuer à la culture de l’Excellence Opérationnelle au sein du Pôle Joaillerie Suisse Communiquer et valoriser les actions terrain Capitaliser sur les bonnes pratiques du lean, proposer de nouvelles initiatives ou méthodes d’Excellence Opérationnelle pour la manufacture QUELLES SONT LES CLES DE VOTRE REUSSITE AU SEIN DE NOTRE MAISON ? Titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur (ou équivalent), vous justifiez d’une première expérience dans un poste similaire, idéalement acquise dans un environnement industriel. Vous avez une bonne connaissance des concepts, outils et méthodologies de l’Excellence Opérationnelle et du Lean manufacturing (VSM, DMAIC, Kaizen, 8D etc). Vous êtes pragmatique et savez écouter les besoins des équipes métiers. Vous êtes curieux, organisé et rigoureux. Vous aimez travailler de manière autonome et proactive. Vous maîtrisez les bases de la gestion de projet (planification, reporting, animation d’ateliers). descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR126535 La storia di Cartier si basa sulla curiosità e sulla passione. descriptionByLocale.en: Reference code: JR126535 Cartier's story is built on curiosity and passion. For over 170 years, we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers, from boutiques to workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues from more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. CONTEXT Within our jewelry manufacturing, we are seeking an Operational Excellence Intern to lead process and performance optimization projects. The Operational Excellence department ensures continuous improvement initiatives across all departments, from production workshops to support functions (Logistics, Quality, Development, Finance…). HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As an Operational Excellence Intern, your main responsibilities will include: - Managing an Operational Excellence project within the Swiss Jewelry Division - Defining: planning, governance bodies, objectives, deliverables - Conducting the project following the DMAIC approach - Coordinating project progress with various stakeholders - Ensuring regular reporting to dedicated committees - Communicating effectively and supporting change management - Guaranteeing the achievement of deliverables and results - Supporting departments in their improvement initiatives - Leading improvement projects (5S, visual management, work standards, tool improvements) - Training or coaching teams on operational excellence methodologies (VSM, DMAIC, Kaizen) - Contributing to the culture of Operational Excellence within the Swiss Jewelry Division - Communicating and showcasing field actions - Capitalizing on lean best practices, proposing new initiatives or methods of Operational Excellence for the manufacturing site WHAT ARE THE KEYS TO YOUR SUCCESS IN OUR HOUSE? Holding an engineering degree (or equivalent), you have some experience in a similar role, ideally in an industrial environment. You have a good understanding of concepts, tools, and methodologies of Operational Excellence and Lean manufacturing (VSM, DMAIC, Kaizen, 8D, etc.). You are pragmatic, attentive to team needs, curious, organized, and rigorous. You enjoy working independently and proactively. You have basic project management skills (planning, reporting, workshop facilitation). Your communication skills, team spirit, and interpersonal skills enable you to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders and foster change acceptance. WHAT DO WE OFFER? We create an innovative and positive environment where we are proud to employ talents from different backgrounds, experiences, and identities. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and strengthened, creativity and knowledge flourish to achieve excellence. YOUR CANDIDATE JOURNEY We look forward to receiving your complete application. If successful, you will have an initial phone contact with our HR team to arrange an interview with our Operational Excellence Manager. We are convinced that when diversity, equity, and inclusion are fully embraced, innovation and creativity emerge to deliver excellence. jobs.title: Stagiaire Archiviste
jobs.description: Reference code: JR126627 Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison’s watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication. Le/La stagiaire archiviste aura pour mission de soutenir l’équipe des archives dans la gestion, la conservation et la valorisation des fonds documentaires du Groupe. Il/Elle participera activement aux projets en cours visant à organiser et rendre accessibles les informations historiques et contemporaines, qu’elles soient physiques ou numériques. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Traitement des fonds : Réaliser l’inventaire, le classement et la description de documents physiques et numériques. Participer à la saisie et à la mise à jour des données dans les bases de données archivistiques. Numérisation : Assister dans les projets de numérisation des collections, y compris la préparation des documents, la numérisation elle-même et le contrôle qualité des images. Participer à l’indexation et à la description des documents numérisés. Recherche et communication : Apporter un soutien aux recherches documentaires internes. Contribuer à la valorisation des fonds (expositions, publications, internes, etc.) si l’opportunité se présente. Gestion quotidienne : Participer aux tâches administratives courantes du service des archives. LA CLÉ DE VOTRE SUCCÈS ? VOS COMPÉTENCES ! Vous recherchez un stage dans le cadre de vos études (Master) en Archiviste, Sciences de l'information Vous maîtrisez les outils du Pack office et êtes familier avec les logiciels archivistiques et avez une sensibilité aux enjeux de la numérisation de la conservation numérique Vous portez un grand intérêt pour l'horlogerie Vous êtes reconnu pour votre rigueur, votre méthode et votre sens de l'organisation Vous êtes autonome, proactif et avez un esprit analytique. Vous êtes doté d'un bon esprit d'équipe et un très bon relationnel Vous maîtrisez le français (anglais professionnel serait un atout). POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? Vous êtes notre meilleur atout. En rejoignant Jaeger-LeCoultre, tout un monde d'opportunités s'ouvre à vous ! La transmission du savoir est l'âme même de notre métier : vous aurez accès à un programme de formation sur mesure. Dans nos bureaux Suisses, nous répondons à votre désir de bien-être et d'équilibre, grâce à un lieu de travail stimulant, du travail à distance, des horaires flexibles, une contribution à la mobilité durable, des services sur site et du temps pour le bénévolat. Notre Maison travaille sans relâche pour gérer son empreinte environnementale et créer un impact positif sur la société grâce à nos efforts collectifs. Apprenez-en davantage sur nos engagements en termes de Développement Durable dans notre programme « Rendre notre Monde Meilleur ». He/she will actively participate in ongoing projects to organize and make available historical and contemporary information, whether physical or digital. HOW DO YOU HAVE AN IMPACT? Treatment of funds: To carry out the inventory, classification and description of physical and digital documents. Participate in data entry and updating in archival databases. Scanning: Assist in digitizing collection projects, including document preparation, digitization itself and image quality control. Participate in indexing and describing digitized documents. Research and Communication: Support internal documentary research. Contribute to the valuation of funds (exhibitions, publications, internal, etc.) if the opportunity arises. You have a good team spirit and a very good relationship You have mastered French (professional English would be an asset). Why should we join? You're our best asset. Learn more about our Sustainable Development commitments in our program "Making Our World Better". jobs.title: Gestionnaire Paie et Assurances Sociales
jobs.description: Reference code: JR126847 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Ready to showcase your skills as Payroll Specialist? Come and join our HR admin. & Payroll team to work in a dynamic environment with our prestigious Maisons. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? We are looking for a new colleague with relevant experience in HR administration and payroll management, a strong sense of service and highly sensitive to confidentiality and data protection. You will be particularly in charge of the following activities: Salary Administration Accurately gather, verify, and input fixed and variable payroll information Edit and control the documents necessary for payroll preparation Edit annual documents (withholding taxes, salary certificates, etc.) Ensure the accuracy of payroll documents HR Administration Manage work permit requests and renewals Provide time management support (correction of clocking, monitoring of counters, shift schedule, etc.) Monitor family allowances (new applications, modifications, cancellations, etc.) Check all employee-related information in Workday Employee Entries and Exits Organize and lead the administrative onboarding of employees: hand over and explain the HR admin pack (taxes, social insurance, Richemont digital tools, etc.) Establish unemployment certificates, salary certificates, employment certificates, and other required documents Support for Employees and Managers Provide support to users of existing HR tools (Time Management, Self-Service portal, On/Off boarding, etc.) Answer questions relating to payslips, annual tax documents, social insurance, taxation, annual calendar, counters and hour balances, etc. Organize and/or participate in the organization of information sessions for employees Contribute to communication and training activities for employees HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Swiss HR certificate is a must have. French fluent and English will be required to connect with our community from all horizons In addition, strong skills in salary administration, a high sense of customer service, wish to work independently in a changing environment, priority management and pragmatism, agile with figures, organised and a good team spirit. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call. 2. The next step from there would be a first Technical interview with our HR Admin & Payroll Manager; and if there is a match, you will have a personal meeting with him/her and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Payroll and Social Insurance Specialist - IWC Manufacture Save Schaffhausen, Switzerland Richemont HR Coordinator Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Payroll & Operations Manager Benelux & Nordics Save Amsterdam, Netherlands Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR126847 Richemont possiede alcuni dei principali prodotti di lusso Maisons, con particolare forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione fiera di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maisons. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo a innovazione e progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in linea con i nostri valori Maisons., attraverso un processo di creatività continua. Pronti a mostrare le vostre competenze come Payroll Specialist? Venite e unitevi al nostro amministratore HR. & Payroll team per lavorare in un ambiente dinamico con le nostre Maisons. COME FARE UN IMPATTO?

jobs.title: Termineur en Habillage Horloger
jobs.description: Reference code: JR127117 Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison’s watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication. VOTRE MISSION : Au sein de notre Direction Manufacturing et rattaché au département Boîtes, vous serez en charge de conduire, coordonner et contrôler l’atelier des Boîtes Complications afin de respecter les programmes et leur réalisation dans les conditions de quantité, qualité, coût, délai et sécurité prévus. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS AVOIR UN IMPACT ? Finition et Polissage des Boîtes de Montres : Réaliser toutes les opérations de finition (polissage, satinage, brossage, etc.) sur les boîtes et composants de montres, en utilisant des machines spécifiques et en assurant la conformité aux spécifications techniques et esthétiques. Préparation et Assemblage : Préparer les boîtes pour les étapes ultérieures (galvanoplastie, sertissage) et assembler leurs différents éléments (carrure, lunette, fond, glace, joints) en respectant les tolérances et les procédures d'étanchéité, puis contrôler leur ajustement et fonctionnement. Compétences Spécifiques en Bijouterie : Préparer les boîtes pour le sertissage, effectuer la finition de pièces joaillières (y compris les ajustements ou petites réparations) et maîtriser les spécificités des métaux précieux (or, platine). Contrôle Qualité : Effectuer des contrôles visuels et dimensionnels rigoureux à chaque étape, identifier et signaler les non-conformités, et assurer la traçabilité des pièces et des opérations. LA CLÉ DE VOTRE SUCCÈS ? VOS COMPÉTENCES ! Formation et Expérience : CFC Termineur Habillage Horloger, complété idéalement par un diplôme ou une expérience significative. Minimum 3 ans d'expérience en terminaison horlogère (produits hauts de gamme) et en bijouterie (préparation au sertissage, finition de pièces joaillières). Compétences Techniques : Maîtrise des techniques de finition horlogère (polissage, satinage, brossage) et des machines associées. Excellente dextérité, acuité visuelle, connaissance des métaux (acier, or, platine, titane) et capacité à lire des plans techniques. Qualités Personnelles : Minutie, précision, rigueur, sens de l'organisation, autonomie et esprit d'équipe. Capacité à gérer la pression et à respecter les délais, avec une passion pour l'horlogerie et la joaillerie de haute qualité. jobs.description:
Reference code: JR126863 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. YOUR MISSION: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Tech Team lead with a strong background in SAP logistics and integration to join our dynamic team. The candidate will play a pivotal role in managing a team defining, developing, and implementing solutions that seamlessly integrate our product and systems (ERP LE & EWM). This role requires a deep understanding of logistics processes, SAP functionalities, and modern integration technologies to ensure efficient and reliable supply chain operations. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Team Management: Manage a team of internal and external consultants. Budget follow-up: Able to understand and manage a budget, and all its constraints. Risk management: Identify the knowledge at risk and propose solutions. Trus & Transparency: need to provide a full transparency to the management, and alert to be raised 
• Requirements Definition: Elicit, analyse, and document detailed functional and non-functional requirements for integrating internal warehouse activities with ERP LE with or without EWM, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical feasibility. Solution Design & Development Support: Work closely with development teams, architects, and external partners to translate business requirements into technical specifications and integration designs. Provide guidance throughout the development lifecycle. For this part, the Forward Deployed Product Engineer will receive support from the product SAP Logistics Expertise: Leverage extensive experience in SAP logistics modules to design and optimize processes, configurations, and data flows related to internal warehousing (e.g., order fulfillment, warehousing, shipping, inventory management). Integration & API Management: Utilize strong knowledge of micro-services, APIs, and other integration technologies to design robust and scalable integration solutions between internal systems and 3PL platforms. Troubleshooting & Debugging: Apply excellent debugging skills in SAP to identify, analyze, and resolve complex issues arising from 3PL integrations, ensuring minimal disruption to operations. Testing & Quality Assurance: Define test cases, support user acceptance testing (UAT), and ensure the quality and reliability of integrated solutions before deployment. Stakeholder Communication: Act as a key liaison between business users, IT teams, and PO partners, facilitating clear communication and managing expectations throughout project lifecycles, or product sprints. Continuous Improvement: Monitor the performance of integrated solutions, gather feedback, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement and optimization. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Education Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. SAP EWM Certification would be a plus. Experience Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience working on multiple SAP projects specifically within the logistics domain (e.g., SAP WM, EWM, SD, MM, LE). Team Management experience in a challenging environment. Languages English (fluent mandatory) French and/or German are a plus Technical Skills: Proven strong debugging skills within SAP environments (ABAP debugging, transaction analysis, etc.). Good knowledge and practical experience with idocs/queue. Knowledge and practical experience with micro-services architecture, RESTful APIs, SOAP, and other modern integration patterns and technologies. Demonstrated experience in integrating SAP systems with external platforms, digital tools. Solid understanding of logistics and supply chain processes (warehousing, transportation, order management). Knowledge in EWM Outbound, inbound, and other processes flow. Soft Skills: Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional team environment. Ability to identify whenever communication to his peers or superiors in the SAPCC or business organization is required. Detail-oriented with a focus on delivering high-quality solutions. Good writing skills. descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR126863 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. Stiamo cercando un Team Tech altamente qualificato ed esperto con un forte background nella logistica e nell'integrazione SAP per unire il nostro team dinamico. Il candidato svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella gestione di un team che definisce, sviluppa e implementa soluzioni che integrano perfettamente i nostri prodotti e sistemi (ERP LE & EWM). Questo ruolo richiede una profonda comprensione dei processi logistici, delle funzionalità SAP e delle moderne tecnologie di integrazione per garantire operazioni di supply chain efficienti e affidabili. Come fai a fare un'infezione? Team Management: Gestire un team di consulenti interni ed esterni. Seguito del bilancio: in grado di comprendere e gestire un bilancio, e tutti i suoi vincoli. Gestione del rischio: Identificare le conoscenze a rischio e proporre soluzioni. Trus & Transparency: bisogno di fornire una piena trasparenza alla gestione, e allarme da sollevare
• Definizione: requisiti funzionali e non funzionali dettagliati per l'integrazione delle attività di magazzino interne con ERP LE con o senza EWM, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali e la fattibilità tecnica. Solution Design & Development Support: lavorare a stretto contatto con team di sviluppo, architetti e partner esterni per tradurre i requisiti aziendali in specifiche tecniche e progetti di integrazione. Fornire una guida durante il ciclo di vita di sviluppo. Da questa parte, l'Ingegnere del Prodotto Deployed Forward riceverà il supporto del prodotto SAP Logistics Expertise: Levare una vasta esperienza nei moduli logistici SAP per progettare e ottimizzare i processi, le configurazioni e i flussi di dati relativi all'evacuazione interna (ad esempio, l'adempimento degli ordini, lo stoccaggio, la spedizione, la gestione dell'inventario). Integrazione & API Management: Utilizzare una forte conoscenza di micro-servizi, API e altre tecnologie di integrazione per progettare soluzioni di integrazione robuste e scalabili tra sistemi interni e piattaforme 3PL. Risoluzione dei problemi & Debugging: Applicare eccellenti competenze di debug in SAP per identificare, analizzare e risolvere problemi complessi derivanti dalle integrazioni 3PL, garantendo una minima interruzione alle operazioni. Test & Quality Assurance: Definire i casi di test, supportare i test di accettazione dell'utente (UAT), e garantire la qualità e l'affidabilità delle soluzioni integrate prima dell'implementazione. Stakeholder Communication: Agite come un collegamento chiave tra utenti aziendali, team IT e partner PO, facilitando la comunicazione chiara e la gestione delle aspettative durante i cicli di vita del progetto, o sprint del prodotto. Miglioramento continuo: monitorare le prestazioni delle soluzioni integrate, raccogliere feedback e identificare le opportunità di miglioramento e ottimizzazione continui. Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Istruzione Laurea Magistrale in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, o un campo tecnico correlato. La certificazione SAP EWM sarebbe un vantaggio. Esperienza minima di 5 anni di esperienza pratica lavorando su più progetti SAP specificatamente all'interno del dominio logistico (ad esempio, SAP WM, EWM, SD, MM, LE). Esperienza di Team Management in un ambiente impegnativo. Lingue Inglese (fluente obbligatorio) Francese e/o Tedesco sono un plus Technical Skills: Prove forti competenze di debug all'interno di ambienti SAP (ABAP debugging, analisi delle transazioni, ecc.). Buona conoscenza e esperienza pratica con idocs/queue. Conoscenza e esperienza pratica con l'architettura dei micro-servizi, API RESTful, SOAP e altri modelli e tecnologie di integrazione moderni. Esperienza dimostrata nell'integrazione dei sistemi SAP con piattaforme esterne, strumenti digitali. Solida comprensione dei processi di logistica e supply chain (consapevolezza, trasporto, gestione degli ordini). La conoscenza in EWM Outbound, inbound e altri processi fluiscono. Soft Skills: eccellenti capacità analitiche e di problem solving. Forte comunicazione, presentazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di articolare concetti tecnici complessi agli stakeholder non tecnici. Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo in un ambiente di team veloce e trasversale. Capacità di identificare ogni volta che la comunicazione ai suoi coetanei o superiori nel SAPCC o organizzazione aziendale è necessaria. Dettaglio orientato con un focus sulla fornitura di soluzioni di alta qualità. Buone capacità di scrittura. jobs.description:
Reference code: JR126755 Founded in Florence in 1860, Panerai began as a workshop dedicated to precision instruments, shaped early on by a decisive partnership with the Royal Italian Navy. Designing instruments and tool watches for extreme conditions forged a mindset rooted in performance, innovation, and purpose. After joining the Richemont Group in 1997, Panerai gained international recognition for its distinctive DNA of Italian design and Swiss watchmaking expertise. Today, the Maison continues to create timepieces that push boundaries, translating its technical heritage into contemporary watchmaking for Modern Heroes—individuals driven by curiosity, courage, and the will to go further. We empower those who embrace challenges, value authenticity, and seek to leave a mark, together with a Maison that has never stopped evolving. Rattaché·e à notre Directeur Recherche & Développement au sein de notre département Pôle Projets, nous sommes à la recherche de notre futur·e : Responsable Développement Montres
