BACKGROUND Our approach to sustainability is inspired by our history and purpose: ‘We Craft the Future’. In FY26, the Group continued building on our responsible business values and heritage. This past year, the scope of the Group’s environmental management was further refined. This included the alignment of departments and expertise, along with the clarification of definitions and topics relevant to Richemont’s value chain, fostering a collective and harmonized approach to environmental stewardship. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The Environment Project Manager will play a pivotal role in driving Richemont's environmental agenda. Reporting to the Sustainability Transformation Manager, this position is responsible for supporting the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Group's environmental framework, ensuring alignment with Richemont's overall sustainability framework. This role will be in charge of the following responsibilities, including but not limited to:
• Environmental Framework: Contribute to the formulation and implementation of Group Policies and Guidelines for priority environmental topics, assess their effectiveness and impact, and identify areas for improvement or revision. Act as a Subject Matter Expert for the development and implementation of environmental projects and actions in coordination with Maisons, Regions and Functions. Under the strategic guidance of the Director Sustainability Transformation, this role supports the definition, development, and implementation of Richemont's harmonised group environmental framework, covering key areas such as climate change mitigation, circular economy principles, biodiversity protection, and water stewardship.
• Roadmap Development: Translate high-level environmental objectives into concrete, feasible roadmaps and actions for the Group and its diverse Maisons, ensuring practical application and measurable impact.
• Impact, Risk & Opportunity Assessment: Support the establishment and implementation of the process for identifying and assessing existing and emerging environmental risks, regulatory changes, and innovative opportunities across the value chain. This includes proposing responses and solutions for prevention, mitigation, and remediation.
• Target Setting & Performance Management: Contribute to environmental target setting and progress reporting, with a focus on digital solution integration.
• Reporting & Performance: Support the interpretation of environmental performance data to inform, among other, the continuous evolution of the environmental framework, support internal and external reporting (e.g., GRI, TCFD), and identify areas for improvement.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with Maisons' sustainability teams, operational departments, and central functions (e.g., Operations, Real Estate, Procurement) to embed environmental considerations into business processes, product lifecycles, and decision-making.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Prepare compelling presentations and reports for various internal stakeholders, including senior management, to communicate strategy, progress, and recommendations.
• Knowledge Sharing: Facilitate knowledge sharing and capability building across the Group on environmental topics, fostering a community of practice.
• Best Practice & Innovation: Stay abreast of global environmental trends, scientific advancements, industry best practices, and technological innovations and provide recommendations to inform future programs and initiatives. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?
• Deep understanding of global environmental challenges and solutions, including climate change science, circular economy models, biodiversity conservation, and resource efficiency.
• Passionate about environmental sustainability and its integration into business strategy.
• Strong project management skills with the ability to lead complex initiatives from conception to implementation.
• Ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity in a dynamic global environment.
• A strategic and forward-thinking individual with a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
• Highly collaborative and influential, with the ability to build strong relationships and drive change across a matrix organization.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking abilities.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex environmental concepts clearly and persuasively to diverse audiences.
• Proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership. SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:
• Master's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, or a related field.
• Minimum of 5-7 years of proven experience in environmental management, sustainability strategy development, or a similar role, preferably within a large, international organization or consulting firm.
• Demonstrated experience with environmental reporting frameworks (e.g., GRI, TCFD) and target-setting methodologies (e.g., SBTi).

Diese Position ist verantwortlich für die Unterstützung der Entwicklung, Umsetzung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des Umweltrahmens der Gruppe und stellt die Angleichung an den allgemeinen Nachhaltigkeitsrahmen von Richemont sicher. Au cours de l'année écoulée, la portée de la gestion environnementale du Groupe a été affinée. Cela comprenait l'harmonisation des ministères et de l'expertise, ainsi que la clarification des définitions et des sujets pertinents à la chaîne de valeur de Richemont, favorisant une approche collective et harmonisée de l'intendance environnementale. Comment allez-vous avoir un impact ? Le gestionnaire de projet environnemental jouera un rôle central dans l'élaboration du programme environnemental de Richemont. Relevant du gestionnaire de la transformation durable, ce poste est chargé de soutenir l'élaboration, la mise en oeuvre et l'amélioration continue du cadre environnemental du Groupe, assurant ainsi l'alignement sur le cadre global de durabilité de Richemont. Ce rôle sera chargé des responsabilités suivantes, notamment :
• Cadre environnemental : Contribuer à la formulation et à la mise en œuvre de politiques et de lignes directrices de groupe pour les questions environnementales prioritaires, évaluer leur efficacité et leur impact, et identifier les domaines à améliorer ou à réviser. Agir en tant qu'expert en matière de développement et de mise en oeuvre de projets et d'actions environnementaux en coordination avec les Maisons, Régions et Fonctions. Sous la direction stratégique du directeur, Transformation durable, ce rôle soutient la définition, l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre du cadre environnemental harmonisé du groupe Richemont, couvrant des domaines clés tels que l'atténuation des changements climatiques, les principes de l'économie circulaire, la protection de la biodiversité et la gestion de l'eau.
• Développement de la feuille de route: Traduire des objectifs environnementaux de haut niveau en feuilles de route et actions concrètes et réalisables pour le Groupe et ses diverses Maisons, en assurant une application pratique et un impact mesurable.
• Évaluation des répercussions, des risques et des possibilités : Appuyer l'établissement et la mise en oeuvre du processus de détermination et d'évaluation des risques environnementaux existants et émergents, des changements réglementaires et des possibilités d'innovation dans toute la chaîne de valeur. Cela comprend la proposition de mesures et de solutions pour la prévention, l'atténuation et l'assainissement.
• Définition des objectifs et gestion du rendement : Contribuer à l'établissement des objectifs environnementaux et à l'établissement de rapports sur les progrès réalisés, en mettant l'accent sur l'intégration des solutions numériques.
• Rapports et rendement : Appuyer l'interprétation des données sur la performance environnementale afin d'éclairer, entre autres, l'évolution continue du cadre environnemental, de soutenir les rapports internes et externes (p. ex. GRI, FDC) et de cerner les domaines à améliorer.
• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de durabilité de Maisons, les départements opérationnels et les fonctions centrales (p. ex., Opérations, Immobilier, Approvisionnement) pour intégrer les considérations environnementales aux processus opérationnels, au cycle de vie des produits et à la prise de décisions.

"Richemont Toastmasters" Community-Management: Animieren und pflegen Sie die "Richemont Toastmasters"-Community und implementieren Sie Strategien, um die Mitgliedschaft und Teilnahme zu erhöhen. jobs.description: Reference code: JR128572 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. "Our mission is to turn complex cloud and DevOps capabilities into simple, self-service experiences that let teams innovate faster and safer" (Michelle Daalman, - DevOps Services Team) ABOUT THE ROLE As a DevOps Services Engineering Intern at Richemont, you will contribute to the evolution of our Internal Developer Portal (IDP) by building components, service interfaces, and self-service workflows that enable internal teams to easily consume automated cloud and DevOps services. This is a hands-on internship designed for enthusiastic learners who want to develop strong foundations in Cloud, DevOps, and automation, while contributing to meaningfull initiatives used by real client teams. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to help streamline workflows, improve deployment practices, and enhance developer self-service capabilities using modern DevOps and cloud technologies. WHAT YOU WILL DO During your internship, you will: Assist in building and improving CI/CD pipelines supporting portal and service delivery Write and maintain scripts or services to support automation and integrations Collaborate with development teams to automate workflows and deployment processes Contribute to the creation of packaged, reusable automated services exposed through the portal Work with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes Gain exposure to Cloud Platforms (AWS, GCP, Alicloud) Proactively identify gaps, suggest improvements, and contribute ideas to enhance developer experience Document processes, tools, and best practices for internal use. Apply DevOps best practices to ensure reliability, consistency, and transparency Collaborate with the Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps Platform, and Cloud Governance & Architecture teams to optimize configuration and enhance deployment efficiency, governance & security Stay up to date with emerging Cloud and DevOps technologies WHO YOU ARE You are a student or junior engineer who: Is currently pursuing (or recently completed) a degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field Has hands-on experience with scripting languages Has a strong interest in DevOps, cloud platforms, automation, or platform engineering Is comfortable working with APIs and modern web development concepts Has basic knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, or DevOps practices Has introductory exposure to containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and / or cloud concepts Is curious, proactive, and eager to learn beyond frontend development Communicates clearly and enjoys working in cross-functional teams HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? In a young and dynamic team environment focused on mentoring and personal development, you will participate in our digital transformation journey at Richemont Group. You will be able to work in an enriching and challenging technical environment with cutting-edge technologies. If you are passionate about delivering seamless deployments and client success, driving automation, DevOps practices, and working with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and if you thrive in a dynamic and collaborative work environment, we invite you to join our team ! #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Devops Services Engineer Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont Cloud Security Team Lead Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont DevOps Monitoring Engineer Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it:
Reference code: JR128572 Richemont possiede alcuni dei principali marchi di lusso al mondo, con particolare attenzione all'orologeria, agli accessori di lusso e alla gioielleria. Ogni marchio rappresenta una tradizione di stile, qualità e artigianato e Richemont cerca di preservare l'eredità e l'identità di ciascuno dei suoi marchi. Allo stesso tempo, siamo impegnati nell'innovazione e nella creazione di nuovi prodotti che rispettino i valori dei nostri marchi attraverso un processo di creatività continua. "La nostra missione è quella di trasformare le complesse capacità cloud e DevOps in esperienze di auto-servizio semplici che consentano alle squadre di innovare più velocemente e in modo più sicuro" (Michelle Daalman, - DevOps Services Team) Come stagista DevOps Services Engineering presso Richemont, contribuirete all'evoluzione del nostro Internal Developer Portal (IDP) costruendo componenti, interfacce di servizio e flussi di lavoro di auto-servizio che consentono alle squadre interne di utilizzare facilmente i servizi cloud e DevOps automatizzati. Si tratta di uno stage pratico progettato per gli entusiasti che vogliono sviluppare solide basi in cloud, DevOps e automazione, mentre contribuiscono a iniziative significative utilizzate da squadre client reali. Durante il tuo stage, ti aspettano:
• Assistere nella costruzione e miglioramento delle pipeline CI/CD che supportano la consegna del portale e dei servizi
• Scrivere e mantenere script o servizi per supportare l'automazione e le integrazioni
• Collaborare con le squadre di sviluppo per automatizzare i flussi di lavoro e i processi di distribuzione
• Contribuire alla creazione di servizi automatizzati, riutilizzabili e confezionati, esposti attraverso il portale
• Lavora con tecnologie container come Docker e Kubernetes
• Esponi alle piattaforme cloud (AWS, GCP, Alicloud)
• Identificare proattivamente le lacune, suggerire miglioramenti e contribuire con idee per migliorare l'esperienza degli sviluppatori
• Documentare processi, strumenti e best practice per uso interno
• Applicare le best practice DevOps per garantire affidabilità, coerenza e trasparenza Collaborare con le squadre di infrastruttura cloud, piattaforma DevOps e governance e architettura cloud per ottimizzare la configurazione e migliorare l'efficienza, la governance e la sicurezza dei deploy Mantenersi aggiornati sulle tecnologie cloud e DevOps emergenti
• Sei uno studente o un giovane ingegnera che:
• Sta attualmente frequentando (o ha recentemente completato) un corso di laurea in Scienze Informatiche, IT o un campo affine
• Ha esperienza pratica con i linguaggi di scripting
• Ha un forte interesse per DevOps, piattaforme cloud, automazione o ingegneria delle piattaforme
• Si sente a proprio agio nel lavorare con le API e i concetti di sviluppo web moderni
• Ha conoscenze basilari delle pipeline CI/CD, dei flussi di lavoro basati su Git o delle pratiche DevOps
• Ha una conoscenza introduttiva dei container (Docker, Kubernetes) e/o dei concetti di cloud
• E curioso, proattivo e desideroso di imparare oltre lo sviluppo frontend
• Comunica chiaramente e gode di lavorare in squadre multifunzionali Come ti teniamo sorridente In un ambiente di squadra giovane e dinamico focalizzato sul mentoring e lo sviluppo personale, parteciperai al nostro viaggio di trasformazione digitale nel gruppo Richemont. Potrai lavorare in un ambiente tecnico arricchente e stimolante con tecnologie all'avanguardia. Se sei appassionato di consegnare deploy senza soluzione di continuità e successo del cliente, guidare l'automazione, le pratiche DevOps e lavorare con tecnologie cloud all'avanguardia, e se ti piace lavorare in un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e collaborativo, ti invitiamo a unirti alla nostra squadra!

jobs.description: Reference code: JR128696 FOR THOSE WHO SEEK EXCELLENCE Join one of the most respected Maisons in fine watchmaking where excellence is both a given and a never-ending quest. Play your part in driving our collective success. YOUR ROLE We are seeking a High Watchmaking Client Relationship Manager who will be responsible for generating qualitative high value sales (exceptional/Les Cabinotiers timepieces) by developing his own VIC/VVIC client portfolio, cultivating strong relationships and leveraging the Maison hospitality platform, whilst also recruiting new clients/UHNWI. Collaboratively with international markets, this role will develop and treat VIC/VVIC/UHNWI visiting our Manufacture in Geneva, and other regional locations. Based in our Manufacture in Plan-les-Ouates and reporting to High Watchmaking Client Director, this role will work cross functionally (HQ and Markets) at Europe level. The High Watchmaking Client Relationship Manager plays a key and strategic role in growing our Maison reputation and desirability within the region. PLAYING YOUR PART Drive Client strategy and support Clients' development You will drive qualitative high value/Les Cabinotiers sales, in line with the Maison’s strategy and scarcity guidelines You will work off-site to grow your clients' network and to recruit new clients You will refer prospects to Boutiques in their home Market and support their Client journey You will work hand in hand with Boutiques to ensure the highest level of service before, during and after the sale when needed. You will manage VIC/VVIC clients' complaints and offer solutions Collaboratively with European/International markets, you will leverage Maison opportunities including the Hospitality platform, deliver unique and tailor-made Client experience You will work closely and support Boutique Managers within the Europe/International region, on coaching and developing their Sales team to grow the VIC/VVIC client base Define yearly action plans to recruit new Clients and contribute to the development of existing ones You will develop your own VIC/VVIC client portfolio, propose and align action plans to increase loyalty and develop high value/Les Cabinotiers sales You will assess market opportunities and potential to target and acquire new Clients; pro-actively suggest new development opportunities (event/places/intermediaries) to recruit new VIC/VVIC Clients You will evaluate existing Client’s journey and development within the markets/within the region, in particular sleeping VIC/VVIC clients, and contribute to (re-)activate them Support HQ Hospitality team You will work hand in hand with Markets and Hospitality Clients Manager to support Hospitality plans for their VIC/VVIC clients coming to Geneva You will host Clients in Switzerland out of the Manufacture, during diners, events, fairs or dedicated activations, and host them in the Manufacture together with Hospitality Clients Manager You will share post Clients’ activities/events analyses and reports with markets for local follow-up You will participate in local, regional and international Maison Events, acting as our Ambassador You will participate and be proactive in the enrichment of the Client experience offer, Hospitality services and overall Client treatment You will pass on knowledge to other Client Relationship Managers/Grand Vendeurs/Sales teams You will contribute to the administration of the Manufacture Salon-Boutique in daily operations (invoicing, shipping, after sales service, inventory, stock management in full compliance with the Maison and Richemont guidelines) together with the Hospitality Clients Manager WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL? Success in this role will require A solid 10+ years’ experience in Sales with proven records in managing VIC/VVIC Clients acquisition, engagement through strong partnerships and retention Self-entrepreneur and a self-motivated person, agile, broad-scanner, critical thinker, with ability to innovate, drive change and work autonomously Excellent knowledge of luxury Market, including watchmaking and jewellery brands, luxury fashion and trends and latest news in town and in the world Elegance, Passion, Generosity, Audacity, and Quest for Excellence, with excellent presentation skills and a high sense of client privacy & Maison’s confidentiality Proactivity with a “get-it-done” results-driven attitude, autonomy and ability to work independently to achieve the goals whilst being a strong team player for transverse activation - with a positive and resilient attitude Flexibility towards international travels Fluency in French and English, any other language a plus Vacheron Constantin celebrates 270 years as the world’s oldest watchmaker in continuous production since 1755. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, we operate a global retail network of nearly 200 points of sale across 36 countries. Every member of our exceptional global community of watchmakers, artisans and dedicated professionals share a common devotion to our exceptional heritage and a passion to trailblaze an even brighter future. If this fires your imagination, we welcome your application. descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR128696 Dans l'univers de la Maison, nos collaborurs de tous orizzonti partagent avec passion un but commun : la quête permanente de l'excellence portée par les compétences et l'engagement eccezioninels des femmes et des hommes qui travaillent dans notre Manufacture. Maison de conosciurs en Haute Horlogerie, Vacheron Constantin n'a jamais cessé, au cours de ses plus de 269 ans d'histoire, de se créer, de s'enrichir et de se réinventer. Siate uno dei non molti per il pensiero che vede l'ESCELLENZA Unisciti a una delle Maison più rispettate nell'orologeria dove l'eccellenza è sia una data che una ricerca senza fine. Gioca la tua parte nella guida del nostro successo collettivo. Il tuo!
• Stiamo cercando un High Watchmaking Client Relationship Manager che sarà responsabile della generazione di vendite ad alto valore qualitativo (exceptional/Les Cabinotiers timepieces) sviluppando il proprio portafoglio clienti VIC/VVIC, coltivando forti relazioni e sfruttando la piattaforma di ospitalità della Maison, reclutando anche nuovi clienti/UHNWI. Collaborativamente con i mercati internazionali, questo ruolo svilupperà e tratterà VIC/VVIC/UHNWI visitando la nostra Manifattura a Ginevra, e altre sedi regionali. Sulla base della nostra Manifattura in Plan-les-Ouates e della relazione al Direttore clienti di alta qualità dell'orologeria, questo ruolo funzionerà in modo funzionale (HQ e Markets) a livello europeo. L'High Watchmaking Client Relationship Manager svolge un ruolo chiave e strategico nella crescita della nostra reputazione e della disabilità della Maison all'interno della regione. Pianificare la strategia del cliente e sostenere lo sviluppo dei clienti Guiderete le vendite qualitative di alta qualità/Les Cabinotiers, in linea con la strategia della Maison e le linee guida di scarsità Potrai lavorare fuori sede per crescere la rete dei tuoi clienti e per reclutare nuovi clienti Riferirete le prospettive di Boutique nel loro mercato domestico e sostenere il loro viaggio cliente Potrai lavorare di pari passo con Boutique per garantire il più alto livello di servizio prima, durante e dopo la vendita quando necessario. Gestirete i reclami dei clienti VIC/VVIC e offrirete soluzioni In collaborazione con i mercati europei / internazionali, potrete sfruttare le opportunità di Maison tra cui la piattaforma Hospitality, fornire un'esperienza clienti unica e su misura Si lavorerà a stretto contatto e supporterà Boutique Manager all'interno della regione Europa / Internazionale, su coaching e sviluppo del loro team di vendita per crescere la base clienti VIC / VVIC Definire piani di azione annuali per reclutare nuovi clienti e contribuire allo sviluppo di quelli esistenti Svilupperai il tuo portafoglio clienti VIC/VVIC, proporrai e allineerai i piani d'azione per aumentare la lealtà e sviluppare un alto valore/Les Cabinotiers sales Valuterai le opportunità di mercato e il potenziale per indirizzare e acquisire nuovi Clienti; pro-attivamente suggerisci nuove opportunità di sviluppo (event/places/intermediaries) per reclutare nuovi clienti VIC/VVIC Valuterai il viaggio e lo sviluppo dei clienti esistenti all’interno dei mercati/all’interno della regione, in particolare i clienti VIC/VVIC che dormono, e contribuiranno (ri-)attivarli Support HQ Hospitality team Si lavorerà di pari passo con Markets and Hospitality Clients Manager per sostenere i piani di ospitalità per i loro clienti VIC/VVIC che verranno a Ginevra. Condividerai attività/eventi dei Clienti analisi e rapporti con i mercati per il follow-up locale Parteciperai a eventi di Maison locali, regionali e internazionali, in qualità di nostro Ambasciatore parteciperai e sarai proattivo nell'arricchimento dell'offerta di esperienza del cliente, dei servizi di accoglienza e del trattamento generale del cliente Passerai la conoscenza ad altri gestori di relazioni cliente/Grand Vendeurs/Sales team Contribuirai all'amministrazione del Salone-Boutique della Manifattura nelle operazioni quotidiane (fattura, spedizione, servizio post-vendita, inventario, gestione delle scorte nel pieno rispetto delle linee guida Maison e Richemont) insieme al Gestore Clienti dell'OspitalitÃ CHE COSA MAKE TU SUCCESSFUL? Il successo in questo ruolo richiederà un solido 10+ anni di esperienza in vendite con record comprovati nella gestione di VIC/VVIC Clients acquisizione, l'impegno attraverso partnership forti e la ritenzione Self-entrepreneur e una persona auto-motivated, agile, broad-scanner, pensatore critico, con la capacità di innovare, guidare il cambiamento e lavorare autonomamente Eccellente conoscenza del mercato di lusso, tra cui l'orologeria e marchi di gioielli, tendenze di moda e di lusso e di moda e di moda e le ultime notizie Con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, gestiamo una rete globale di vendita al dettaglio di quasi 200 punti vendita in 36 paesi. Ogni membro della nostra eccezionale comunità globale di orologiai, artigiani e professionisti dedicati condividono una comune devozione al nostro patrimonio eccezionale e alla passione per la sciabola di un futuro ancora più luminoso. Se questo accende la vostra immaginazione, accogliamo la vostra applicazione. Gestore clienti di ospitalità di lavori simili Salva Plan-Les-Ouates, Svizzera Vacheron Constantin HEAD di MARKETING SPECIALTIES & HIGH-END OFFER Salva Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Vacheron Constantin Private Client Manager, SEA Save Singapore, Singapore Vacheron Constantin

descriptionByLocale.de: Referenzcode: JR128696 Dans l'univers de la Maison, nos workingurs de tous horizons partagent avec passion un but commun : la quête permanente de l'excellence portée par les compétences et l'engagement Exceptnels des femmes et des hommes qui travaillent dans notre Manufacture. Maison de connaisseurs en Haute Horlogerie, Vacheron Constantin n'a jamais cessé, au cours de ses plus de 269 ans d'histoire, de se créer, de s'enrichir et de se réinventer. Seien Sie einer von nicht vielen FOR THOSE WHO SEEK EXCELLENCE Begleiten Sie eines der angesehensten Maisons in der feinen Uhrmacherei, wo Exzellenz sowohl eine gegebene als auch eine nie endende Quest ist. Spielen Sie Ihren Teil an unserem kollektiven Erfolg. IHRE ROLLE Wir suchen einen High Watchmaking Client Relationship Manager, der für die Erzeugung qualitativ hochwertiger Verkäufe (außergewöhnlich/Les Cabinotiers Zeitmesser) verantwortlich ist, indem er sein eigenes VIC/VVIC-Client-Portfolio entwickelt, starke Beziehungen kultiviert und die Maison Hospitality-Plattform nutzt und gleichzeitig neue Kunden/UHNWI rekrutiert. In Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Märkten wird diese Rolle die VIC/VVIC/UHNWI, die unsere Manufaktur in Genf besucht, und andere regionale Standorte entwickeln und behandeln. Mit unserer Fertigung in Plan-les-Ouates und der Berichterstattung an High Watchmaking Client Director wird diese Rolle funktionell (HQ und Märkte) auf europäischer Ebene arbeiten. Der High Watchmaking Client Relationship Manager spielt eine wichtige und strategische Rolle bei der Steigerung unserer Maison Reputation und Verzweiflung in der Region. IHRE PART Drive Client Strategie und Unterstützung der Entwicklung von Clients Sie werden qualitativ hohe Werte/Les Cabinotiers-Verkäufe im Einklang mit der Strategie und den Knappheitsrichtlinien von Maison antreiben Sie werden außerhalb der Website arbeiten, um das Netzwerk Ihrer Kunden zu erweitern und neue Kunden einzustellen Sie verweisen auf Boutiquen in ihrem Heimatmarkt und unterstützen ihre Customer Journey Sie arbeiten Hand in Hand mit Boutiquen, um das höchste Niveau der Dienstleistung vor, während und nach dem Verkauf bei Bedarf zu gewährleisten. Sie verwalten die Beschwerden der VIC/VVIC-Kunden und bieten Lösungen Zusammenarbeit mit europäischen/Internationalen Märkten, Sie nutzen Maison-Möglichkeiten einschließlich der Hospitality-Plattform, liefern einzigartige und maßgeschneiderte Kundenerfahrung Sie werden eng zusammenarbeiten und unterstützen Boutique-Manager in der Region Europa/International, Coaching und Entwicklung ihres Vertriebsteams, um die VIC/VVIC-C-Client-Basis zu wachsen. Sie entwickeln Ihr eigenes VIC/VVIC-Client-Portfolio, schlagen und richten Aktionspläne an, um die Loyalität zu erhöhen und einen hohen Wert/Les Cabinotiers-Vertrieb zu entwickeln Sie werden Marktchancen und Potenziale bewerten, um neue Kunden anzusprechen und zu erwerben; proaktiv schlagen neue Entwicklungschancen (Ereignisse/Stellen/Zwischengänge) vor, um neue VIC/VVIC-Clients einzustellen Sie bewerten die Reise und Entwicklung des bestehenden Kunden in den Märkten/innerhalb der Region, insbesondere schlafende VIC/VVIC-Kunden, und tragen dazu bei, sie zu unterstützen HQ Hospitality Team Sie arbeiten Hand in Hand mit Markets und Hospitality Clients Manager, um Hospitality Pläne für ihre VIC/VVIC-Kunden zu unterstützen, die nach Genf kommen. Sie werden post Kunden Aktivitäten / Veranstaltungen Analysen und Berichte mit Märkten für lokale Follow-up teilen Sie werden an lokalen, regionalen und internationalen Maison Events teilnehmen, fungieren als unser Botschafter Sie werden teilnehmen und aktiv an der Anreicherung des Kunden-Erfahrungsangebots, Hospitality-Services und Gesamt-Client-Behandlung Sie werden Wissen an andere Client-Beziehungsmanager/Grand Vendeurs/Sales-Teams weitergeben Sie werden zur Verwaltung der Herstellung Salon-Boutique in den täglichen Betrieben beitragen (Rechnung, Versand, nach Verkaufsservice, Inventar, Lagerverwaltung in voller Übereinstimmung mit den Maison und Richemont Richtlinien) zusammen mit dem Hospitality Clients Manager WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL? Erfolg in dieser Rolle erfordert eine solide 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in Vertrieb mit bewährten Aufzeichnungen in der Verwaltung VIC / VVIC Clients Akquisition, Engagement durch starke Partnerschaften und Retention Self-entrepreneur und eine selbst motivierte Person, agile, breit-Scanner, kritische Denker, mit der Fähigkeit, vertrauliche, Laufwerksänderung und Arbeit autonom. Mit Sitz in Genf, Schweiz, betreiben wir ein weltweites Einzelhandelsnetz von fast 200 Verkaufsstellen in 36 Ländern. Jedes Mitglied unserer außergewöhnlichen Weltgemeinschaft von Uhrmachern, Kunsthandwerkern und engagierten Profis teilt eine gemeinsame Hingabe zu unserem außergewöhnlichen Erbe und einer Leidenschaft, eine noch hellere Zukunft zu entdecken. Wenn dies Ihre Fantasie feuert, begrüßen wir Ihre Anwendung. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? By bringing added value, demonstrate and relay a quality-oriented mindset, and contribute to the dynamics of the team. · Support of team members across the Core Platforms Pole of Client & Market PMO team · Assist related (Senior) Program Managers in the preparation and execution of program initiative. · Contribute to varied activities around structuring and documenting a major Transformation program · Contribute to continuous improvement and develop our internal methodology by updating and maintaining our project documentation. · Suggest and organize team activities. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? · You are doing a master's degree or are recently graduated (Business or Engineering School) with a strong willingness to enter the area of Technology Innovation and Program Management. · You can follow a rapid learning curve and show impactful results (be a doer) after a short discovery phase. · You can experience transversal topics from IT to Business areas, see the big picture, and summarize the key elements. · You have a client orientated mindset, with an eye for detail and can propose improvements in our quality of deliverables and operational activities. · You are effective in communication and can work closely with cross-functional teams. · You have a strong team spirit, you are proactive, enthusiastic, and not afraid of new challenges. · Eager to master Program Management within an IT environment · Skilled in Microsoft 360 (Teams, PowerPoint, Excel & Word), know-how of Atlassian Suite is a bonus. · Strong proficiency in English and French is a must. · You are available for a 6-month internship with a start date in April 2026 · You are eligible for an internship agreement. HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? Enjoy the various personalities of our team, our regular team events, and the variety of our activities. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: 1. jobs.description: Reference code: JR128728 Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura. Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations. Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation. Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As part of the dynamic Piaget CRM & E-business team, you will assist in the day-to-day management of digital content across essential touchpoints like our website, newsletters, and clienteling. We are looking for a team player with a can-do attitude, who is organized, detail-oriented, and a quick learner. Internship duration: 10 months, starting September 1st, 2026. To be considered for this role, please submit a cover letter and a resume. Key responsibilities: The management of digital activation calendar & its content toolbox with cross-functional collaboration The collection and coordination of content needs from CRM and E-business touchpoints The adaptation of copywriting / text for digital platforms The launch of new products across digital platforms HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, ideally complemented by internships or academic projects. Ability to work autonomously and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Highly organized, with meticulous attention to detail, and adept at managing multiple stakeholders and timelines. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, with a strong aptitude for quickly learning and utilizing CMS, DAM, Slack, Trello, or other content planning tools. Fluent in English; proficiency in other European languages is a valuable asset. STILL WONDERING WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY? A Welcoming Team: Join our friendly, open-minded, and talented team, where your skills will be valued and your contributions will make a real difference. Dynamic and Engaging Work: Experience daily activities that are interesting, challenging, and diverse, keeping you engaged and motivated. Investment in Your Growth: We are passionate about developing our people, and you will have access to various training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. The Piaget culture of encouraging Extra-Care, fostering Mastery and bringing out the Extraordinary in our people, means that we will always go further, doing “what has never been done before”. Together. If you want to become a part of it do not hesitate to apply! Corso di laurea o master in un campo rilevante, idealmente completato da stage o progetti accademici. Capacità di lavorare autonomamente e prosperare in un ambiente dinamico e veloce. jobs.description: Reference code: JR128817 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Within the Group Supply Chain Team, you will step in a transformation project of Supply chain & Merchandising. You will support the design of the solution in terms of processes, tools & performance indicators. You will also support the implementation in a key Maison by providing the appropriate training material, by validating the solution with end-users & by supporting them in the operational implementation. WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE? You have a good understanding of global Supply Chain processes. You have an appetence for data-analytics combined with solid analytical skills and are at ease with IT tools. Planning processes, reporting tools, project management are familiars’ fields to you You are positive and adaptive to different people & environments, with strong communication skills (both written and oral). You have a good general culture, intellectual curiosity, and motivation to learn. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? You will work with diverse teams and have the opportunity to learn about a wide variety of domains. You will gain insights into the luxury industry from the perspective of one of the global leaders that is bridging more than two thousand years of heritage with cutting edge innovation. Working in the close to the Swiss countryside right outside Geneva, we offer an on-site restaurant, a beautiful setting, and a spacious open-plan working environment. The offices are close to local transport with direct access to the train station. HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? Inspiration is nurtured by an inspirational work environment. We do our best to ensure a passionate, international, and supportive environment. Employee experience is key, so you can expect a high-quality work environment with necessary additions to keep you smiling We all craft a positive and inclusive work atmosphere; we count on your strong contribution as well. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call. 2. The next step from there would be a discussion with all the key functions that will be crucial for your success (Hiring Manager, HR) 3. jobs.title: Boutique Manager
jobs.description: Reference code: JR128793 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The Boutique Manager manages and will develop a multicultural team. You will be responsible for achieving our commercial ambitions and providing our customers with unforgettable experiences that reflect the Maison signature, while ensuring the excellence and compliance of boutique operations. An agile and inspiring leader, a true ambassador for the Maison, you will be the driving force behind an emblematic boutique with international resonance, which you will also be responsible for promoting internally as an incubator for our best talents, professions and operating models of tomorrow. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Working in collaboration with the various Cartier Switzerland departments, you will be responsible for the boutique's commercial and operational performance by improving the main retail efficiency indicators, developing the team's skills and optimising operational costs. As an experienced and exemplary manager, you will create a positive and motivating environment that encourages performance, learning and personal development. Managing, training and developing your team gives you a sense of fulfilment and gives everyone the opportunity to contribute to our collective success. Developing your employees’ skills and optimising the organisation of the boutique life in an agile way are key to achieving and surpassing the objectives set. Creative and proactive, you will translate the boutique's strategy and ambitions into individual and collective priorities and objectives on a daily basis. As an ambassador for the boutique and the Maison, you will be an exemplary embodiment of the image and values of the Maison, which you will represent to all its internal and external audiences, both in and out of the boutique. You will be approachable, engaging and professional at all times, and demonstrate an excellent level of self-awareness. Working closely with the sales and communications teams, you will ensure that the customer is constantly at the heart of your actions at all levels of the organisation, in strict compliance with the Maison's image and strategy. Guaranteeing the perfect orchestration of the customer experience, you will bring to bear at the highest level our expertise in terms of hospitality, personalised experiences and event programming. Attentive to the smallest detail, uncompromisingly demanding but agile at all times, you will ensure the quality and enrichment of our database and its strategic and tactical activation in the service of our stated ambition: to engage and surprise our customers of yesterday, today and tomorrow. You will be responsible for ensuring that the customer strategy, the customer action plan and the boutique's annual events programme are fully deployed to enhance its appeal and influence. In compliance with the policies, procedures and directives of our Maison, you will supervise operations and be responsible for promoting a culture of efficiency and continuous improvement at all levels of the organisation. All these actions converge to serve a triple objective: the perfect management of flows, the optimisation of the employee experience and the fluidity of the customer experience. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Master's degree or equivalent 10+ years Retail experience in managing and developing large teams Strong leadership, communication and management skills with a flair for business and customers. Knowledge of the luxury goods industry and the jewellery and watchmaking sectors is a plus. Strong organisational skills and long-term vision. Strong expertise in clienteling and handling VIP clients. Performance culture and results orientation. Excellent analytical skills and understanding of retail productivity levers. Experience in an international environment. Fluency in German and English. Strong digital skills and an interest in new technologies and media. Strong interpersonal skills. Willingness to work weekend shifts and travel for training, customer events, etc. as required. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR128793 La storia di Cartier è fondata sulla curiosità e la passione. Da più di 170 anni abbracciamo uno spirito audace e pionieristico che continua ad ispirare i nostri team attraverso tutti i Métiers dalle nostre boutique ai nostri laboratori e uffici aziendali. I nostri oltre 10.000 colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito e un impegno indipendenti condivisi per l'eccellenza, cercando di arricchire continuamente il nostro patrimonio Maison.s spingendo i confini della creatività e dell'innovazione. Sarà lei a realizzare le nostre ambizioni commerciali e a fornire ai nostri clienti esperienze indimenticabili che riflettono la firma della Maison, garantendo al contempo l'eccellenza e la conformità delle operazioni boutique. Un leader agile e ispiratore, vero ambasciatore della Maison, sarà il motore di una boutique emblematica con risonanza internazionale, che sarà anche responsabile della promozione interna come incubatore per i nostri migliori talenti, professioni e modelli operativi di domani. Lavorando in collaborazione con i vari dipartimenti Cartier Svizzera, sarete responsabili delle performance commerciali e operative della boutique migliorando i principali indicatori di efficienza al dettaglio, sviluppando le competenze del team e ottimizzando i costi operativi. Come manager esperto ed esemplare, creerete un ambiente positivo e motivante che incoraggi le prestazioni, l'apprendimento e lo sviluppo personale. Gestire, formare e sviluppare il proprio team ti dà un senso di soddisfazione e dà a tutti l'opportunità di contribuire al nostro successo collettivo. Sviluppare i tuoi dipendenti. competenze e ottimizzare l'organizzazione della vita boutique in modo agile sono fondamentali per raggiungere e superare gli obiettivi prefissati. Creativo e proattivo, tradurrai la strategia e le ambizioni della boutique in priorità e obiettivi individuali e collettivi su base giornaliera. Come ambasciatore della boutique e della Maison, sarete un esemplare incarnazione dell'immagine e dei valori della Maison, che rappresenterete a tutti i suoi pubblici interni ed esterni, sia dentro che fuori dalla boutique. Sarete sempre disponibili, coinvolgenti e professionali e dimostrerete un eccellente livello di auto-consapevolezza. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di vendita e comunicazione, sarete sicuri che il cliente sia costantemente al centro delle vostre azioni a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione, nel rigoroso rispetto dell'immagine e della strategia della Maison. Garantito l'orchestrazione perfetta dell'esperienza del cliente, porterai a sopportare al massimo livello la nostra competenza in termini di ospitalità, esperienze personalizzate e programmazione degli eventi. Attentivo ai minimi dettagli, senza compromessi ma sempre esigente, assicurerai la qualità e l'arricchimento del nostro database e la sua attivazione strategica e tattica al servizio della nostra ambizione dichiarata: coinvolgere e sorprendere i nostri clienti di ieri, oggi e domani. La strategia del cliente, il piano d'azione del cliente e il programma annuale degli eventi della boutique sono pienamente utilizzati per migliorare il suo fascino e la sua influenza. In conformità con le politiche, le procedure e le direttive della nostra Maison, si supervisionerà l'attività e sarà responsabile della promozione di una cultura di efficienza e miglioramento continuo a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione. Tutte queste azioni convergono per servire un triplice obiettivo: la gestione perfetta dei flussi, l'ottimizzazione dell'esperienza dei dipendenti e la fluidità dell'esperienza del cliente. COME ESPERIRETE SUCCESSO CON NOI? Laurea magistrale o equivalente 10+ anni Esperienza al dettaglio nella gestione e nello sviluppo di grandi team Forte capacità di leadership, comunicazione e gestione con un tocco di classe per le aziende e i clienti. La conoscenza del settore dei beni di lusso e dei settori della gioielleria e dell'orologeria è un vantaggio. Forte capacità organizzative e visione a lungo termine. Forte competenza in cliente VIP che si occupa di cliente cliente. Cultura delle prestazioni e orientamento ai risultati. Eccellente capacità analitiche e comprensione delle leve di produttività al dettaglio. Esperienza in un ambiente internazionale. Flessibilità in tedesco e inglese. Forte abilità digitali e un interesse per le nuove tecnologie e media. Forte abilità interpersonali. Volontà di lavorare turni fine settimana e viaggi per la formazione, eventi clienti, ecc. descriptionByLocale.de: Referenzcode: JR128793 Die Geschichte von Cartier basiert auf Neugier und Leidenschaft. Seit mehr als 170 Jahren setzen wir auf einen mutigen Pioniergeist, der unsere Teams in allen Métiers von unseren Boutiquen bis zu unseren Werkstätten und Büros inspiriert. Unsere 10.000+ Kollegen aus mehr als 105 Nationen sind durch einen gemeinsamen, unabhängigen Geist und ein gemeinsames Engagement für Exzellenz vereint, indem sie unser Maison, sein Erbe durch die Verbreitung der Grenzen von Kreativität und Innovation kontinuierlich bereichern. WIE WIRD SIE EIN IMPACT KENNEN? Der Boutique Manager verwaltet und wird ein multikulturelles Team entwickeln. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erreichung unserer kommerziellen Ambitionen und bieten unseren Kunden unvergessliche Erfahrungen, die die Maison Signatur widerspiegeln, und gewährleisten die Exzellenz und die Einhaltung der Boutique-Operationen. Ein agiler und inspirierender Führer, ein wahrer Botschafter für das Maison, werden Sie die treibende Kraft hinter einer emblematischen Boutique mit internationaler Resonanz sein, die Sie auch für die Förderung intern als Brutkasten für unsere besten Talente, Berufe und Betriebsmodelle von morgen verantwortlich sein werden. IHRE VERANTWORTUNGEN In Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen Abteilungen der Cartier Schweiz sind Sie für die kommerzielle und operative Leistung der Boutique verantwortlich, indem Sie die wichtigsten Effizienzindikatoren für den Einzelhandel verbessern, die Fähigkeiten des Teams entwickeln und die Betriebskosten optimieren.Als erfahrener und vorbildlicher Manager schaffen Sie ein positives und motivierendes Umfeld, das Leistung, Lernen und persönliche Entwicklung fördert. Die Führung, Ausbildung und Weiterentwicklung Ihres Teams gibt Ihnen ein Gefühl der Erfüllung und gibt jedem die Möglichkeit, zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen. Die Entwicklung Ihrer Mitarbeiter, Fähigkeiten und die agile Organisation des Boutique-Lebens sind der Schlüssel zur Erreichung und Übertroffenheit der gesetzten Ziele. Kreativ und proaktiv übersetzen Sie die Strategie und Ambitionen der Boutique täglich in individuelle und kollektive Prioritäten und Ziele. Als Botschafter für die Boutique und das Maison werden Sie eine vorbildliche Verkörperung des Images und Wertes des Maison sein, die Sie allen internen und externen Zielgruppen, sowohl in und aus der Boutique, repräsentieren werden. Sie werden jederzeit zugänglich, engagiert und professionell sein und ein hervorragendes Selbstbewusstsein zeigen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Vertriebs- und Kommunikationsteams stellen Sie sicher, dass der Kunde auf allen Ebenen der Organisation ständig im Mittelpunkt Ihres Handelns steht, unter strikter Einhaltung des Images und der Strategie des Maison. Mit der Garantie der perfekten Orchestrierung des Kundenerlebnisses bringen Sie unsere Expertise in Sachen Gastfreundschaft, personalisierten Erlebnissen und Eventprogrammierung auf höchstem Niveau. Ganz im Detail, kompromisslos anspruchsvoll, aber zu jeder Zeit agil, sichern Sie die Qualität und Bereicherung unserer Datenbank und deren strategische und taktische Aktivierung im Dienste unseres genannten Anspruchs: unsere Kunden von gestern, heute und morgen zu engagieren und zu überraschen. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, dass die Kundenstrategie, der Kundenaktionsplan und das jährliche Eventprogramm der Boutique vollständig eingesetzt werden, um ihre Attraktivität und ihren Einfluss zu erhöhen. In Übereinstimmung mit den Richtlinien, Verfahren und Richtlinien unseres Maisons überwachen Sie die Abläufe und sind verantwortlich für die Förderung einer Kultur der Effizienz und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung auf allen Ebenen der Organisation. All diese Aktionen konvergieren, um einem dreifachen Ziel zu dienen: dem perfekten Management der Abläufe, der Optimierung der Mitarbeitererfahrung und der Fluidität des Kundenerlebnisses. descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence: JR128793 L'histoire de Cartier est fondée sur la curiosité et la passion. Depuis plus de 170 ans, nous avons adopté un esprit audacieux et pionnier qui continue d'inspirer nos équipes de tous les Métiers, de nos boutiques à nos ateliers et bureaux corporatifs. Nos 10 000 collègues de plus de 105 nationalités sont unis par un esprit indépendant partagé et un engagement en faveur de l'excellence, s'efforçant d'enrichir continuellement notre patrimoine de Maison en repoussant les frontières de la créativité et de l'innovation. Comment allez-vous avoir un impact ? Le directeur de la Boutique gère et développera une équipe multiculturelle. Vous serez responsable de la réalisation de nos ambitions commerciales et de fournir à nos clients des expériences inoubliables qui reflètent la signature de la Maison, tout en assurant l'excellence et la conformité des opérations de boutique. Leader agile et inspirant, véritable ambassadeur de la Maison, vous serez le moteur d'une boutique emblématique à résonance internationale, que vous serez également chargé de promouvoir en interne comme incubateur pour nos meilleurs talents, professions et modèles opérationnels de demain. Vos responsabilités En collaboration avec les différents départements de Cartier Suisse, vous serez responsable de la performance commerciale et opérationnelle de la boutique en améliorant les principaux indicateurs d'efficacité au détail, en développant les compétences de l'équipe et en optimisant les coûts opérationnels. En tant que gestionnaire expérimenté et exemplaire, vous créerez un environnement positif et motivant qui favorise la performance, l'apprentissage et le développement personnel. La gestion, la formation et le développement de votre équipe vous donnent un sentiment d'accomplissement et donnent à chacun la possibilité de contribuer à notre réussite collective. Développer les compétences de vos collaborateurs et optimiser l'organisation de la vie de boutique de manière agile sont les clés pour atteindre et dépasser les objectifs fixés. Créative et proactive, vous traduirez la stratégie et les ambitions de la boutique en priorités et objectifs individuels et collectifs au quotidien. En tant qu'ambassadeur de la boutique et de la Maison, vous serez une incarnation exemplaire de l'image et des valeurs de la Maison, que vous représenterez à tous ses publics internes et externes, tant à l'intérieur qu'à l'extérieur de la boutique. Vous serez accessible, engageant et professionnel en tout temps, et démontrer un excellent niveau de conscience de soi. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes de vente et de communication, vous veillerez à ce que le client soit constamment au cœur de vos actions à tous les niveaux de l'organisation, dans le strict respect de l'image et de la stratégie de la Maison. Garantir l'orchestration parfaite de l'expérience client, vous apportera au plus haut niveau notre expertise en matière d'hospitalité, d'expériences personnalisées et de programmation d'événements. Attentif aux moindres détails, exigeants sans compromis mais agiles en tout temps, vous assurerez la qualité et l'enrichissement de notre base de données et son activation stratégique et tactique au service de notre ambition déclarée : engager et surprendre nos clients d'hier, aujourd'hui et demain. Vous serez chargé de veiller à ce que la stratégie client, le plan d'action client et le programme annuel d'événements de la boutique soient pleinement déployés pour améliorer son attrait et son influence. Conformément aux politiques, procédures et directives de notre Maison, vous superviserez les opérations et serez chargé de promouvoir une culture d'efficacité et d'amélioration continue à tous les niveaux de l'organisation. Toutes ces actions convergent pour servir un triple objectif : la gestion parfaite des flux, l'optimisation de l'expérience des salariés et la fluidité de l'expérience client. Comment allez-vous nous convaincre? Maîtrise ou équivalent 10 ans et plus Expérience au détail dans la gestion et le développement de grandes équipes Fort leadership, communication et compétences en gestion avec un style pour les entreprises et les clients. La connaissance de l'industrie des articles de luxe et des secteurs de la joaillerie et de l'horlogerie est un atout. Des compétences organisationnelles solides et une vision à long terme. Une solide expertise dans la clientèle et le traitement des clients VIP. Culture de rendement et orientation des résultats. Excellentes compétences analytiques et compréhension des leviers de productivité de détail. Expérience dans un environnement international. Connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais. jobs.description: Reference code: JR128887 Founded in Florence in 1860, Panerai began as a workshop dedicated to precision instruments, shaped early on by a decisive partnership with the Royal Italian Navy. Designing instruments and tool watches for extreme conditions forged a mindset rooted in performance, innovation, and purpose. After joining the Richemont Group in 1997, Panerai gained international recognition for its distinctive DNA of Italian design and Swiss watchmaking expertise. Today, the Maison continues to create timepieces that push boundaries, translating its technical heritage into contemporary watchmaking for Modern Heroes—individuals driven by curiosity, courage, and the will to go further. We empower those who embrace challenges, value authenticity, and seek to leave a mark, together with a Maison that has never stopped evolving. Afin de renforcer notre département Watchmaking, nous sommes à la recherche d’un-e Responsable d’Ateliers VOTRE MISSION Au sein du département Watchmaking, vous assurez la gestion quotidienne de vos secteurs afin de garantir l’atteinte des objectifs de qualité, de coût, de délai et de sécurité en gérant votre équipe et les moyens de production. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS FAIRE LA DIFFERENCE ? Dans votre rôle de Responsable d’Ateliers, vous serez amené(e) : Être responsable de l’atteinte des objectifs (Sécurité, Qualité, Délai, Coût, Management) Définir, respecter et piloter les indicateurs et les budgets (efficience, absentéisme, non-qualité interne, frais de fonctionnement etc…). Suivre l’en-cours et la définition des plannings en collaboration avec l’ordonnancement. Piloter l’amélioration continue de son environnement de travail (excellence opérationnelle, résolution de problèmes) au travers de plans d’actions, chantier KAIZEN, projets DMAIC. Superviser l’approvisionnement et les stocks de consommables / outillages. Être garant des process et des standards Garantir la répétabilité, la standardisation et l’évolution des processus d’assemblage. Assurer l’exhaustivité, le maintien et le respect des standards. Contribuer à la définition des process et certifier que l’industrialisation des nouveautés est conforme aux besoins. Piloter les audits produits/process de son secteur en partenariat avec l’équipe qualité/industrialisation. Anticiper le renouvellement des moyens et les besoins en investissement. Garantir la sécurité des collaborateurs et la conformité des postes de travail. Garantir la propreté et l’entretien des outils de travail (postes, machines, espaces communs). Être animateur et facilitateur transverse Animer les instances de routines matinales (niveau atelier et transverse). Veiller à la bonne collaboration et au partage d’informations avec les autres secteurs/métiers. Gérer les sujets transverses et contribuer à leur résolution. Assurer le management de son équipe Être un relais de communication auprès de ses équipes et promouvoir les valeurs de la Maison. Être garant du respect de la réglementation, des orientations et des procédures de la marque et du groupe. Gérer le besoin en ressources, la formation et l’adéquation des compétences. Créer une dynamique d'équipe positive, une bonne cohésion et une culture d’amélioration continue au sein des équipes. Adresser et traiter les difficultés en collaboration avec le département RH. QUELLES SONT LES CLES DE VOTRE REUSSITE AU SEIN DE NOTRE MAISON ? Diplôme d’ingénieur ou d’un diplôme de technicien supérieur ou équivalent. Management d’équipes de production ou techniques. Connaissances horlogères (assemblage mouvements et emboitage). Lean, excellence opérationnelle. Connaissance ERP & MES. Bonnes connaissances des outils informatiques (pack office). langues : Français et anglais. 5 à 10 ans d'expérience dans un poste similaire dans l'industrie. Capacité d'adaptation aux contextes, aux personnes et aux changements. Remise en question et ouverture d’esprit. Bon communicateur et vulgarisateur. Volonté d’apprendre et culture de l’amélioration continue. Sens de l’organisation, de la rigueur, un esprit d’analyse et de synthèse Coordination transverse. QU'EST-CE QUI REND PANERAI UNIQUE ? Vous ferez partie d'une Maison dynamique où vos compétences et vos talents seront reconnus. Vous partagerez avec nous les mêmes valeurs telles que l'enrichissement des communautés, l'attitude bienveillante, l'amélioration continue et la responsabilité individuelle. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe multiculturelle et développerez une expérience internationale. Vous naviguerez avec nous sur le chemin du développement durable. Vous développerez et ferez progresser votre carrière grâce à des opportunités au sein de Maison et du groupe Richemont. VOTRE EXPERIENCE CANDIDAT 1ère étape – Après la sélection de votre candidature, notre équipe de recrutement vous contactera sous 2 semaines pour une prise de contact. 2ème étape – Entretien sur site avec le futur responsable et le département RH. 3ème étape – Entretien sur site avec deux autres responsables de département. Panerai est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances et veille à ce que tous les candidats soient traités de manière égale et équitable tout au long de notre processus de recrutement. Nous voulons offrir un environnement inclusif de respect mutuel et sommes déterminés à ce qu'aucun candidat ne subisse de discrimination fondée sur le sexe, l'expression de genre, le handicap, l'origine, les antécédents, les croyances religieuses ou l'orientation sexuelle ou toute autre mention protégé par la loi. Panerai recrute des « Modern Heroes » et reconnaît tous les types de talents et de singularités. Your next adventure starts at Panerai. We look forward to hearing from you. Essere un facilitatore trasversale e facilitatore Animate routine mattutine (laboratorio e livello trasversale). Assicurare una buona collaborazione e condivisione di informazioni con altri settori/imprese. Gestisci argomenti di taglio incrociato e contribuisci alla loro risoluzione. Conoscenza dell'orologeria (montaggi e goffratura). Magra, eccellenza operativa. Conoscenza ERP & MES. Buona conoscenza degli strumenti informatici (ufficio pacchetti). lingue: francese e inglese. da 5 a 10 anni di esperienza in una posizione simile nell'industria. Adattabilità a contesti, persone e cambiamenti. Domanda e mente aperta. Buon comunicatore e vulgarizzatore. La volontà di imparare e la cultura del miglioramento continuo. Senso di organizzazione, rigore, spirito di analisi e sintesi Coordinamento trasversale. Cosa c'è? Sarete parte di una Casa dinamica dove le vostre abilità e talenti saranno riconosciuti. Si lavorerà su un team multiculturale e sviluppare un'esperienza internazionale. Si naviga con noi sul percorso dello sviluppo sostenibile. Potrai sviluppare e far progredire la tua carriera attraverso opportunità all'interno di Maison e del Gruppo Richemont. jobs.title: Boutique Director
jobs.description: Reference code: JR128889 FOR THOSE WHO SEEK EXCELLENCE Join a community of dedicated professionals where excellence is both a given and a never-ending quest. Play your part in driving our collective success. YOUR ROLE We are seeking a Flagship Boutique Director for our Geneva boutique who will be responsible for the strategic development and operational excellence of this prestigious retail location. This role is responsible for defining and executing the sales strategy to drive long-term growth, enhance brand presence, and achieve commercial objectives for the boutique. You are a proactive leader with a deep understanding of the luxury watch market, have strong commercial acumen, and proven experience in leading a high performing team to elevate client experience. If you are energised by a fast-paced environment where vision, initiative and collaboration drive success, we invite you to join us. PLAYING YOUR PART You will lead strategic business development by creating and implementing a long-term plan for the Geneva Flagship, aligning with global objectives and brand vision. This includes identifying market opportunities, analysing performance and trends, and leading high-profile client events and brand activations to enhance visibility and attract high-value clientele, all while managing budgets to achieve sales and profitability targets. A key focus will be on high-value client business and relationship management. You will build and cultivate relationships with high-net-worth individuals, developing bespoke clientelling strategies to boost loyalty and average transaction value. You will ensure an exceptional, personalised client experience and act as a primary brand ambassador, fostering influential contacts. You are an inspirational leader and will develop a high-performing, client-centric team, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement through coaching and mentoring. You will promote a positive work environment that motivates the team to exceed targets. Finally, you will ensure flawless boutique operations and brand representation, maintaining the highest standards of visual merchandising, inventory, security, and compliance. Effective collaboration with internal departments is essential to ensure seamless operations and strategic alignment, upholding Vacheron Constantin's brand values and craftsmanship in all interactions. WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL? + 15 years proven experience in luxury retail management, with at least 10 years in a senior leadership role overseeing a flagship or high-value boutique,. Strong track record of driving significant sales growth, particularly in high-value segments, and achieving ambitious business objectives. Strategic thinker and leader, with excellent business acumen and ability to analyse retail performance with a results-orientated mindset. Humble, emotionally intelligent leader with a proven ability to inspire, develop and grow high performing teams. Strong clienteling expertise and a deep understanding of UHNW/HNW client expectations and relationship management. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with fluency in English and French required; additional languages are a plus. Passionate about luxury, craftsmanship, and client service with a profound knowledge of the luxury watch industry, Vacheron Constantin's heritage, and its product collections. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to evolving market conditions. HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? Vacheron Constantin celebrates 270 years as the world’s oldest watchmaker in continuous production since 1755. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, we operate a global retail network of nearly 200 points of sale across 36 countries. Every member of our exceptional global community of watchmakers, artisans and dedicated professionals share a common devotion to our exceptional heritage and a passion to trailblaze an even brighter future. If this sparks your imagination, we welcome your application. • Cerchiamo un Flagship Boutique Director per la nostra boutique di Ginevra che sarà responsabile dello sviluppo strategico e dell'eccellenza operativa di questo sito retail. Sei un leader proattivo con una profonda conoscenza del mercato degli orologi di lusso, hai una forte acumen commerciale e una comprovata esperienza nel guidare un team ad alte prestazioni a 142 esperienza cliente. Se sei alimentato da un ambiente veloce-ACed dove la visione, l'iniziativa e la collaborazione guidano il successo, ti invitiamo a unirti a noi. PIANTO VOSTRA PARTE Condurrà lo sviluppo strategico del business creando e implementando un piano a lungo termine per la bandiera di Ginevra, allineandosi con gli obiettivi globali e visione del marchio. Ciò include l'individuazione delle opportunità di mercato, l'analisi delle prestazioni e delle tendenze, e importanti eventi di alto profilo dei clienti e attivazioni di marca per migliorare la visibilità e attrarre alto valore di clientele, il tutto mentre la gestione dei bilanci per raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita e redditività. Un obiettivo chiave sarà quello di puntare su business e relazioni di alto valore dei clienti. Costruirete e coltiverete relazioni con individui di alto valore netto, sviluppando strategie bespoke di cui al punto 2.5 del presente documento per aumentare la fedeltà e il valore medio delle transazioni. Lei garantirà un'esperienza clienti eccezionale e personalizzata e agirà come ambasciatore principale del marchio, promuovendo contatti influenti. Lei è un leader ispiratore e svilupperà un team ad alte prestazioni, orientato al cliente, promuovendo una cultura di eccellenza e miglioramento continuo attraverso l'allenamento e l'ACEring. Promuoverà un ambiente di lavoro positivo che il team sarà al di sopra degli obiettivi. Infine, assicurerà operazioni boutique e rappresentazione del marchio impeccabili, mantenendo i più alti standard di visual merchandising, inventario, sicurezza e conformità. Una collaborazione efficace con i reparti interni è essenziale per garantire operazioni senza soluzione di continuità e allineamento strategico, sostenendo i valori del marchio e l'artigianalità di Vacheron Constantin in tutte le interazioni. COSA VOI FARE SUCCESSIVO? + 15 anni di esperienza comprovata nella gestione del retail di lusso, con almeno 10 anni di leadership senior ruolo di supervisore di una boutique di punta o di alto valore,. Forte record di guidare una crescita significativa delle vendite, in particolare nei segmenti di alto valore, e raggiungere ambiziosi obiettivi di business. Pensatore strategico e leader, con eccellente acumen di business e capacità di analizzare le prestazioni al dettaglio con una mentalità orientata ai risultati. Leader Humble, emotivamente intelligente con una comprovata capacità di ispirare, sviluppare e crescere team ad alte prestazioni. Forte esperienza di cliente di venatura e una profonda comprensione delle aspettative dei clienti UHNW / HNW e gestione dei rapporti. Eccellente comunicazione, interpersonale, e capacità di negoziazione, con fluenza in inglese e francese richiesto; ulteriori lingue sono un vantaggio. Appassionato di lusso, artigianato e servizio clienti con una profonda conoscenza del settore orologi di lusso, patrimonio di Vacheron Constantin, e le sue collezioni di prodotti. Capacità di lavorare in modo efficace in un ambiente veloce-racing, dinamico e adattarsi alle condizioni del mercato in evoluzione. COME VI teniamo SMILING? Vacheron Constantin celebra 270 anni come il mondo. orologiaio più antico in produzione continua dal 1755. Con sede a Ginevra, Svizzera, gestiamo una rete globale di vendita al dettaglio di quasi 200 punti vendita in 36 paesi. Ogni membro della nostra eccezionale comunità mondiale di orologiai, artigiani e professionisti dedicati condividono una valutazione comune al nostro patrimonio eccezionale e la passione per seguire un futuro ancora più luminoso. Se questo fa scattare la vostra immaginazione, accogliamo la vostra domanda. descriptionByLocale.de: Referenzcode: JR128889 FÜR DIE SEEK-AUSGABEN DER SICHERHEIT Treten Sie einer Gemeinschaft von engagierten Fachleuten bei, in der Exzellenz sowohl eine gegebene als auch eine nie endende Suche ist. Spielen Sie Ihren Teil dazu, unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg zu fördern. IHRE ROLLE Wir suchen einen Flagship Boutique Director für unsere Genfer Boutique, die für die strategische Entwicklung und operative Exzellenz dieses renommierten Einzelhandelsstandorts verantwortlich ist. Diese Rolle ist verantwortlich für die Definition und Umsetzung der Vertriebsstrategie, um langfristiges Wachstum zu fördern, die Markenpräsenz zu verbessern und kommerzielle Ziele für die Boutique zu erreichen. Sie sind ein proaktiver Marktführer mit einem tiefen Verständnis des Luxusuhrenmarktes, haben einen starken kommerziellen Hintergrund und haben Erfahrung in der Führung eines leistungsstarken Teams, um die Kundenerfahrung zu erhöhen. Wenn Sie von einem schnelllebigen Umfeld, in dem Vision, Initiative und Zusammenarbeit den Erfolg treiben, erregen, laden wir Sie ein, sich uns anzuschließen. SPIELEN SIE IHRER TEIL Sie leiten strategische Geschäftsentwicklung durch die Erstellung und Umsetzung eines langfristigen Plans für das Genfer Flagship, der sich an globalen Zielen und Markenvisionen orientiert. Dazu gehören die Identifizierung von Marktchancen, die Analyse von Leistung und Trends sowie die führende, hochkarätige Kunden-Events und Markenaktivierung, um die Sichtbarkeit zu erhöhen und hochwertige Kunden zu gewinnen, und zwar unter gleichzeitiger Verwaltung von Budgets, um Umsatz- und Rentabilitätsziele zu erreichen. Ein Schwerpunkt liegt dabei auf dem hochwertigen Kundengeschäft und dem Beziehungsmanagement. Sie werden Beziehungen zu net-wertvollen Personen aufbauen und pflegen, maßgeschneiderte Kundenstrategien entwickeln, um Loyalität und durchschnittlichen Transaktionswert zu steigern. Sie sorgen für eine außergewöhnliche, personalisierte Kundenerfahrung und agieren als primärer Markenbotschafter und fördern einflussreiche Kontakte. Sie sind ein inspirierender Führer und entwickeln ein leistungsstarkes, kundenorientiertes Team, das durch Coaching und Mentoring eine Kultur der Exzellenz und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung fördert. Sie fördern ein positives Arbeitsumfeld, das das Team motiviert, Ziele zu überschreiten. Schließlich stellen Sie eine einwandfreie Boutique-Operation und Markenrepräsentation sicher, wobei Sie höchste Standards für visuelle Merchandising, Inventar, Sicherheit und Compliance einhalten. Eine effektive Zusammenarbeit mit internen Abteilungen ist unerlässlich, um einen reibungslosen Betrieb und eine strategische Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten, wobei Vacheron Constantins Markenwerte und Handwerkskunst in allen Interaktionen gewahrt bleiben. WAS WIRD SIE SCHNELLEN? + 15 Jahre Erfahrung im Luxus-Einzelhandelsmanagement, mit mindestens 10 Jahren Führungsrolle als Vorzeige- oder hochwertige Boutique. Starke Erfolgsbilanz, die ein signifikantes Umsatzwachstum, insbesondere in hochwertigen Segmenten, und die Erreichung ehrgeiziger Geschäftsziele fördert. Strategischer Denker und Leader, mit exzellentem Geschäftssinn und Fähigkeit, die Einzelhandelsleistung mit ergebnisorientierter Denkweise zu analysieren. Humble, emotional intelligenter Leader mit nachgewiesener Fähigkeit, leistungsstarke Teams zu inspirieren, zu entwickeln und zu wachsen. Starke Kundenkompetenz und ein tiefes Verständnis der Erwartungen der UHNW/HNW-Kunden und des Beziehungsmanagements. Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation, zwischenmenschliche und Verhandlungskompetenzen, mit fließendem Englisch und Französisch erforderlich; zusätzliche Sprachen sind ein Plus. Leidenschaft für Luxus, Handwerkskunst und Kundenbetreuung mit einem fundierten Wissen über die Luxusuhrenindustrie, das Erbe von Vacheron Constantin und seine Produktkollektionen. Fähigkeit, in einem schnelllebigen, dynamischen Umfeld effektiv zu arbeiten und sich an die sich wandelnden Marktbedingungen anzupassen. WIE KÖNNEN WIR SIE SMILINGEN? Vacheron Constantin feiert 270 Jahre als weltweit ältester Uhrenhersteller in kontinuierlicher Produktion seit 1755. Mit Hauptsitz in Genf, Schweiz, betreiben wir ein weltweites Einzelhandelsnetzwerk mit fast 200 Verkaufsstellen in 36 Ländern. Jedes Mitglied unserer außergewöhnlichen globalen Gemeinschaft von Uhrmachern, Handwerkern und engagierten Fachleuten teilt eine gemeinsame Hingabe an unser außergewöhnliches Erbe und eine Leidenschaft, eine noch bessere Zukunft zu bahnen.Wenn dies Ihre Fantasie weckt, begrüßen wir Ihre Bewerbung.
