descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence: JR128889 POUR LES CEUX D'EXCELLENCE Rejoignez une communauté de professionnels dévoués où l'excellence est à la fois une quête donnée et une quête sans fin. Jouez votre rôle dans la conduite de notre succès collectif. Votre rôle Nous sommes à la recherche d'un directeur de la boutique Flagship pour notre boutique de Genève qui sera responsable du développement stratégique et de l'excellence opérationnelle de ce prestigieux site de vente au détail. Ce rôle est chargé de définir et d'exécuter la stratégie de vente pour stimuler la croissance à long terme, améliorer la présence de la marque et atteindre des objectifs commerciaux pour la boutique. Vous êtes un leader proactif avec une compréhension profonde du marché de l'horlogerie de luxe, avez une forte acuité commerciale, et l'expérience prouvée dans la conduite d'une équipe de haute performance pour élever l'expérience client. Si vous êtes sous l'impulsion d'un environnement rapide où la vision, l'initiative et la collaboration stimulent le succès, nous vous invitons à nous rejoindre. Jouer votre partie Vous dirigerez le développement stratégique des affaires en créant et en mettant en œuvre un plan à long terme pour le Flagship de Genève, en adéquation avec les objectifs mondiaux et la vision de la marque. Il s'agit notamment d'identifier les débouchés commerciaux, d'analyser les performances et les tendances, et de diriger des événements clients et des activations de marques de premier plan afin d'améliorer la visibilité et d'attirer une clientèle de grande valeur, tout en gérant les budgets pour atteindre les objectifs de ventes et de rentabilité. L'accent sera mis sur la gestion des affaires et des relations avec les clients de grande valeur. Vous établirez et cultiverez des relations avec des personnes de haute valeur nette, développant des stratégies clientelling sur mesure pour augmenter la fidélité et la valeur transactionnelle moyenne. Vous assurerez une expérience client exceptionnelle et personnalisée et agirez en tant qu'ambassadeur principal de la marque, favorisant des contacts influents. Vous êtes un chef de file inspirant et développerez une équipe hautement performante, centrée sur le client, favorisant une culture d'excellence et d'amélioration continue grâce au coaching et au mentorat. Vous favoriserez un environnement de travail positif qui motive l'équipe à dépasser les cibles. Enfin, vous assurerez des opérations de boutique impeccables et la représentation de la marque, en maintenant les plus hauts standards de merchandising visuel, d'inventaire, de sécurité et de conformité. Une collaboration efficace avec les services internes est essentielle pour assurer des opérations sans faille et un alignement stratégique, en maintenant les valeurs de marque et l'artisanat de Vacheron Constantin dans toutes les interactions. Qu'est-ce qui vous fera réussir? + 15 ans d'expérience prouvée dans la gestion de détail de luxe, avec au moins 10 ans dans un rôle de leadership supérieur supervision d'une boutique phare ou de grande valeur,. Forte expérience en matière de croissance significative des ventes, en particulier dans les segments à forte valeur ajoutée, et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux ambitieux. Penseur stratégique et leader, avec un excellent sens des affaires et la capacité d'analyser les performances de détail avec un état d'esprit axé sur les résultats. Humble, leader émotionnellement intelligent avec une capacité éprouvée d'inspirer, de développer et de développer des équipes performantes. Une expertise cliente solide et une compréhension approfondie des attentes des clients et de la gestion de leurs relations. Excellentes compétences en communication, relations interpersonnelles et en négociation, avec une maîtrise du français et de l'anglais requise; les langues supplémentaires sont un plus. Passionné de luxe, d'artisanat et de service à la clientèle avec une connaissance approfondie de l'industrie horlogère de luxe, du patrimoine de Vacheron Constantin et de ses collections de produits. Capacité à travailler efficacement dans un environnement dynamique et rapide et à s'adapter aux conditions changeantes du marché. Comment tu te sens mal ? Vacheron Constantin célèbre 270 ans comme le plus ancien horloger du monde en production continue depuis 1755. Basé à Genève, en Suisse, nous exploitons un réseau mondial de détail de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté mondiale exceptionnelle d'horlogers, d'artisans et de professionnels dévoués partagent une dévotion commune à notre patrimoine exceptionnel et une passion pour faire briller un avenir encore plus brillant. Si cela suscite votre imagination, nous accueillons votre candidature. jobs.title: Finance Senior Product Owner
jobs.description: Reference code: JR128927 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. “Do you enjoy orchestrating evolutions towards operational efficiency and future-ready employee experiences? Are you eager to use the latest technologies and participate in the build of constantly improving solutions? If yes, then apply and join us. A team aiming at accelerating business through technology is waiting for you to step up and have an impact on our Group transformation.” YOUR MISSION: As part of Group Platforms' department, Richemont is looking to further strengthen its dynamic Product Management team structured around key capabilities that support our Maisons' value chain strategy. In this context, we are hiring a Finance Senior Product Owner to strategically lead and transform Finance Products with strong interdependencies across various Product Areas. The focus area will be strategic oversight and continuous enhancement of integrated and performing Finance and Accounting solutions across Richemont entities. The Finance Senior Product Owner will ensure full alignment with Group Finance business priorities, complying with business rules and processes defined by the Business Process Owners (BPOs). The Finance Senior Product Owner plays a pivotal role in supporting and driving the Group Finance strategy by leading the development of valuable products and fostering product transformation. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? You will lead Product transformation, drive strategic initiatives and foster innovation for the Finance & Accounting Product. This includes strategic topics such as finance simplification, e-invoicing, accounting capabilities, M&A integration, and managing critical interdependencies with other business areas. You will act as the strategic interface between the Group Product Office and the Finance Function, ensuring deep understanding and alignment of strategic objectives for the Product You will build and maintain comprehensive roadmaps You will implement consistent Product ways of working (e.g., ceremonies, demand management, fixed capacity models), fostering a mature and efficient product development culture You will proactively steer risks, issues, and related mitigation plans in close collaboration with the Finance function You will regularly communicate and articulate the strategic evolution and impact of the Finance & Accounting Product, demonstrating their contribution to the overarching business vision, particularly to senior stakeholders. You will strategically partner with relevant stakeholders to proactively discover and understand their needs, translating these into strategic product initiatives and requirements for Finance & Accounting Product You will lead the prioritization of demands in close collaboration with the Group Finance organization (Business Process Owners, Center of Excellence, Working Group), ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and resource capacity. You will oversee the strategic maintenance and refinement of the product backlog, ensuring it reflects evolving business needs, maximizes business value and ROI, and aligns with available capacity. You will lead and guide the technical team working on Finance & Accounting solutions, ensuring the strategic product vision is translated effectively into implementation and delivered with high quality. You will proactively facilitate and manage interdependencies with cross-functional teams across Product Areas, ensuring seamless integration and alignment You will champion change management initiatives, fostering adoption and dissemination of comprehensive product training, support tools, and documentation You will drive continuous product improvement initiatives, leveraging user feedback, benefits realization, adoption rates, and key metrics/KPIs to ensure optimal business outcomes and strategic alignment. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Excellence is a top priority for our teams. In this role you have the opportunity to play a pivotal role in major global strategic initiatives for the Richemont Group and its Maisons. Your passion for moving forward, achieving and leading change will find the perfect context within the team. Innovation is at the heart of what we do, joining us means being exposed to latest trends and technologies. DIMENSIONS 10-15 years’ experience in projects/products management, including multinational and innovative environments, in the operational finance or consulting area. B.Sc. or MSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or a Master’s degree in Business Administration. Experience of SAP Financial solutions. Practical experience in operational finance roles (e.g., controlling, accounting) is required Audit / consulting experience in a Big4 or similar firms is a plus. Excellent Business acumen, strong customer orientation. Successful experience in facilitation, change management, and cross-business areas problem solving. Knowledge of collaborative solutions for product management and Agile frameworks/methodologies is a plus. Experience in implementing PO techniques (e.g. customer journeys, personas, discovery, agile ceremonies) is a plus. Ability to anticipate change through technologies. Strong analytical, problem-solving, negotiation and organizational skills. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, good listener. Ability to present ideas in a user-friendly or executive language at different management levels up to C-Level, motivate and inspire teams with client vision. Experience working in a team-oriented and collaborative environment. jobs.description: Reference code: JR129049 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. CONTEXTE Au sein de notre Manufacture Joaillère située au Locle, notre Département des Ressources Humaines joue un rôle stratégique dans l'accompagnement et le développement de nos talents. Dans un contexte de transformation et d'amélioration continue, nous recherchons pour un CDM de 12 mois un/e Chargé/e de Projet RH dynamique et engagé/e pour renforcer nos équipes. CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif. Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique. Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles. Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité. Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance. Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution. A travers son histoire, Cartier s'est démarqué du fait de l'engagement de femmes et d'hommes singuliers. A ce titre, notre Maison offre à toutes et tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi, sans distinction notamment de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ? jobs.description: Reference code: JR129217 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT The Richemont Procurement department is responsible for sourcing and purchasing the goods and services that enable our group's operations. We're committed to driving efficiency, sustainability, and innovation in every purchase we make. Our key initiatives include: Strengthening indirect procurement across the group through our P2P Project, ensuring seamless and efficient processes. Embracing data-driven decision-making to optimize every purchase and unlock new opportunities. Digitalizing end-to-end procurement with our eSHOP platform. You will have the opportunity to make a real difference by contributing to the future of procurement, gain valuable experience in data and process management, and discover the world of luxury by working within a leading luxury group. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? This is a unique opportunity to explore the worlds of data and process within our dynamic Procurement Excellence team. As Procurement Excellence Intern, you will: Work closely with Procurement and Technology experts to build the future of digital Procurement at Richemont, contributing to a valuable experience. Contribute to the implementation of digital applications. You will participate in tool selection, design, testing, training and communication. Promote the use of our dashboards and data visualization tools, helping to communicate insights and drive informed decision-making. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You're currently pursuing a Master's degree in Commerce or Engineering. You're analytical and enjoy finding innovative solutions to technical and business challenges. You are a technology enthusiast and are curious about the world of data and digital tools. You can collaborate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders, demonstrating strong communication skills throughout. You thrive in dynamic environments, adapting your skills across diverse business and technical landscapes. You're proficient in English. Proficiency in French is appreciated. You’re ready to join our team starting September 2026. You have an internship agreement with your school/university WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory interview. 2. The next step from there would be a second interview with the Procurement Data Project Manager. 3. As a final step, you will have a last interview with the Procurement Senior Process Manager. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR129217 Richemont possiede alcuni dei principali prodotti di lusso Maisons, con particolare forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una fiera tradizione di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maisons. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo a innovazione e progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in linea con i nostri valori Maisons., attraverso un processo di continua creatività. CONTEXT Il dipartimento Procurement di Richemont è responsabile dell'approvvigionamento e dell'acquisto di beni e servizi che consentono l'operatività del nostro gruppo. Ci impegniamo a guidare l'efficienza, la sostenibilità e l'innovazione in ogni acquisto che facciamo. Le nostre iniziative chiave includono: Rafforzare l'approvvigionamento indiretto attraverso il nostro progetto P2P, garantendo processi senza soluzione di continuità ed efficienti. Emigrare il processo decisionale basato sui dati per ottimizzare ogni acquisto e sbloccare nuove opportunità. Digitalizzazione degli appalti end-to-end con la nostra piattaforma eSHOP. Avrete l'opportunità di fare la differenza contribuendo al futuro dell'approvvigionamento, acquisire una preziosa esperienza nella gestione dei dati e dei processi e scoprire il mondo del lusso lavorando all'interno di un gruppo leader di lusso. COME FATE UN IMPATTO? Questa è un'occasione unica per esplorare i mondi dei dati e dei processi all'interno del nostro team dinamico di Procurement Excellence. Come Procurement Excellence Stagista, lavorerete a stretto contatto con gli esperti di Procurement e Technology per costruire il futuro dell'Appaltamento digitale a Richemont, contribuendo a un'esperienza preziosa. Contribuisci all'implementazione delle applicazioni digitali. Parteciperai alla selezione degli strumenti, alla progettazione, alla sperimentazione, alla formazione e alla comunicazione. Fai uso dei nostri dashboard e degli strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati, aiutandoti a comunicare informazioni e a guidare un processo decisionale informato. COME SI ESPREDE CON NOI? Attualmente stai perseguendo un Master in Commercio o Ingegneria. Sei analitico e godi di trovare soluzioni innovative alle sfide tecniche e aziendali. Sei un appassionato di tecnologia e sei curioso del mondo dei dati e degli strumenti digitali. Puoi collaborare efficacemente con diversi team e stakeholder, dimostrando forti capacità comunicative in tutto. Promuovi in ambienti dinamici, adattando le tue competenze in diversi paesaggi aziendali e tecnici. Sei esperto in inglese. La professionalità in francese è apprezzata. Sei pronto a entrare nel nostro team a partire dal settembre 2026. Hai un accordo di stage con la tua scuola / università CHE FACCIA IL NOSTRO GRUPPO DIVERSO? La nostra vera potenza non sta nelle nostre somiglianze, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e competenze umane, così come nella nostra specifica capacità di promuovere il potenziale non sfruttato. - Noi apprezziamo la libertà, la collegialità, la lealtà e la solidarietà. - Noi incoraggiamo l'empatia, la curiosità, il coraggio, l'umiltà e l'integrità. - Ci preoccupiamo per il mondo in cui viviamo. IL TUO GIORNALE CON NOI 1. Se la tua candidatura è selezionata, ti contatteremo il più presto possibile per un'intervista introduttiva informale. 2. Il passo successivo da lì sarebbe una seconda intervista con il Responsabile del Progetto Dati di Appalti. 3. Come ultimo passo, avrete un'ultima intervista con il Senior Process Manager degli appalti. Alla fine, speriamo, possiamo darvi qualche buona notizia e salutarvi come nostro nuovo collega! #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Simili Jobs Digital Content Stagista Salva Plan-Les-Ouates, Svizzera Piaget Business Analytics Stagista Salva Bellevue, Svizzera Richemont Supply Chain Stagista Salva Bellevue, Svizzera Richemont

jobs.description: Reference code: JR129325 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. CONTEXTE Au sein de l’atelier de Prototypes, vous réalisez les prototypes et les éléments de test des composants habillage et procédez aux ajustements nécessaires, en amont de la fabrication. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Vous collaborez étroitement avec le bureau d'études pour évaluer les plans et la faisabilité des dossiers techniques Vous définissez l’outillage nécessaire et préparez les postes Vous gérez la fabrication des prototypes à l’aide de machines à commande numériques 5 axes et de machines conventionnelles Vous prenez en charge le contrôle dimensionnel des pièces Vous collaborez avec d’autres départements internes et vous contribuez à l’amélioration continue du département QUELLES SONT LES CLES DE VOTRE REUSSITE AU SEIN DE NOTRE MAISON ? Au bénéfice d’un CFC de micro-mécanicien avec une orientation faiseur d’étampes, ou équivalent, vous justifiez d’une expérience réussie dans la fabrication des prototypes à l’aide de machines à commandes numériques 5 axes et de machines conventionnelles. Des compétences en décolletage sont un atout. Vous maîtrisez le logiciel CREO et êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques usuels. Vous avez également des connaissances dans la lecture de plans et dans la manipulation des instruments de mesure et de contrôle (calibre, micromètre, comparateur, projecteur, etc.). Des connaissances en bijouterie-joaillerie sont un plus, ainsi que la maîtrise du soudage au chalumeau et laser. Vous êtes une personne motivée, dynamique, polyvalente, ayant un bon esprit d’équipe et appréciez travailler dans un environnement de travail agile. QU’AVONS-NOUS A VOUS OFFRIR ? Nous créons un environnement positif où nous sommes fiers d'employer des talents issus de différents milieux, expériences et identités. Nous sommes convaincus que lorsque la diversité et l'inclusion sont pleinement acceptées et renforcées, la créativité et le savoir émergent pour atteindre l'excellence. VOTRE PARCOURS CANDIDAT AVEC NOUS Si votre candidature correspond à ce que l'on recherche, vous aurez un premier contact téléphonique au plus vite avec notre équipe RH. Par la suite, vous accèderez à un entretien individuel avec notre Responsable Prototypes ainsi que notre HR Business Partner. Tout au long de son histoire, la Maison Cartier s'est distinguée par l'engagement de chacun de ses employés. Nous sommes convaincus que lorsque la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion sont pleinement assumées, l'innovation et la créativité émergent pour offrir l'excellence. Quelles que soient les différences visibles ou invisibles, nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où chacun a une chance égale de réaliser son plein potentiel, d'être entendu et de se sentir valorisé. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR129325 La storia di Cartier è fondata su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbiamo abbracciato uno spirito coraggioso e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team di tutte le Professioni dalle nostre boutique ai nostri laboratori e uffici aziendali. I nostri 10.000+ colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e dall'impegno per l'eccellenza, colpendo a rinnovare continuamente la nostra Maison CONTEXT Nel laboratorio Prototipi, si eseguono i prototipi e gli elementi di prova dei componenti di condimento e fare le regolazioni necessarie, prima della produzione. Come hai un'infezione? Si lavora a stretto contatto con l'ufficio di progettazione per valutare i piani e la fattibilità dei file tecnici Definire gli strumenti necessari e preparare le stazioni Si gestisce la produzione di prototipi utilizzando macchine di controllo digitali a 5 assi e macchine convenzionali Supporti il controllo dimensionale delle parti Collaborate con altri dipartimenti interni e contribuite al continuo miglioramento del dipartimento, quali sono le regole della vostra sopravvivenza nella nostra casa? A beneficio di un CFC micro-meccanico con orientamento make-up o equivalente, si giustifica un'esperienza di successo nella produzione di prototipi utilizzando macchine di controllo digitali a 5 assi e macchine convenzionali. Le capacità di arrampicata sono una risorsa. Si padroneggia il software CREO e si sente a proprio agio con i soliti strumenti IT. Hai anche conoscenze nella lettura dei piani e nella manipolazione di strumenti di misura e di controllo (calibrazione, micrometro, comparatore, proiettore, ecc.). La conoscenza dei gioielli è un plus, così come la padronanza della saldatura con torcia e laser. Sei una persona motivata, dinamica, versatile con un buon spirito di squadra e godere di lavorare in un ambiente di lavoro agile. Cosa ti abbiamo fatto? Creiamo un ambiente positivo in cui siamo orgogliosi di impiegare talenti da diversi background, esperienze e identità. Siamo convinti che quando la diversità e l'inclusione sono pienamente accettate e rafforzate, la creatività e la conoscenza emergono per raggiungere l'eccellenza. Se la tua applicazione corrisponde a quello che stiamo cercando, riceverai una prima telefonata il prima possibile con il nostro team HR. Successivamente, si accederà a un'intervista individuale con il nostro Prototypes Manager e il nostro HR Business Partner. Nel corso della sua storia, Maison Cartier si è distinta dall'impegno di ciascuno dei suoi dipendenti. Siamo convinti che quando la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione sono pienamente assunte, l'innovazione e la creatività emergono per offrire l'eccellenza. Qualunque siano le differenze visibili o invisibili, ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente in cui ognuno ha la stessa possibilità di realizzare il proprio pieno potenziale, di essere ascoltato e di sentirsi valorizzato. Climbing skills are an asset. You master the CREO software and are comfortable with the usual IT tools. Knowledge of jewellery is a plus, as well as the mastery of welding with torch and laser. Subsequently, you will access an individual interview with our Prototypes Manager and our HR Business Partner. Throughout its history, Maison Cartier has distinguished itself by the commitment of each of its employees. Seit mehr als 170 Jahren haben wir einen mutigen, bahnbrechenden Geist angenommen, der unsere Teams in allen Berufen unserer Boutiquen zu unseren Werkstätten und Unternehmensbüros weiter inspiriert. Sie definieren die erforderlichen Werkzeuge und bereiten die Stationen vor Sie verwalten die Herstellung von Prototypen mit 5-Achsen-Digital-Steuermaschinen und konventionellen Maschinen Sie unterstützen die Dimensionskontrolle von Teilen Sie kooperieren mit anderen internen Abteilungen und tragen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Abteilung bei, was sind die Knaben von Ihnen in unserem Haus? Zum Nutzen eines mikromechanischen FCKW mit einer Make-up- oder äquivalenten Ausrichtung rechtfertigen Sie eine erfolgreiche Erfahrung bei der Herstellung von Prototypen mit 5-Achsen-Digital-Steuermaschinen und konventionellen Maschinen. Kletterfähigkeiten sind ein Gut. Sie beherrschen die CREO-Software und sind mit den üblichen IT-Tools komfortabel. Sie haben auch Kenntnisse in der Lesung von Plänen und in der Manipulation von Messgeräten (Kalibrierung, Mikrometer, Komparator, Projektor, etc.). Das Wissen um Schmuck ist ein Plus, sowie die Meisterschaft des Schweißens mit Brenner und Laser. Sie sind ein motivierter, dynamischer, vielseitiger Mensch mit einem guten Teamgeist und genießen die Arbeit in einem agilen Arbeitsumfeld. Was haben wir zu dir gemacht? Wir schaffen ein positives Umfeld, in dem wir stolz sind, Talente aus unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Erfahrungen und Identitäten einzusetzen. Wir sind überzeugt, dass, wenn Vielfalt und Inklusion vollständig akzeptiert und gestärkt werden, Kreativität und Wissen entstehen, um Exzellenz zu erreichen. Wenn Ihre Bewerbung mit dem übereinstimmt, was wir suchen, erhalten Sie schnellstmöglich einen ersten Anruf mit unserem Personalteam. Anschließend erhalten Sie ein individuelles Interview mit unserem Prototypes Manager und unserem HR Business Partner. Während seiner Geschichte hat sich Maison Cartier durch das Engagement jedes seiner Mitarbeiter ausgezeichnet. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass, wenn Vielfalt, Gerechtigkeit und Integration vollständig angenommen werden, Innovation und Kreativität entstehen, um Exzellenz zu bieten. Was auch immer die sichtbaren oder unsichtbaren Unterschiede, wir sind verpflichtet, eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der jeder eine gleiche Chance hat, ihr volles Potenzial zu verwirklichen, zu hören und zu fühlen geschätzt. jobs.description: Reference code: JR129291 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Recruitment Manage the end-to-end recruitment of interns across our various sites in Switzerland, covering all business functions. Partner closely with hiring managers from role briefing through candidate selection, interviews, offers, and hiring. Identify and leverage the most effective sourcing channels based on business needs, location, and hiring volume. Define relevant selection criteria tailored to each area of recruitment. Analyze recurring hiring needs and anticipate recruitment cycles across business functions to build proactive talent pipelines. Early Career Coordinate and represent the Group at career fairs, networking events, and employer branding initiatives with partner schools and universities. Participate in end-of-internship evaluations and ensure effective follow-up with early-career candidates. Design and continuously enhance the candidate experience for early talent before, during, and after their internship. Contribute to the continuous improvement and implementation of the Group’s Early Career strategy and related initiatives. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Final year Bachelor or Master's student in HR, Business Administration or related. Currently have an internship agreement (convention) with your school or university. Proficiency in office tools, specifically handling datas with Excel and comfortable with Powerpoint (MS Office Suite). A first experience in HR, ideally in recruitment or project management, is a strong asset. Knowledge of an ATS, ideally Workday, is a plus Fluent in French and English (spoken and written). Available for a 6-month internship starting in September 2026 . WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, you will be invited for a first round of interview with the Talent Acquisition Partners, then a second round with the Swiss Early Careers & Campus Manager. Finally you will meet with the Head of Swiss Talent. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Talent Acquisition & Management Intern Save Geneva, Switzerland Van Cleef & Arpels Group Employer Branding and University Relations Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont - Business Analyst Intern, TimeVallée Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Procurement Category Manager
jobs.description: Reference code: JR129333 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Richemont is looking for a Procurement Category Manager dedicated to Corporate Services categories. Reporting to the Category Director Corporate & Operations, you will be responsible for developing and driving comprehensive global category strategies as well as supporting our Central Functions, Maisons and Regions Procurement community to optimize sourcing and supplier management for your categories. This role is instrumental in ensuring optimal value creation and cost efficiency, through category expertise, market knowledge, strong internal and external relationship management. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As a Procurement Category Manager, your main responsibilities will include: Global Category Strategy Development & Leadership: Develop, define, and implement comprehensive global category strategies aligned with Richemont’s (Group/Maisons/Regions) business needs & Objectives. Lead the execution and roll-out of category strategies across various Maisons and regions through business partnering, stakeholders enrolling and influencing. Drive value creation, cost reduction, and innovation across the assigned categories through deep market knowledge, category expertise, and a forward-thinking approach. Sourcing, Market Intelligence & Supplier Relationship Management Manage complex tenders, negotiations, and contract management for global and central agreements, ensuring favorable terms and conditions. Conduct market analysis and competitive intelligence for the assigned category. Develop and maintain comprehensive knowledge of the global supplier landscape, identifying strategic partners and emerging suppliers. Develop and implement strategic SRM (Supplier Relationship Management) programs for key suppliers, fostering long-term partnerships. Lead regular strategic business reviews with critical suppliers to drive continuous improvement and innovation. Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration: Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key internal stakeholders across functions, Maisons and Regions to understand business needs and ensure category strategies support overall business goals. Act as a trusted advisor to internal clients on procurement best practices, market insights, and supplier capabilities. Support central functions sourcing needs for central spend & global initiatives. Performance Management & Compliance: Monitor category performance, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and report on progress against strategic objectives and financial targets. Ensure compliance with internal procurement policies and sourcing process rules, ethical guidelines, and external regulations. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You are an established and versatile procurement professional with 7+ years of experience in a structured environment, with strong category management skills. Experience and knowledge within the Corporate services area, ideally Security and Facilities Management categories, is an advantage. You have: Strategic Acumen: Demonstrated ability to develop and implement global category strategies, driving significant value creation, cost optimization, and innovation. RFPs, Negotiation & Contract Management: Excellent RFP, negotiation and contract management abilities, with a proven track record of securing advantageous terms. Stakeholder Management: Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, capable of engaging effectively with diverse internal and external partners at all levels, including senior leadership. Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and creative solutions. Adaptability: Demonstrated learning agility and adaptability to evolving market conditions and business needs. Autonomy & Drive: Demonstrated entrepreneurial mindset, with a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, getting the buy-in from stakeholders and leading execution. Proactive, results-oriented, and able to work autonomously in a fast-paced, international, and demanding environment. Sustainability Focus: A strong commitment to responsible sourcing and integrating sustainability principles into procurement practices. Academics: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Business, Marketing and Professional certifications. Languages: Fluent in both English and French. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Procurement Category Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Piaget Director, Strategic Sourcing Save New York, United States of America Richemont Regional Marketing & Merchandising, Category Manager Save Singapore, Singapore Cartier

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR129333 Richemont possiede alcuni dei principali prodotti di lusso Maisons, con particolare forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una orgogliosa tradizione di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maisons. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell'innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che siano in linea con i nostri valori Maisons., attraverso un processo di continua creatività. Richemont è alla ricerca di un Procurement Category Manager dedicato alle categorie Corporate Services. In relazione al Direttore di Categoria Corporate & Operations, sarà responsabile dello sviluppo e della guida di strategie globali globali complete, oltre a sostenere la nostra comunità di Appaltori di Funzioni Centrali, Maisons e Regioni per ottimizzare l'approvvigionamento e la gestione dei fornitori per le vostre categorie. Questo ruolo è determinante per garantire la creazione di valori ottimali e l'efficienza dei costi, attraverso competenze di categoria, conoscenze di mercato, una forte gestione delle relazioni interne ed esterne. Come responsabile delle categorie di appalti, le vostre principali responsabilità comprendono: Sviluppo e leadership di strategie globali di categoria: sviluppare, definire e attuare strategie globali globali di categoria allineate con le esigenze e gli obiettivi del settore (gruppo/maison/regions). Guidare la creazione di valore, riduzione dei costi e innovazione attraverso le categorie assegnate attraverso la conoscenza profonda del mercato, competenze di categoria, e un approccio lungimirante. Sourcing, Market Intelligence & Supplier Relationship Management Gestire gare complesse, negoziati e gestione dei contratti per accordi globali e centrali, garantendo condizioni favorevoli. Condurre analisi di mercato e intelligenza competitiva per la categoria assegnata. Sviluppare e mantenere una conoscenza completa del panorama globale dei fornitori, identificare partner strategici e fornitori emergenti. Sviluppare e implementare programmi strategici di SRM (Supplier Relationship Management) per i principali fornitori, promuovendo partnership a lungo termine. Leader regolari valutazioni strategiche con fornitori critici per guidare il miglioramento continuo e l'innovazione. Stakeholder Engagement & Waldation: Costruire e mantenere forti relazioni collaborative con i principali stakeholder interni per tutte le funzioni, Maisons e Regioni per comprendere le esigenze aziendali e garantire strategie di categoria supportano obiettivi aziendali generali. Agire come consulente fidato dei clienti interni sulle migliori pratiche di approvvigionamento, sulle informazioni di mercato e sulle capacità dei fornitori. Sostenere le funzioni centrali per soddisfare le esigenze di spesa centrale e iniziative globali. Gestione delle prestazioni e conformità: monitorare le prestazioni della categoria, monitorare gli indicatori chiave di prestazione (KPI) e riferire sui progressi compiuti contro gli obiettivi strategici e gli obiettivi finanziari. Garantire il rispetto delle politiche interne in materia di appalti e le norme di processo di approvvigionamento, linee guida etiche e regolamenti esterni. Siete un professionista di approvvigionamento stabilito e di versatile con 7+ anni di esperienza in un ambiente strutturato, con forti competenze di gestione di categoria. L'esperienza e la conoscenza all'interno del settore servizi aziendali, idealmente le categorie di gestione di sicurezza e strutture, è un vantaggio. Hai: Acumen strategico: capacità dimostrativa di sviluppare e implementare strategie di categoria globale, guidando la creazione di valore significativo, ottimizzazione dei costi e innovazione. RFP, Gestione dei Trattati e dei Contract: Ottime capacità di RFP, negoziazione e gestione dei contratti, con un comprovata esperienza di garanzia di termini vantaggiosi. Gestione delle parti interessate: una forte comunicazione, influenza e capacità di gestione delle parti interessate, in grado di impegnarsi efficacemente con diversi partner interni ed esterni a tutti i livelli, compresa la leadership senior. Capacità analitiche e di soluzione dei problemi: capacità di analisi e risoluzione dei problemi forti, con la capacità di tradurre dati complessi in intuizioni e soluzioni creative attuabili. Adattabilità: agilità e adattabilità all'evoluzione delle condizioni di mercato e delle esigenze aziendali. Autonomy & Drive: mentalità imprenditoriale demonstrata, con un approccio proattivo all'identificazione delle opportunità, all'acquisizione del buy-in da parte degli stakeholder e all'esecuzione leader. Proattivo, orientato ai risultati e in grado di lavorare autonomamente in un ambiente veloce, internazionale ed esigente. Sostenibilità Focus: un forte impegno per un approvvigionamento responsabile e l'integrazione dei principi di sostenibilità nelle pratiche di approvvigionamento. Accademici: Laurea in Apprendimento, Supply Chain, Business, Marketing e certificazioni professionali. Lingue: Fluente sia in inglese che in francese. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Simili Lavori Strategic Sourcing Manager, Store Construction Save New York, Stati Uniti d'America Richemont Regional Marketing & Merchandising, Category Manager Save Singapore, Singapore Cartier Director, Strategic Sourcing Save New York, Stati Uniti d'America Richemont

descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence: JR129333 Richemont possède quelques-uns des principaux produits de luxe du monde, avec des atouts particuliers en bijoux, montres fines et accessoires haut de gamme. Chaque Maison représente une fière tradition de style, de qualité et d'artisanat et Richemont cherche à préserver le patrimoine et l'identité de chacune de ses Maisons. Dans le même temps, nous sommes engagés dans l'innovation et la conception de nouveaux produits qui sont conformes à nos valeurs Maisons, à travers un processus de créativité continue. Richemont est à la recherche d'un gestionnaire de catégorie d'approvisionnement dédié aux catégories des Services ministériels. Sous l'autorité du directeur de catégorie Corporate & Operations, vous serez responsable de l'élaboration et de la conduite de stratégies globales complètes de catégorie ainsi que du soutien de notre communauté d'approvisionnement des fonctions centrales, des maisons et des régions pour optimiser l'approvisionnement et la gestion des fournisseurs pour vos catégories. Ce rôle est essentiel pour assurer une création de valeur optimale et une rentabilité optimale, grâce à l'expertise de catégorie, aux connaissances du marché, à une gestion solide des relations internes et externes. Comment allez-vous avoir un impact ? En tant que gestionnaire de catégorie d'approvisionnement, vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes : Développement et leadership de la stratégie de catégorie mondiale : Élaborer, définir et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies globales complètes de catégorie alignées sur les besoins et les objectifs opérationnels de Richemonts (Groupe/Maisons/Régions). Diriger l'exécution et le déploiement de stratégies de catégorie dans diverses Maisons et régions par le biais de partenariats d'affaires, d'intervenants qui s'inscrivent et influencent. Favoriser la création de valeur, la réduction des coûts et l'innovation dans toutes les catégories, grâce à une connaissance approfondie du marché, à une expertise de catégorie et à une approche prospective. Sourcing, Market Intelligence & Supplier Relationship Management Gérer les appels d'offres complexes, les négociations et la gestion des contrats pour les accords mondiaux et centraux, en assurant des conditions favorables. Effectuer des analyses de marché et des renseignements concurrentiels pour la catégorie attribuée. Développer et maintenir une connaissance approfondie du paysage mondial des fournisseurs, en identifiant les partenaires stratégiques et les nouveaux fournisseurs. Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des programmes stratégiques de GRS (gestion des relations avec les fournisseurs) à l'intention des fournisseurs clés, en favorisant les partenariats à long terme. Diriger régulièrement les examens stratégiques des entreprises avec les fournisseurs essentiels pour favoriser l'amélioration continue et l'innovation. Engagement et collaboration des intervenants : établir et maintenir des relations solides et collaboratives avec les principaux intervenants internes dans toutes les fonctions, Maisons et Régions, afin de comprendre les besoins opérationnels et de s'assurer que les stratégies de catégorie appuient les objectifs opérationnels généraux. Agir comme conseiller de confiance auprès des clients internes sur les pratiques exemplaires en matière d'approvisionnement, les perspectives du marché et les capacités des fournisseurs. Soutenir les fonctions centrales besoins d'approvisionnement pour les dépenses centrales et les initiatives mondiales. Gestion du rendement et conformité : Surveiller le rendement de la catégorie, suivre les indicateurs de rendement clés et rendre compte des progrès réalisés par rapport aux objectifs stratégiques et aux objectifs financiers. Assurer la conformité aux politiques internes d'approvisionnement et aux règles du processus d'approvisionnement, aux lignes directrices éthiques et aux règlements externes. Comment allez-vous nous convaincre? Vous êtes un professionnel de l'approvisionnement établi et polyvalent avec plus de 7 ans d'expérience dans un environnement structuré, avec de solides compétences en gestion de catégorie. L'expérience et les connaissances dans le domaine des services ministériels, idéalement dans les catégories Sécurité et gestion des installations, sont un avantage. Vous avez: Strategic Acumen: Démonstration de la capacité de développer et de mettre en œuvre des stratégies de catégorie globale, moteur la création de valeur significative, l'optimisation des coûts, et l'innovation. DDP, négociation et gestion des contrats : Excellente capacité de la DP, de la négociation et de la gestion des contrats, avec une expérience éprouvée de l'obtention de conditions avantageuses. Gestion des intervenants : Forte capacité de communication, d'influence et de gestion des intervenants, capable de collaborer efficacement avec divers partenaires internes et externes à tous les niveaux, y compris les cadres supérieurs. Compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes : Des capacités analytiques et de résolution de problèmes solides, avec la capacité de traduire des données complexes en idées pratiques et des solutions créatives. Adaptabilité : Agilité d'apprentissage démontrée et capacité d'adaptation à l'évolution des conditions du marché et des besoins des entreprises. Autonomy & Drive: esprit d'entreprise démontré, avec une approche proactive pour identifier les opportunités, obtenir l'adhésion des parties prenantes et la direction de l'exécution. Proactive, axée sur les résultats et capable de travailler de manière autonome dans un environnement rapide, international et exigeant. Objectif de durabilité : Un engagement ferme en faveur d'un approvisionnement responsable et de l'intégration des principes de durabilité dans les pratiques d'approvisionnement. Academics: Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en achats, chaîne d'approvisionnement, affaires, marketing et certifications professionnelles. Langues: Anglais et français. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Emplois similaires Gestionnaire de Catégorie d'Approvisionnement Sauvegarder Plan-Les-Ouates, Suisse Piaget Directeur, Sourcing stratégique Sauvegarder New York, États-Unis Richemont Regional Marketing & Marchandising, Gestionnaire de Catégorie Sauvegarder Singapour, Singapour Cartier

jobs.description: Reference code: JR129448 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. YOUR MISSION: As part of the Richemont Europe finance team, the Regional Internal Control Manager supports the increasing need for compliance and requirements for internal control, in line with the Group Internal control guidelines and requirements. This position is central in the control environment of Richemont Europe with both the coordination of local ICS, as well as many business developments projects in all the European markets in scope. This position has a double aspect: act as ICS leader for the regional managing company (including European wholesale, E-commerce activities and supervision of Benelux & Nordics ICS activities) and act as coordinator for all the activities in the European markets. This position implies to be in contact with a very broad range of actors internally and externally: local CFO, ICS, retail back offices, Group Finance, Regional Exco, as well as internal and external auditors. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Internal control activities of the entity RLG Europe: - Review and update risk matrices, perform subsequent testing and issue adequate reporting to Group in line with management’s expectations - Review system access rights and inherent segregation of duties, ensure mitigations are in place - Be the contact point for external auditors (preparation of the audits, responses, etc.) - Prepare and supervise bi‐annual stock counts - Support management in ad‐hoc initiatives aimed at strengthening the compliance effort. - Document or provide guidelines for documenting processes, procedures and user guides. - Ensure clear communication by animating the European Finance Intranet and other relevant online platforms Regional compliance processes - Coordinate and animate the regional RFBO SME (retail financial back office subject matter experts) community - Increase harmonization of processes in the Region - Coordinate regional process audits Compliance in the 7 markets belonging to the “Europe” region - Ensure the sharing of internal control best practices throughout Europe region - Schedule and perform Internal Control reviews of the markets to ensure adequate and sustained compliance. Follow up on issues uncovered and analyse deficiencies. Monitor adequate resolution of issues. - Support the markets in their relationship with internal auditors and bring expertise to the resolution of issues noted. Follow up on issues uncovered and analyse deficiencies - Train newcomers on the Richemont internal controls framework and available tools - Oversee brand first-time implementation of internal control framework in newly‐set up markets or markets newly in scope. - Supervise the Benelux & Nordics ICS Manager and its activities Support all other stakeholders: - Participate to best practice projects - Perform wholesale back‐office controls pursuant to brand commercial policies - Issue ICS reporting including, for example, consignment stock status, discounts granted in boutiques and to wholesalers - Develop collaborative approach with both internal and external auditors - Develop close but independent working relationships with all levels of management in all areas of the business to ensure open communication and to provide consultation and support on remediation efforts and ICS requirements - Support the Brands in their effort to write & implement worldwide wholesale procedures Project support - Participate to RLGE and region ad hoc projects HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Master in Finance or similar fields. Experience in a Big 4 SAP knowledge New data analytics tools (celonis) Retail and wholesale business practices Laws and regulations in the European countries Proactive on-going awareness of the luxury industry and the new retail evolution Giving a previous audit experience is a big advantage in order to better take care of the audits in our scope. You are fluent in English and French Still wondering why, you should apply ? You will join a friendly and dynamic team with whom you will be able to share your knowledge and expertise Entrepreneurship, trust, integrity and agile learning are part of our great team spirit You will interact with numerous stakeholders across Maisons, Functions WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT ? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Send your application online. If your profile matches our search, you will be contacted by our HR team for an interview. Otherwise, you will receive an email to inform you that your application has not been successful. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Internal Control Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Regional Finance Controller, Europe Save Meyrin, Switzerland Cartier Internal Control Manager Save Milano, Italy Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR129448 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. TUA MISSIONE: Nell'ambito del team di finanza Richemont Europe, il Regional Internal Control Manager supporta la crescente necessità di conformità e requisiti per il controllo interno, in linea con le linee guida e i requisiti di controllo interno del Gruppo. Questa posizione è centrale nell'ambiente di controllo di Richemont Europe con il coordinamento dell'ICS locale, così come molti progetti di sviluppo aziendale in tutti i mercati europei di portata. Questa posizione ha un duplice aspetto: fungere da leader ICS per la società di gestione regionale (compresa l'ingrosso europeo, le attività di e-commerce e la supervisione delle attività di Benelux & Nordics ICS) e fungere da coordinatore per tutte le attività nei mercati europei. Questa posizione implica essere in contatto con una gamma molto ampia di attori internamente ed esternamente: CFO locale, ICS, uffici di vendita al dettaglio, Finanze di Gruppo, Exco regionale, così come auditor interni ed esterni. Come fai a fare un'infezione? Attività di controllo interno dell’ente RLG Europe: - Revisione e aggiornamento delle matrici di rischio, eseguire i test successivi e rilasciare un’adeguata segnalazione a Gruppo in linea con le aspettative della gestione - Valutazione dei diritti di accesso al sistema e segregazione inerente dei doveri, garantire le mitigazioni sono in atto - Sii il punto di contatto per i revisori esterni (preparazione degli audit, delle risposte, ecc.) - Preparare e supervisionare i conti azionari semestrali - Gestione del supporto in iniziative ad hoc volte a rafforzare lo sforzo di conformità. - Documento o fornire linee guida per documentare processi, procedure e guide utente. - Assicurare una comunicazione chiara animando l’European Finance Intranet e altre pertinenti piattaforme online Processi di conformità regionali - Coordinare e animare la comunità regionale delle PMI RFBO (ripartire gli esperti in materia di back office finanziari) - Aumentare l’armonizzazione dei processi nella Regione - Coordinare i controlli di processo regionali Compliance nei 7 mercati appartenenti alla regione “Europa” - Assicurare la condivisione delle migliori pratiche di controllo interno in tutta la regione - Pianificare e eseguire la conformità dei mercati sostenuti Seguire le questioni scoperte e analizzare le carenze. Monitorare la risoluzione adeguata dei problemi. - Sostenere i mercati nel loro rapporto con i revisori interni e portare competenze alla risoluzione dei problemi rilevati. Seguire le questioni scoperte e analizzare le carenze - Formare i nuovi arrivati nel quadro dei controlli interni Richemont e gli strumenti disponibili - Superare l'implementazione di prima volta del marchio del quadro di controllo interno in nuovi mercati o mercati di nuova portata. - Supervisionare il Benelux & Nordics ICS Manager e le sue attività Supporta tutti gli altri stakeholder: - Partecipare a progetti di best practice - Eseguire controlli back-office all'ingrosso ai sensi delle politiche commerciali del marchio - Emissione di report ICS inclusi, ad esempio, lo stato di spedizione, gli sconti concessi in boutique e ai grossisti - Sviluppare un approccio collaborativo con i revisori interni ed esterni - Sviluppare relazioni di lavoro strette ma indipendenti con tutti i livelli di gestione in tutte le aree di business Master in Finanza o campi simili. Nuovi strumenti di analisi dei dati (celonis) Vendita al dettaglio e commercio all'ingrosso pratiche legali e regolamenti nei paesi europei Proattiva consapevolezza in corso del settore del lusso e la nuova evoluzione al dettaglio Dare una precedente esperienza di audit è un grande vantaggio per meglio prendersi cura degli audit nel nostro ambito. Sei fluente in inglese e francese ancora chiedendo perché, si dovrebbe applicare? Ti unirai a un team amichevole e dinamico con il quale potrai condividere le tue conoscenze e competenze Imprenditorialità, fiducia, integrità e apprendimento agile fanno parte del nostro grande spirito di squadra Interagirete con numerosi stakeholders in Maisons, Funzioni CHE MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Il nostro vero potere non risiede nelle nostre similitudini, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e capacità umane, così come nella nostra specifica capacità di promuovere il potenziale non sfruttato. Valiamo la libertà, la collegialità, la lealtà e la solidarietà. - No. Adottiamo empatia, curiosità, coraggio, umiltà e integrità. - No. Ci preoccupiamo del mondo in cui viviamo. Invia la tua candidatura online. Se il tuo profilo corrisponde alla nostra ricerca, sarai contattato dal nostro team HR per un'intervista. Altrimenti, riceverai un'email per informarti che la tua applicazione non ha avuto successo. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture similar Jobs Europe FP&A Controller Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Internal Control Manager Save Corsico, Italy Richemont Jewelry Manager Europe Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR129474 Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura. Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations. Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation. Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Piaget is actively seeking a bright and enthusiastic Press & Public Relations Project Manager to join the team and make the Maison shine. You will play an essential role in supporting the creation of the press, celebrities and influencers strategy at the International Level for the Maison. You will also be instrumental in generating maximum brand exposure both offline and online. Key 
• Responsibilities: Celebrity & Influencer Strategy: You will contribute to the development and implementation of our Maison’s Celebrity and Influencer strategy. This includes as well supporting local strategies in collaboration with our subsidiaries. You will manage ongoing communications and relationships with talent and influencers, ensuring positive experiences and effective collaboration. Project Management: You will lead the end-to-end planning, execution, and monitoring of PR campaigns and projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and meet strategic objectives. You will oversee the creation and distribution of content by talent and influencers, ensuring brand messaging consistency and quality. You will manage the logistics for celebrity and influencer participation in events, ensuring a smooth and successful experience. Analytics & Reporting: You will analyze campaign performance using relevant metrics (e.g., reach, engagement, sentiment, media value, ROI) and prepare detailed post-campaign reports and presentations, providing insights and recommendations for future strategies. Risk & Crisis Management: Support identifying potential communication bottlenecks and structuring response strategies to protect the brand's reputation. Budget: You will manage project budgets, track expenses, and ensure cost-effective utilization of resources for talent and influencer engagements and maintain accurate supplier documentation. Compliance & Best Practices: You will stay abreast of industry trends, best practices, and regulatory changes in influencer marketing and PR. You will negotiate contracts, terms, and deliverables with talent, influencers, and their representatives, ensuring compliance with legal and brand guidelines. You will also ensure all talent and influencer activities comply with relevant advertising standards, disclosure requirements, and guidelines. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? A minimum of 5 years of experience in PR within the luxury industry. Strong communication skills, both written and oral, coupled with a genuine passion for communication and creativity, and the ability to develop creative initiatives to achieve exceptional results. Dynamic with a collaborative approach, demonstrating proven experience with cross-functional collaboration and partnering with various departments (e.g., events, marketing, product marketing). Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, meeting tight deadlines. Excellent prioritizing, time management, and strong organizational skills. ROI oriented with strong analytical and reporting capabilities. PR legal skills to manage endorsement contracts with the legal department. Mandatory understanding of the Social Media and Media landscape. Proficiency in computer skills including Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams. Fluent in English. STILL WONDERING WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY? A Welcoming Team: Join our friendly, open-minded, and talented team, where your skills will be valued and your contributions will make a real difference. Dynamic and Engaging Work: Experience daily activities that are interesting, challenging, and diverse, keeping you engaged and motivated. Investment in Your Growth: We are passionate about developing our people, and you will have access to various training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. The Piaget culture of encouraging Extra-Care, fostering Mastery and bringing out the Extraordinary in our people, means that we will always go further, doing “what has never been done before”. Together. If you want to become a part of it do not hesitate to apply! Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation. Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Piaget is actively seeking a bright and enthusiastic Press & Public Relations Project Manager to join the team and make the Maison shine. You will play an essential role in supporting the creation of the press, celebrities and influencers strategy at the International Level for the Maison. You will also be instrumental in generating maximum brand exposure both offline and online. Key

Project Management: You will lead the end-to-end planning, execution, and monitoring of PR campaigns and projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and meet strategic objectives. You will oversee the creation and distribution of content by talent and influencers, ensuring brand messaging consistency and quality. You will manage the logistics for celebrity and influencer participation in events, ensuring a smooth and successful experience. Analytics & Reporting: You will analyze campaign performance using relevant metrics (e.g., reach, engagement, sentiment, media value, ROI) and prepare detailed post-campaign reports and presentations, providing insights and recommendations for future strategies. Compliance & Best Practices: You will stay abreast of industry trends, best practices, and regulatory changes in influencer marketing and PR. Together. If you want to become a part of it do not hesitate to apply! jobs.description: Reference code: JR129438 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Richemont is looking for an experienced and forward-thinking leader to shape the next chapter of Group People Analytics. In this role, you will define and drive our People Analytics and HR Reporting strategy, strengthen data-informed decision-making across HR and business leadership, and accelerate our ability to unlock the value of people data at scale. You will play a pivotal role in transforming HR into a more insight-led function while ensuring our data, platforms, and capabilities evolve to support strategic, operational, and regulatory needs across the Group. Reporting to the Group HR Digital & Data Director, you will lead the Group People Analytics function and a team of four experts. You will shape the function’s direction, strengthen its operating model, and ensure the delivery of impactful executive insights and scalable reporting capabilities for the Group. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? In this role, you will position People Analytics as a strategic capability for HR and the business, combining leadership, business partnership, and analytical expertise. In particular, you will: Define and lead the Group People Analytics and Reporting strategy, setting the vision, priorities, governance, and roadmap required to strengthen data-driven decision-making across HR and for business leaders. Lead the adoption and continuous improvement of the Visier people analytics platform, ensuring relevance of insights, strong user experience, and growing usage across the HR community and, progressively, among business leaders. Strengthen the analytics capabilities of the HR community through targeted upskilling and stronger data literacy, enabling them to translate complex workforce topics into clear, decision-oriented narratives. Shape the future HR data and analytics ecosystem leveraging our data lake capabilities with GCP and Looker, enabling richer analysis across people and business data. Drive excellence in Workday reporting by establishing a robust operating model that combines clear governance, strong expertise, reliable delivery, and the ability to scale reporting services efficiently across the Group. Own HR data governance end-to-end, covering stewardship, data quality, definitions, documentation, compliance, and controls, while guiding the continuous strengthening of data quality practices. Deliver high-value executive insights for Group leadership and provide trusted data for Non-Financial Reporting and other regulatory requirements. Animate the People Analytics community across the Group, fostering alignment, knowledge sharing, and the spread of effective practices. Operate effectively across both strategic priorities and key tactical matters, ensuring the function remains connected to business needs while driving long-term direction. Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of experts, ensuring strong execution, collaboration, and continuous growth of the function. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Master’s degree in a relevant field and 15+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR data, reporting, or related analytics domains, including successful experience in a similar senior leadership role. Strong track record in defining and executing People Analytics strategies that create measurable business value and strengthen HR effectiveness. Proven leadership capability, with experience coaching, developing, and inspiring multidisciplinary expert teams while setting high standards for quality, pace, and collaboration. Strong ability to translate complex people and business data into clear messages, practical recommendations, and compelling executive narratives. Deep understanding of HR data, data governance, data quality, reporting models, and the responsibilities that come with handling sensitive employee information. Solid expertise in Workday reporting and strong familiarity with modern analytics platforms and ecosystems, including Visier, GCP, and Looker. Experience designing adoption strategies and upskilling programs that strengthen analytics literacy and encourage effective use of data across HR communities. Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across HR, Group Platform, Finance, and senior business stakeholders in a matrix organization. Excellent communication skills and executive presence, with the credibility to influence senior stakeholders and represent the function at Group level. Fluent in English; French is an asset. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Group HR Reporting Manager Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Director, Talent Management & Mobility Save New York, United States of America Cartier Group Talent Systems & Operations Project Manager Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Richemont is looking for an experienced and forward-thinking leader to shape the next chapter of Group People Analytics. In this role, you will define and drive our People Analytics and HR Reporting strategy, strengthen data-informed decision-making across HR and business leadership, and accelerate our ability to unlock the value of people data at scale. You will play a pivotal role in transforming HR into a more insight-led function while ensuring our data, platforms, and capabilities evolve to support strategic, operational, and regulatory needs across the Group. Reporting to the Group HR Digital & Data Director, you will lead the Group People Analytics function and a team of four experts. You will shape the function’s direction, strengthen its operating model, and ensure the delivery of impactful executive insights and scalable reporting capabilities for the Group. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? In this role, you will position People Analytics as a strategic capability for HR and the business, combining leadership, business partnership, and analytical expertise. In particular, you will: Define and lead the Group People Analytics and Reporting strategy, setting the vision, priorities, governance, and roadmap required to strengthen data-driven decision-making across HR and for business leaders. Lead the adoption and continuous improvement of the Visier people analytics platform, ensuring relevance of insights, strong user experience, and growing usage across the HR community and, progressively, among business leaders. Strengthen the analytics capabilities of the HR community through targeted upskilling and stronger data literacy, enabling them to translate complex workforce topics into clear, decision-oriented narratives. Shape the future HR data and analytics ecosystem leveraging our data lake capabilities with GCP and Looker, enabling richer analysis across people and business data. Drive excellence in Workday reporting by establishing a robust operating model that combines clear governance, strong expertise, reliable delivery, and the ability to scale reporting services efficiently across the Group. Own HR data governance end-to-end, covering stewardship, data quality, definitions, documentation, compliance, and controls, while guiding the continuous strengthening of data quality practices. Deliver high-value executive insights for Group leadership and provide trusted data for Non-Financial Reporting and other regulatory requirements. Animate the People Analytics community across the Group, fostering alignment, knowledge sharing, and the spread of effective practices. Operate effectively across both strategic priorities and key tactical matters, ensuring the function remains connected to business needs while driving long-term direction. Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of experts, ensuring strong execution, collaboration, and continuous growth of the function. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Master’s degree in a relevant field and 15+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR data, reporting, or related analytics domains, including successful experience in a similar senior leadership role. Strong track record in defining and executing People Analytics strategies that create measurable business value and strengthen HR effectiveness. Proven leadership capability, with experience coaching, developing, and inspiring multidisciplinary expert teams while setting high standards for quality, pace, and collaboration. Strong ability to translate complex people and business data into clear messages, practical recommendations, and compelling executive narratives. Deep understanding of HR data, data governance, data quality, reporting models, and the responsibilities that come with handling sensitive employee information. Solid expertise in Workday reporting and strong familiarity with modern analytics platforms and ecosystems, including Visier, GCP, and Looker. Experience designing adoption strategies and upskilling programs that strengthen analytics literacy and encourage effective use of data across HR communities. Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across HR, Group Platform, Finance, and senior business stakeholders in a matrix organization. Excellent communication skills and executive presence, with the credibility to influence senior stakeholders and represent the function at Group level.
