jobs.description: Reference code: JR130246 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. YOUR MISSION: As a Client & Engagement Data Product Owner in the Product Office, you will be instrumental in ensuring that business-relevant data within your designated product area is centrally available through a series of high-quality data products that you will have to build/enhance and maintain in collaboration with our internal data teams. This means you will oversee the entire lifecycle of data products, from initial requirement capture and definition to successful delivery, roll-out, and adoption, ensuring alignment with Richemont's data governance standards. This role is key to accelerating data-driven decision-making across our Maisons, Functions, and Regions. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Discovery, Planning & Delivery: Define and drive the roadmap for owned data products within your product area focusing on Clients, online and e-commerce, web analytics, partners, post-purchase and marketing. Collaborate closely with the Group Data Office and Group Data Domain Leads. Gather detailed business requirements from stakeholders across Maisons, Functions, and Regions, translating them into clear user stories and technical specifications. Partner with the Group Data Office to design, prioritize, and plan data product delivery, ensuring technical implementation meets business and governance requirements. Oversee functional testing and validation to ensure data products meet defined needs. Data Governance: Work with Group Data Domain Leads to apply data governance requirements throughout the product lifecycle, from data ingestion to sharing. Ensure adherence to Group data governance principles and standards for raw data and data products, including data classification, field-level documentation, and data quality monitoring. Implement and document access rules in accordance with access policies. Adoption & Enhancements: Drive the adoption and usage of owned data products across Maisons, Functions, and Regions. Develop and deliver training materials and documentation to support optimal data product usage. Provide ongoing functional support and guidance to users and proactively identify opportunities for continuous innovation. Manage new business requests and conduct regular updates on data product evolution. Interactions: You will collaborate closely with: Group Technology: To align on technical architecture, data models, and integration mechanisms. Group Data Office: To ensure best practices and adherence to Group-wide data governance for central data products. Group Data Leads (Domains and Maisons): To understand domain needs, governance requirements, and promote core data product adoption. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? +7 years working experience in a related field Education & Experience: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business Administration) or equivalent practical experience on the job. Data Product Management: Proven ability to manage the entire lifecycle of technical data products, from discovery and definition to delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement. Technical knowledge: Solid understanding of data management and governance principles, including data classification, data quality, and access control. Experience with cloud data platforms, specifically Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Proficiency in querying and manipulating data, with strong knowledge of BigQuery or similar large-scale data warehouses. Knowledge of data visualization tools, specifically Looker. Familiarity with data integration techniques, data modeling, and data pipeline concepts. Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear and actionable technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria. All certifications proving above technical knowledge are considered as a plus. Domain & Business Understanding: Understanding of business processes within a product-oriented environment. Ability to ensure data generated in products supports business processes and is properly integrated, modeled, and available. Soft Skills: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills. Proven ability to manage interactions with diverse business stakeholders, including senior management, and foster collaboration across Maisons, Functions, and Regions. Excellent communication and presentation skills to articulate complex data concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. What We Offer: A dynamic and international work environment within the luxury industry. Opportunities to drive data innovation and impact business strategy. Continuous learning and development within a leading global group. Descrizione Reference code: JR130246 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. La tua missione - As a Client & Engagement Data Product Owner in the Product Office, you will be instrumental in ensuring that business-relevant data within your designated product area is centrally available through a series of high-quality data products that you will have to build/enhance and maintain in collaboration with our internal data teams. - This means you will oversee the entire lifecycle of data products, from initial requirement capture and definition to successful delivery, roll-out, and adoption, ensuring alignment with Richemont's data governance standards. - This role is key to accelerating data-driven decision-making across our Maisons, Functions, and Regions. Come farai la differenza? Discovery, Planning & Delivery - Define and drive the roadmap for owned data products within your product area focusing on Clients, online and e-commerce, web analytics, partners, post-purchase and marketing. - Collaborate closely with the Group Data Office and Group Data Domain Leads. - Gather detailed business requirements from stakeholders across Maisons, Functions, and Regions, translating them into clear user stories and technical specifications. - Partner with the Group Data Office to design, prioritize, and plan data product delivery, ensuring technical implementation meets business and governance requirements. - Oversee functional testing and validation to ensure data products meet defined needs. Data Governance - Work with Group Data Domain Leads to apply data governance requirements throughout the product lifecycle, from data ingestion to sharing. - Ensure adherence to Group data governance principles and standards for raw data and data products, including data classification, field-level documentation, and data quality monitoring. - Implement and document access rules in accordance with access policies. Adoption & Enhancements - Drive the adoption and usage of owned data products across Maisons, Functions, and Regions. - Develop and deliver training materials and documentation to support optimal data product usage. - Provide ongoing functional support and guidance to users and proactively identify opportunities for continuous innovation. - Manage new business requests and conduct regular updates on data product evolution. Interazioni - You will collaborate closely with: - Group Technology: To align on technical architecture, data models, and integration mechanisms. - Group Data Office: To ensure best practices and adherence to Group-wide data governance for central data products. - Group Data Leads (Domains and Maisons): To understand domain needs, governance requirements, and promote core data product adoption. Come misureremo il successo? - +7 years working experience in a related field - Education & Experience: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business Administration) or equivalent practical experience on the job. - Data Product Management: Proven ability to manage the entire lifecycle of technical data products, from discovery and definition to delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement. - Technical knowledge: Solid understanding of data management and governance principles, including data classification, data quality, and access control. - Experience with cloud data platforms, specifically Google Cloud Platform (GCP). - Proficiency in querying and manipulating data, with strong knowledge of BigQuery or similar large-scale data warehouses. - Knowledge of data visualization tools, specifically Looker. - Familiarity with data integration techniques, data modeling, and data pipeline concepts. - Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear and actionable technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria. - All certifications proving above technical knowledge are considered as a plus. - Domain & Business Understanding: Understanding of business processes within a product-oriented environment. - Ability to ensure data generated in products supports business processes and is properly integrated, modeled, and available. - Soft Skills: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills. - Proven ability to manage interactions with diverse business stakeholders, including senior management, and foster collaboration across Maisons, Functions, and Regions. - Excellent communication and presentation skills to articulate complex data concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Cosa offriamo - A dynamic and international work environment within the luxury industry. - Opportunities to drive data innovation and impact business strategy. - Continuous learning and development within a leading global group. - Competitive compensation and benefits package.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence: JR130246 Richemont possède quelques-uns des principaux produits de luxe du monde, avec des atouts particuliers en bijoux, montres fines et accessoires haut de gamme. Chaque Maison représente une fière tradition de style, de qualité et d'artisanat et Richemont cherche à préserver le patrimoine et l'identité de chacune de ses Maisons. Dans le même temps, nous sommes engagés dans l'innovation et la conception de nouveaux produits qui sont conformes à nos valeurs Maisons, à travers un processus de créativité continue. VOTRE MISSION : En tant que propriétaire de données client et engagement au sein de l'Office des produits, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans la mise à disposition de données pertinentes pour les entreprises dans votre zone de produits désignée grâce à une série de produits de données de haute qualité que vous devrez construire et entretenir en collaboration avec nos équipes de données internes. Cela signifie que vous superviserez l'ensemble du cycle de vie des produits de données, depuis la saisie initiale des exigences et la définition jusqu'à la livraison, le déploiement et l'adoption réussies, en assurant l'alignement sur les normes de gouvernance des données de Richemont. Ce rôle est essentiel pour accélérer la prise de décision axée sur les données dans nos Maisons, Fonctions et Régions. Comment allez-vous avoir un impact ? Découverte, planification et livraison : Définir et piloter la feuille de route pour les produits de données appartenant à votre secteur de produit en mettant l'accent sur les clients, le commerce en ligne et électronique, l'analyse Web, les partenaires, la post-achat et le marketing. Collaborer étroitement avec le Bureau des données du groupe et les responsables des domaines de données du groupe. Rassembler les besoins opérationnels détaillés des intervenants des Maisons, des Fonctions et des Régions, les traduire en histoires d'utilisateurs claires et en spécifications techniques. Établir des partenariats avec le Groupe de données pour concevoir, classer par ordre de priorité et planifier la livraison des données, en veillant à ce que la mise en œuvre technique réponde aux exigences en matière d'affaires et de gouvernance. Superviser les tests fonctionnels et la validation pour s'assurer que les produits de données répondent aux besoins définis. Gouvernance des données: Travailler avec le domaine de données de groupe mène à appliquer les exigences de gouvernance des données tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, de l'ingestion de données au partage. Veiller au respect des principes et normes de gouvernance des données du Groupe pour les données brutes et les produits de données, y compris la classification des données, la documentation sur le terrain et le contrôle de la qualité des données. Appliquer et documenter les règles d'accès conformément aux politiques d'accès. Adoption & Améliorations: Favoriser l'adoption et l'utilisation de produits de données appartenant à des maisons, des fonctions et des régions. Élaborer et fournir du matériel de formation et de la documentation pour soutenir l'utilisation optimale des données. Fournir un soutien fonctionnel continu et des conseils aux utilisateurs et identifier proactivement les possibilités d'innovation continue. Gérer les nouvelles demandes d'affaires et effectuer des mises à jour régulières sur l'évolution des produits de données. Interactions : Vous collaborerez étroitement avec : Technologie de groupe : Pour vous aligner sur l'architecture technique, les modèles de données et les mécanismes d'intégration. Bureau des données du groupe : Assurer les meilleures pratiques et le respect de la gouvernance des données à l'échelle du groupe pour les produits de données centraux. Responsables de données de groupe (domaines et maisons) : Comprendre les besoins du domaine, les exigences en matière de gouvernance et promouvoir l'adoption de produits de données de base. Comment allez-vous nous convaincre? +7 ans d'expérience de travail dans un domaine connexe Éducation et expérience : Licence ou maîtrise dans un domaine pertinent (p. ex. informatique, informatique, génie, administration des affaires) ou expérience pratique équivalente au travail. Data Product Management: Capacité éprouvée de gérer tout le cycle de vie des produits de données techniques, de la découverte et de la définition à la livraison, l'adoption et l'amélioration continue. Connaissances techniques : Connaissance des principes de gestion et de gouvernance des données, y compris la classification des données, la qualité des données et le contrôle de l'accès. Expérience des plateformes de données en nuage, en particulier Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Aptitude à interroger et à manipuler des données, avec une bonne connaissance de BigQuery ou d'entrepôts de données similaires à grande échelle. Connaissance des outils de visualisation des données, en particulier Looker. Connaissance des techniques d'intégration des données, de la modélisation des données et des concepts de pipeline de données. Capacité de traduire des exigences opérationnelles complexes en spécifications techniques claires et réalisables, en récits d'utilisateurs et en critères d'acceptation. Toutes les certifications prouvant des connaissances techniques supérieures sont considérées comme un plus. Domaine & Compréhension des affaires: Compréhension des processus commerciaux dans un environnement axé sur les produits. Capacité de s'assurer que les données produites dans les produits appuient les processus opérationnels et sont correctement intégrées, modélisées et disponibles. Compétences douces : Compétences exceptionnelles en analyse et en résolution de problèmes. Capacité éprouvée de gérer les interactions avec divers intervenants commerciaux, y compris la haute direction, et de favoriser la collaboration entre les maisons, les fonctions et les régions. Excellente capacité de communication et de présentation pour articuler des concepts de données complexes avec des publics techniques et non techniques. Ce que nous offrons: Un environnement de travail dynamique et international dans l'industrie du luxe. Possibilités de stimuler l'innovation dans les données et d'influer sur la stratégie commerciale. Apprentissage et développement continus au sein d'un groupe mondial de premier plan. jobs.description: Reference code: JR130272 POUR CEUX ET CELLES QUI RECHERCHENT L’EXCELLENCE Rejoignez l’une des Maisons emblématiques de la haute horlogerie, où l’excellence est une exigence constante. Prenez part à notre succès collectif et à la création de notre héritage futur. VOTRE RAISON D’ÊTRE AU SEIN DE LA MAISON Nous recherchons un(e) polisseur(se). Rattaché au département SAV, le polisseur a pour mission d’assurer les opérations de polissage, de retouches et de terminaison pour l'ensemble des composants horlogers en production et au SAV ainsi que du démontage/remontage de boîte, dans le respect des critères de qualité de la Marque. VOTRE RÔLE À JOUER Vous serez responsable de : Préparer votre poste de travail, vos outils, ainsi que la documentation associée Respecter et appliquer les standards, les instructions de travail et de poste Contrôler la qualité et la quantité des pièces du lot Réaliser les opérations de polissage sur les différents matériaux (acier, or, platine, titane, palladium…) selon instructions Réaliser les opérations de polissage manuel : le feutrage, polissage, avivage, satinage (circulaire, droit et soleil) sablage, lapidage et le de-rhodiage Procéder au lavage (vapeur, machine) Réaliser le démontage de boîtes pour retouches Réaliser le remontage de glaces et/ou de boîtes pour étanchéité Réaliser les opérations d’autocontrôle selon les instructions de travail et de poste Contrôler la marche, l’étanchéité, la précision et la durée de marche de la montre Détecter, résoudre et remonter les problèmes qualité et/ou technique aux services concernés Assurer la maintenance des équipements de l’atelier LES QUALITÉS POUR EXCELLER La réussite dans ce rôle repose sur : Votre expérience avérée en polissage de boîtes de montres et composants habillage, idéalement au sein d’un atelier SAV Votre maitrise d’outils manuel tels que le lapidaire, la ponceuse à bande, la sableuse, le tour à polir, le micromoteur Votre capacité à lire des plans techniques Votre grande précision dans la manipulation d’outillages horlogers Votre expérience professionnelle ou personnelle dans le démontage et le remontage de boîtes de montres, serait un réel atout dans la prise en main de ce rôle. L’utilisation d’outils informatique et d’un ERP Votre rigueur, votre capacité de concentration, votre patience et votre dextérité qui feront la différence Votre ouverture d'esprit et votre esprit d'initiative Votre disponibilité et votre flexibilité seront fortement appréciées Vacheron Constantin a célébré 270 ans en tant que plus ancienne manufacture horlogère au monde, en activité continue depuis 1755. Basée à Genève, Suisse, notre Maison opère un réseau mondial de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté exceptionnelle – horlogers, artisans et professionnels – partage une même passion pour notre héritage et l’ambition de construire un avenir encore plus radieux. Prêt(e) à faire partie de notre histoire ? Nous serons ravis de découvrir votre candidature. • Cerchiamo una lucidatrice. Annesso al reparto di assistenza post-vendita, la missione del lucidatore è garantire le operazioni di lucidatura, ritocco e finitura di tutti i componenti dell'orologio in produzione e il servizio post-vendita, nonché lo smontaggio/rimontaggio della cassa, nel rispetto dei criteri di qualità del Marchio. IL TUO RUOLO Sarai responsabile di: Preparare la tua postazione di lavoro, i tuoi strumenti, nonché la documentazione associata Rispettare e applicare le norme, il lavoro e le istruzioni postali Controllare la qualità e la quantità dei pezzi nel lotto Eseguire operazioni di lucidatura sui diversi materiali (acciaio, oro, platino, titanio, palladio, ecc.) secondo le istruzioni Eseguire operazioni di lucidatura manuale: feltratura, lucidatura, brillantatura, satinatura (circolare, diritta e solare) sabbiatura, denocciolatura e derodiatura Effettuare il lavaggio (vapore, macchina) Effettuare lo smontaggio delle casse per il ritocco Effettuare il rimontaggio dei cristalli e/o delle casse per l'impermeabilizzazione Effettuare operazioni di autocontrollo secondo le istruzioni di lavoro e post Controllare il funzionamento, la tenuta stagna, la precisione e la durata dell'orologio Rilevare, risolvere e segnalare problemi di qualità e/o tecnici ai reparti interessati Garantire la manutenzione delle attrezzature dell'officina QUALITÀ PER ECCELLERE Il successo in questo ruolo si basa su: La vostra comprovata esperienza nella lucidatura di casse e componenti di finiture di orologi, idealmente in un laboratorio di assistenza post-vendita La tua padronanza degli strumenti manuali come lapidario, levigatrice a nastro, sabbiatrice, tornio lucidatrice, micromotore La tua capacità di leggere i piani tecnici La tua grande precisione nel maneggiare gli strumenti di orologeria La tua esperienza professionale o personale nello smontare e rimontare casse di orologi, sarebbe una vera risorsa per assumere questo ruolo. Con sede a Ginevra, Svizzera, la nostra Casa gestisce una rete globale di quasi 200 punti vendita in 36 paesi. Ogni membro della nostra eccezionale comunità – orologiai, artigiani e professionisti – condivide la stessa passione per la nostra tradizione e l’ambizione di costruire un futuro ancora più luminoso. Pronti a far parte della nostra storia? Saremo lieti di scoprire la tua candidatura. descriptionByLocale.en: Reference code: JR130272 FOR THOSE WHO SEEK EXCELLENCE Join one of the emblematic Maisons of fine watchmaking, where excellence is a constant requirement. Be a part of our collective success and the creation of our future legacy. YOUR REASON FOR BEING IN THE HOUSE We are looking for a polisher. Attached to the after-sales service department, the polisher's mission is to ensure polishing, touch-up and finishing operations for all watch components in production and after-sales service as well as case disassembly/reassembly, in compliance with the Brand's quality criteria. YOUR ROLE TO PLAY You will be responsible for: Prepare your workstation, your tools, as well as the associated documentation Respect and apply the standards, work and post instructions Control the quality and quantity of the parts in the batch Carry out polishing operations on the different materials (steel, gold, platinum, titanium, palladium, etc.) according to instructions Carry out manual polishing operations: felting, polishing, brightening, satin finishing (circular, straight and sun) sandblasting, stoning and de-rhodium plating Carry out washing (steam, machine) Carry out the disassembly of boxes for retouching Carry out the reassembly of crystals and/or boxes for waterproofing Carry out self-checking operations according to work and post instructions Check the running, watertightness, precision and running time of the watch Detect, resolve and report quality and/or technical problems to the departments concerned Ensure the maintenance of workshop equipment QUALITIES TO EXCEL Success in this role is based on: Your proven experience in polishing watch cases and trim components, ideally in an after-sales service workshop Your mastery of manual tools such as the lapidary, belt sander, sandblaster, polishing lathe, micromotor Your ability to read technical plans Your great precision in handling watchmaking tools Your professional or personal experience in disassembling and reassembling cases of watches, would be a real asset in taking on this role. The use of IT tools and an ERP Your rigor, your ability to concentrate, your patience and your dexterity which will make the difference Your open-mindedness and your spirit of initiative Your availability and your flexibility will be greatly appreciated Vacheron Constantin celebrated 270 years as the oldest watch manufacturer in the world, in continuous activity since 1755. Based in Geneva, Switzerland, our House operates a global network of nearly 200 points of sale in 36 countries. Each member of our exceptional community – watchmakers, artisans and professionals – shares the same passion for our heritage and the ambition to build an even brighter future. Ready to be part of our history? We will be delighted to discover your application. descriptionByLocale.de: Referenzcode: JR130272 FÜR ALLE, DIE EXZELLENZ SUCHEN Treten Sie einem der symbolträchtigen Maisons der feinen Uhrmacherkunst bei, wo Exzellenz eine ständige Anforderung ist. Seien Sie Teil unseres gemeinsamen Erfolgs und der Schaffung unseres zukünftigen Erbes. IHR GRUND, DASS SIE IM HAUS SIND. Wir suchen einen Polierer. Die Aufgabe des Polierers, der der Kundendienstabteilung zugeordnet ist, besteht darin, die Polier-, Ausbesserungs- und Endbearbeitungsvorgänge aller Uhrenkomponenten in der Produktion und im Kundendienst sowie die Demontage/Wiedermontage des Gehäuses unter Einhaltung der Qualitätskriterien der Marke sicherzustellen. IHRE ROLLE ZU SPIELEN Sie sind verantwortlich für: Bereiten Sie Ihren Arbeitsplatz, Ihre Werkzeuge sowie die dazugehörige Dokumentation vor. Respektieren und wenden Sie die Normen, Arbeits- und Postanweisungen an. Kontrollieren Sie die Qualität und Quantität der Teile in der Charge. Führen Sie Poliervorgänge an den verschiedenen Materialien (Stahl, Gold, Platin, Titan, Palladium usw.) gemäß den Anweisungen durch. Führen Sie manuelle Poliervorgänge durch: Filzen, Polieren, Aufhellen, Satinieren (rund, gerade und sonnenstrahlen), Sandstrahlen, Steinen und Entrhodinieren, Waschen (Dampf, Maschine) durchführen, Demontage von Kästen zur Retusche durchführen, Kristalle und/oder Kästen zum Abdichten wieder zusammenbauen, Selbstkontrollen gemäß den Arbeits- und Postanweisungen durchführen, den Lauf, die Wasserdichtigkeit, die Präzision und die Laufzeit der Uhr überprüfen, Qualitäts- und/oder technische Probleme erkennen, lösen und den betroffenen Abteilungen melden, die Wartung der Werkstattausrüstung sicherstellen. QUALITÄTEN, DIE AUSGEZEICHNET WERDEN. Der Erfolg in dieser Rolle basiert auf: Ihrer nachgewiesenen Erfahrung im Polieren von Uhren Gehäuse und Zierteile, idealerweise in einer Kundendienstwerkstatt. Ihre Beherrschung manueller Werkzeuge wie Schleifmaschine, Bandschleifer, Sandstrahler, Poliermaschine, Mikromotor. Ihre Fähigkeit, technische Pläne zu lesen. Ihre große Präzision im Umgang mit Uhrmacherwerkzeugen. Ihre berufliche oder persönliche Erfahrung im Zerlegen und Zusammenbauen von Uhrengehäusen wäre für die Übernahme dieser Rolle von großem Vorteil. Der Einsatz von IT-Tools und einem ERP. Ihre Genauigkeit, Ihre Konzentrationsfähigkeit, Ihre Geduld und Ihre Geschicklichkeit, die den Unterschied machen werden. Ihre Aufgeschlossenheit und Ihr Initiativgeist. Ihre Verfügbarkeit und Ihre Flexibilität werden sehr geschätzt. Vacheron Constantin feierte 270 Jahre als ältester Uhrenhersteller der Welt, der seit 1755 ununterbrochen tätig ist. Unser Haus mit Sitz in Genf, Schweiz, betreibt ein globales Netzwerk von fast 200 Verkaufsstellen in 36 Ländern. Jedes Mitglied unserer außergewöhnlichen Gemeinschaft – Uhrmacher, Kunsthandwerker und Profis – teilt die gleiche Leidenschaft für unser Erbe und den Ehrgeiz, eine noch bessere Zukunft aufzubauen. Bereit, Teil unserer Geschichte zu sein? Wir freuen uns über Ihre Bewerbung. descriptionByLocale.fr: Reference code: JR130272 POUR CEUX ET CELLES QUI RECHERCHENT L’EXCELLENCE Rejoignez l’une des Maisons emblématiques de la haute horlogerie, où l’excellence est une exigence constante. Prenez part à notre succès collectif et à la création de notre héritage futur. VOTRE RAISON D’ÊTRE AU SEIN DE LA MAISON Nous recherchons un(e) polisseur(se). Rattaché au département SAV, le polisseur a pour mission d’assurer les opérations de polissage, de retouches et de terminaison pour l'ensemble des composants horlogers en production et au SAV ainsi que du démontage/remontage de boîte, dans le respect des critères de qualité de la Marque. VOTRE RÔLE À JOUER Vous serez responsable de : Préparer votre poste de travail, vos outils, ainsi que la documentation associée Respecter et appliquer les standards, les instructions de travail et de poste Contrôler la qualité et la quantité des pièces du lot Réaliser les opérations de polissage sur les différents matériaux (acier, or, platine, titane, palladium…) selon instructions Réaliser les opérations de polissage manuel : le feutrage, polissage, avivage, satinage (circulaire, droit et soleil) sablage, lapidage et le de-rhodiage Procéder au lavage (vapeur, machine) Réaliser le démontage de boîtes pour retouches Réaliser le remontage de glaces et/ou de boîtes pour étanchéité Réaliser les opérations d’autocontrôle selon les instructions de travail et de poste Contrôler la marche, l’étanchéité, la précision et la durée de marche de la montre Détecter, résoudre et remonter les problèmes qualité et/ou technique aux services concernés Assurer la maintenance des équipements de l’atelier LES QUALITÉS POUR EXCELLER La réussite dans ce rôle repose sur : Votre expérience avérée en polissage de boîtes de montres et composants habillage, idéalement au sein d’un atelier SAV Votre maitrise d’outils manuel tels que le lapidaire, la ponceuse à bande, la sableuse, le tour à polir, le micromoteur Votre capacité à lire des plans techniques Votre grande précision dans la manipulation d’outillages horlogers Votre expérience professionnelle ou personnelle dans le démontage et le remontage de boîtes de montres, serait un réel atout dans la prise en main de ce rôle. L’utilisation d’outils informatique et d’un ERP Votre rigueur, votre capacité de concentration, votre patience et votre dextérité qui feront la différence Votre ouverture d'esprit et votre esprit d'initiative Votre disponibilité et votre flexibilité seront fortement appréciées Vacheron Constantin a célébré 270 ans en tant que plus ancienne manufacture horlogère au monde, en activité continue depuis 1755. Basée à Genève, Suisse, notre Maison opère un réseau mondial de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté exceptionnelle – horlogers, artisans et professionnels – partage une même passion pour notre héritage et l’ambition de construire un avenir encore plus radieux. Prêt(e) à faire partie de notre histoire ? Nous serons ravis de découvrir votre candidature. jobs.title: Downstream Supply Chain Solutions Director
jobs.description: Reference code: JR130197 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. YOUR MISSION: In his scope of responsibilities, the Downstream Supply Chain Solutions Director is responsible for the development of a Supply Chain competency center at the service of the Maisons with the objectives to: Manage end-to-end Supply Chain Planning transformation projects​ and bring targeted added-value Supply Chain expertise on adhoc Maison’s request Maintain and develop consistent, efficient, sustainable Supply Chain Planning processes across the Maisons, Animate the Supply Chain Community within the Group related to her/his stream The Downstream Supply Chain Solutions Director will play a key role in the Richemont Group end-to-end supply chain transformation and will be with her/his organization a key contributor to achieve Richemont's overall high ambitions. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? END to END SUPPLY CHAIN STRATEGY SUPPLY CHAIN TRANSFORMATION: Lead Downstream Supply Chain Planning transformation projects in close collaboration with the Maisons and all internal stakeholders/Group functions to ensure supply chain efficiency and agility to provide optimal product availability at the optimized stock level, and ensure high internal client satisfaction. Support the Maisons in the definition of their End-to-End Supply Chain strategy and their associated 3/5-year plan to build an overall consolidated SC roadmap. Based on this consolidated SC roadmap, build a 3/5-year roadmap related to her/his streams and promote this roadmap within Richemont organization to ensure a full adherence and availability of resources (human resources, IT budget,…) on the roadmap horizon. Ensure an effective roll-out of the defined Roadmap SUPPLY CHAIN AMBASSADOR: Act as ambassador of the Richemont Supply Chain Solutions department. Create and foster positive and productive partnerships with stakeholders across the Maisons and the Group. BEST PRACTICES & PROCESSES: Define & manage the Supply Chain Planning « best practices » and ensure its sharing between the Maisons. Co-build and ensure development of new advanced Supply Chain models and processes in collaboration with the Maisons & Group Functions. PROMOTE OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE: Define & share common metrics to monitor the performance of the Downstream Supply Chain Planning of the Maisons. Accompany in target setup and support action plans definition. SUPPLY CHAIN STUDIES: Provide methodology, tools & expertise to conduct engineering and optimisation studies, on demand from the Maisons Supply Chains or other Group departments (e.g. Worldwide Logistics department) PROJECT MANAGEMENT: Manage key Supply Chain projects or programs, most often multi-domain and multi-Maisons, with a strong component of transformation and change management. Animate and elevate cross-functional teams to achieve project goals. INNOVATION Develop a network and connect with key industry players in the Supply Chain landscape, including specialised Supply Chain consulting firms, participate in forums and conferences. Collect and share competitive intelligence Be up to date on new trends and technologies available on the market. Assess new technologies that can contribute to enhancing & transformation of the Group Supply Chain. MANAGEMENT Inspire, lead and develop a team of Project Managers and of Business Process Owners. Animate a community of Supply Chain professionals at Maison and Group level to accelerate the co-construction of best practices. Foster collective intelligence. Plan and allocate resources effectively to meet department productivity and qualitative goals. Department management with the overall operational, budgetary, financial, HR responsibilities. Close partnership and collaboration with other Supply Chain Solutions Managers/Directors within GSCS department to ensure a full and integrated end-to-end SC approach/project. Promote Richemont Supply Chain inside & outside the Group. Develop internal and external Richemont SC awareness. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Senior supply chain professional with 15+ years of successful track record in in-house supply chain role or consulting in international matrix environments, with strengths in designing and implementing effective processes, and modern supply chain solutions at global level. Luxury/hard-luxury/Fashion business knowledge and experience Experience in leading end-to-end supply chain transformation programs and driving implementation of supply chain projects and processes. Strong leadership and management skills, including the capacity to articulate a vision, inspire, motivate, and develop talents. Excellent communication skills with the ability to animate and influence demanding stakeholders to foster collaboration, share and implement best practices, and drive continuous improvement. Service & result-oriented, capable of bringing a strategic vision and hands-on contribution to achieve your goals. Fluent in English, French is a plus. Experience with S4/HANA deployment a strong plus. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Upstream Supply Chain Project Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Supply Chain Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Supply Chain Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR130197 Richemont possiede alcuni dei principali prodotti di lusso Maisons, con particolare forza in gioielli, orologi pregiati e accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una orgogliosa tradizione di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maisons. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo a innovazione e progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in linea con i nostri valori Maisons. attraverso un processo di creatività continua. La vostra missione: Nella sua sfera di responsabilità, il Direttore di Supply Chain Solutions Downstream è responsabile dello sviluppo di un centro di competenza Supply Chain al servizio delle Maisons con gli obiettivi di: Gestire progetti di trasformazione end-to-end Supply Chain Planning e portare a valore aggiunto mirato l'esperienza di Supply Chain su richiesta ad hoc Maison.s Mantenere e sviluppare processi di Supply Chain Planning coerenti, efficienti e sostenibili in tutte le Maisons, Animate la Supply Chain Community all'interno del Gruppo relativa al suo flusso Il Supply Chain Solutions Director di Downstream svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione della catena di fornitura end-to-end del Gruppo Richemont e sarà con la sua organizzazione un contributo chiave per realizzare le ambizioni globali di Richemont. COME FARETE UN IMPATTO? FINE A FINE DELLE STRATEGIE DI FORNITURA TRASFORMAZIONE DELLA CHAINA DI FORNITURA: I progetti di trasformazione della Supply Chain Lead Downstream in stretta collaborazione con le Maisons e tutti gli stakeholder/interners/Group per garantire efficienza e agilità nella catena di fornitura per fornire una disponibilità ottimale al livello di stock ottimizzato e garantire un'elevata soddisfazione interna del cliente. Sostenere le Maisons nella definizione della loro strategia End-to-End Supply Chain e il loro piano di 3/5 anni associato per costruire una roadmap SC consolidata nel suo complesso. Sulla base di questa roadmap SC consolidata, costruire una roadmap di 3/5 anni relativa ai suoi flussi e promuovere questa roadmap all'interno dell'organizzazione Richemont per garantire una piena adesione e disponibilità delle risorse (risorse umane, budget IT,.) all'orizzonte della roadmap. Assicurare un'efficace implementazione della roadmap definita SUPPLY CHAIN AMBASSADOR: Act as ambassador of the Richemont Supply Chain Solutions dipartimentation. Creare e promuovere partnership positive e produttive con gli stakeholder di tutte le Maisons e del Gruppo. BEST PRATICHE E PROCESSI: Definire e gestire la Supply Chain Planning. best practices e garantirne la condivisione tra le Maisons. Co-build e garantire lo sviluppo di nuovi modelli e processi avanzati di Supply Chain in collaborazione con le funzioni Maisons & Group. PROMOTE OPERATIVE EXCELLENCE: Definire e condividere metriche comuni per monitorare le prestazioni della Downstream Supply Chain Planning delle Maisons. Accompagnare nella definizione di piani d'azione di setup e supporto. STUDI DELLA CHAIN DI FORNITURA: Fornire metodologia, strumenti e competenze per condurre studi di ingegneria e ottimizzazione, su richiesta delle catene di approvvigionamento Maisons o di altri dipartimenti del Gruppo (ad esempio, Dipartimento mondiale di logistica) GESTIONE DEL PROGETTO: Gestire progetti o programmi chiave della Supply Chain, spesso multi-dominio e multi-Maisons, con una forte componente di trasformazione e gestione del cambiamento. INNOVAZIONE Sviluppare una rete e connettersi con i principali attori del settore nel panorama Supply Chain, comprese le società specializzate di consulenza Supply Chain, partecipare a forum e conferenze. Raccogliere e condividere informazioni competitive Aggiornarsi sulle nuove tendenze e tecnologie disponibili sul mercato. Valutare nuove tecnologie che possono contribuire a migliorare e trasformare la Supply Chain di Gruppo. GESTIONE Incorrere, guidare e sviluppare un team di Project Manager e di Business Process Owners. Anima una comunità di professionisti della Supply Chain a livello di Maison e Gruppo per accelerare la co-costruzione delle best practice. Favorire l'intelligenza collettiva. Pianificare e allocare le risorse in modo efficace per soddisfare la produttività del reparto e gli obiettivi qualitativi. Gestione del dipartimento con le responsabilità operative, finanziarie, finanziarie e di HR. Chiudere la partnership e la collaborazione con altri Supply Chain Solutions Manager/Directors del reparto GSCS per garantire un approccio/progetto SC completo e integrato. Promuovere Richemont Supply Chain all'interno e all'esterno del Gruppo. Sviluppare la consapevolezza interna ed esterna di Richemont SC. COME ESPERIRETE SUCCESSO CON NOI? Senior supply chain professional con oltre 15 anni di successi nel ruolo della supply chain interna o nella consulenza in ambienti internazionali a matrice, con punti di forza nella progettazione e realizzazione di processi efficaci e moderne soluzioni di supply chain a livello globale. Conoscenze ed esperienze aziendali di lusso/hard-luxury/fashion Esperienza in programmi leader di trasformazione supply chain end-to-end e realizzazione di progetti e processi di supply chain. Forte capacità di leadership e management, compresa la capacità di articolare una visione, ispirare, il numero di persone, e sviluppare talenti. Ottime capacità di comunicazione con la capacità di animare e influenzare stakeholder esigenti per promuovere la collaborazione, condividere e implementare le migliori pratiche, e guidare il miglioramento continuo. Servizio e risultati, in grado di portare una visione strategica e un contributo pratico per raggiungere i vostri obiettivi. Fluente in inglese, francese è un plus. Esperienza con S4/HANA distribuzione un forte plus. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Lavori simili Upstream Supply Chain Project Stand Save Bellevue, Svizzera Richemont Supply Chain Stand Save Bellevue, Svizzera Richemont

Referenzcode: JR130197 Richemont besitzt einige der weltweit führenden Luxusartikel Maisons mit besonderen Stärken in Schmuck, feinen Uhren und Premium-Zubehör. Jedes Maison steht für eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerkskunst und Richemont versucht, das Erbe und die Identität jedes seiner Maisons zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig engagieren wir uns für Innovation und die Gestaltung neuer Produkte, die unseren Maisons entsprechen, Werte, durch einen Prozess der kontinuierlichen Kreativität. DEIN MISSION: Im Rahmen seiner
• Aufgaben ist der Downstream Supply Chain Solutions Director für die Entwicklung eines Supply Chain Kompetenzzentrums im Dienste der Maisons verantwortlich, mit dem Ziel: End-to-End Supply Chain planen Transformationsprojekte zu verwalten und gezieltes Know-how in der Supply Chain auf adhoc Maison zu bringen, die Anfragen zu halten und zu entwickeln konsistente, effiziente, nachhaltige Supply Chain Planungsprozesse in den Maisons, die Animieren der Supply Chain Community innerhalb der Gruppe im Zusammenhang mit ihrem/ihrem Stream Der Downstream Supply Chain Solutions Director Sie wird eine Schlüsselrolle bei der End-to-End-Versorgungskette-Transformation der Richemont-Gruppe spielen und mit ihrer/ihrer Organisation einen wichtigen Beitrag leisten, um die hohen Ziele von Richemont insgesamt zu erreichen. WIE WIRD MAN EINE AUSWIRKUNG ERHALTEN? ENTWICKLEN, DIE ABGABENSTRATEGIE VERSORGUNGSKAPITALUMSETZUNG ANZUFÜGEN: Lead Downstream Supply Chain Planung von Transformationsprojekten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Maisons und allen internen Stakeholdern/Gruppenfunktionen, um die Effizienz und Agilität der Lieferkette zu gewährleisten, um eine optimale Produktverfügbarkeit auf der optimierten Lagerebene zu gewährleisten und eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit zu gewährleisten. Unterstützen Sie die Maisons bei der Festlegung ihrer End-to-End Supply Chain Strategie und ihres damit verbundenen 3/5-Jahresplans, eine konsolidierte SC-Roadmap zu erstellen. Aufbauen Sie auf dieser konsolidierten SC Roadmap einen 3/5-Jahres-Fahrplan, der mit ihren/ihren Streams in Zusammenhang steht, und fördern Sie diesen Fahrplan innerhalb der Richemont Organisation, um eine vollständige Einhaltung und Verfügbarkeit von Ressourcen (Human Resources, IT Budget,...) am Fahrplanhorizont zu gewährleisten. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die definierte Roadmap SUPPLY CHAIN AMBASSADOR als Botschafter der Richemont Supply Chain Solutions Abteilung wirksam eingeführt wird. BESTE PRAKTIKEN & PROZESSE: Definieren und verwalten Sie die Supply Chain Planung « Best Practices » und gewährleisten Sie ihre gemeinsame Nutzung zwischen den Maisons. Co-Build und die Entwicklung neuer fortschrittlicher Supply Chain Modelle und Prozesse in Zusammenarbeit mit den Maisons & Group Funktionen. PROMOTE OPERATIONELLE AUSKUNFT: Definieren und gemeinsame Metriken, um die Leistung der Downstream Supply Chain Planung der Maisons zu überwachen. Animieren und erhöhen Sie funktionsübergreifende Teams, um Projektziele zu erreichen. jobs.description: Reference code: JR130276 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? You will work within Group Supply Chain Execution team to enrich the new Supply Chain Knowledge platform for Watch and Jewelry Maisons, interacting directly with them to build the right approach for publishing and enhancing Group Operating Model knowledge and ensuring W&J business continuity through it. You will be involved in various ongoing projects to be able to capitalize on documentation and allow the W&J knowledge to spread through the various Group Supply Chain actors in a more structured way and better user accessibility. Working in the close to the Swiss countryside right outside Fribourg, we offer an on-site restaurant, a beautiful setting, and a spacious open-plan working environment. jobs.description: Reference code: JR130267 Who are we? A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. ARE YOU A GOOD MATCH? You have a strong and relevant financial background. You have a good understanding and strong interest in HR topics. You act as a business partner with excellent communication skills. You have a team player attitude, and you like to work with different kinds of teams. Proactive and very agile, you like to propose in a challenging and innovative environment. You are structured, rigorous, problem-solving oriented and have good analytical skills. You have good IT knowledge (Excel and PowerPoint). You have interest in new financial tools. You speak French & English fluently WHAT ARE OUR EXPECTATIONS? Reporting to the Senior FP&A Manager, you will be in charge of Maison worldwide HR costs & FTEs consolidation and analysis and Support one specific region. In this function, you will: (1) Manage Maison worldwide HR costs & FTEs consolidation and analysis - Be responsible of the WW consolidation of FTEs & Personnel costs for Quarterly Rolling Forecast, Budget and 3Y plan (guidelines, drivers’ analysis, guarantee realism of projections, challenge market estimates, risks & opportunities). - Ensure accurate planning and reporting, particularly with HQ Team, Group Finance and Regional teams. - Analyze monthly reporting data vs expectations and define controlling KPI’s. - Responsible for filling in data in Richemont financial systems and communicating to HR counterpart all FTE related Group Financial guidelines. Also, you’ll participate in the Maison dashboard, workflows and tools’ evolution. - Follow remuneration scheme changes impact on financials. - Act as the main responsible for KPI’s/bonus simulation. (2) Business Partnering one specific region - Support all financial cycles (actuals, quarterly, forecasts, budget), assess business risks and opportunities, challenge overall assumptions and business performance. - Analyze investment requests and provide recommendations. MORE THAN A JOB...We recruit for a career! By joining Van Cleef & Arpels you will be part of a Maison where employee career development is at the heart of our ambition. Upon your arrival, you will be immersed into our enchanting world with trainings on our history, our know-how and our creations. THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS Send your application online. If your profile matches our search, you will be contacted by our HR team for an interview. Along the recruitment process you will meet the Senior FP&A Manager then the Controlling Director. Otherwise, you will receive an email to inform you that your application has not been successful. jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130302 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As the Group Talent Systems & Operations Manager, you will be a key member of the Group Talent team, reporting to the Group Talent Operations Senior Manager in Geneva. This role requires a strong blend of operational expertise and project coordination, focusing on managing initiatives related to talent and performance. Your primary mission will be to optimize our HR Talent systems, particularly Workday, from a business perspective, ensuring data integrity, driving efficiency, enhancing user experience, and providing expert support to the HR community, while actively contributing to and coordinating various projects that enhance our talent landscape. Key 
• Responsibilities: System Optimization & Project Coordination: Proactively identify opportunities and collaborate with cross functional and HRIS teams to coordinate and manage enhancement projects within Workday, focusing on improving functionality, efficiency, and user experience for Talent, Performance, and Development modules. Act as a primary point of contact and expert resource for the Talent community regarding Workday usage and optimization processes. Manage the effective resolution of system support needs by partnering with HRIS teams, including the escalation of complex or critical issues, and contribute to the planning and execution of system-related initiatives. Data Management & Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough and systematic testing of Talent, Performance, and Development processes and functionalities within Workday across various test environments, identifying bugs and verifying fixes to ensure smooth operation and data integrity. Assist in the implementation of new reports and analytics capabilities, coordinating with stakeholders to ensure they meet business requirements and provide reliable insights. Learning & Development Support & Communication: Proactively create, maintain, and update engaging e-learning materials (courses, videos, presentations) for HR Academy / NeverStopLearning, adapting to evolving needs and framework changes using tools such as EasyGenerator, Canva, and PowerPoint. Participate in communication efforts related to managing the talent optimization cycle (Talent, Performance, Development), ensuring clarity and engagement within the HR community. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You should have 10 years of international HR experience, with a strong focus on HR systems optimization (especially Workday), data quality, and operational support within Talent Management. You are autonomous, professional, and capable of driving system improvements. Required skills: Workday Expertise: Deep understanding and hands-on experience with Workday (Talent, Performance, Development modules) from a business perspective. Business-System Acumen: Ability to translate business needs into system requirements and collaborate with HRIS teams. Digital Savvy: Proficient in e-learning authoring tools (e.g., EasyGenerator, Canva, PowerPoint). Operational Excellence: Strong commitment to improving quality and efficiency of business and system processes. Problem-Solving & Proactivity: Analytical approach to identifying and resolving system anomalies and process inefficiencies. Project Management: Ability to coordinate and manage projects, contribute to larger initiatives, and manage multiple priorities effectively. Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent written and oral communication, with the ability to build relationships. Attention to Detail: Meticulous in content validation, system testing, and data quality assurance. Global Mindset: Experience in a global, matrixed environment. Language: Fluent in English, any other language is a plus. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet the people who will be crucial to your future success in the role. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs HRIS Specialist – CDD Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Group HR Reporting Manager Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Swiss Talent Acquisition Intern Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR130302 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di beni di lusso a livello mondiale, con particolare forza nella gioielleria, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta un'orgogliosa tradizione di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che siano in linea con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di creatività continua. COME AVRAI UN IMPATTO? In qualità di Group Talent Systems & Operations Manager, sarai un membro chiave del team Group Talent, riportando al Group Talent Operations Senior Manager a Ginevra. Questo ruolo richiede una forte combinazione di competenze operative e coordinamento dei progetti, concentrandosi sulla gestione di iniziative legate al talento e alle prestazioni. La tua missione principale sarà ottimizzare i nostri sistemi HR Talent, in particolare Workday, dal punto di vista aziendale, garantendo l'integrità dei dati, favorendo l'efficienza, migliorando l'esperienza dell'utente e fornendo supporto esperto alla comunità delle risorse umane, contribuendo attivamente e coordinando vari progetti che migliorano il nostro panorama dei talenti. Principali
• Responsabilità: ottimizzazione del sistema e coordinamento del progetto: identificare in modo proattivo le opportunità e collaborare con team interfunzionali e HRIS per coordinare e gestire progetti di miglioramento all'interno di Workday, concentrandosi sul miglioramento della funzionalità, dell'efficienza e dell'esperienza utente per i moduli Talento, Prestazioni e Sviluppo. Agire come punto di contatto primario e risorsa esperta per la community di talenti per quanto riguarda l'utilizzo e i processi di ottimizzazione di Workday. Gestire la risoluzione efficace delle esigenze di supporto del sistema collaborando con i team HRIS, inclusa l'escalation di problemi complessi o critici, e contribuire alla pianificazione e all'esecuzione di iniziative relative al sistema. Gestione dei dati e controllo della qualità: condurre test approfonditi e sistematici dei processi e delle funzionalità di talento, prestazioni e sviluppo all'interno di Workday in vari ambienti di test, identificando bug e verificando le correzioni per garantire il corretto funzionamento e l'integrità dei dati. Assistere nell'implementazione di nuovi report e funzionalità di analisi, coordinandosi con le parti interessate per garantire che soddisfino i requisiti aziendali e forniscano approfondimenti affidabili. Supporto e comunicazione per apprendimento e sviluppo: crea, mantieni e aggiorna in modo proattivo materiali di e-learning coinvolgenti (corsi, video, presentazioni) per HR Academy/NeverStopLearning, adattandoti alle esigenze in evoluzione e ai cambiamenti del quadro utilizzando strumenti come EasyGenerator, Canva e PowerPoint. Partecipare agli sforzi di comunicazione relativi alla gestione del ciclo di ottimizzazione del talento (Talent, Performance, Development), garantendo chiarezza e coinvolgimento all'interno della comunità HR. COME VIVRAI IL SUCCESSO CON NOI? Dovresti avere 10 anni di esperienza internazionale nelle risorse umane, con una forte attenzione all'ottimizzazione dei sistemi HR (in particolare Workday), alla qualità dei dati e al supporto operativo nell'ambito della gestione dei talenti. Sei autonomo, professionale e capace di apportare miglioramenti al sistema. Competenze richieste: Competenza in Workday: profonda conoscenza ed esperienza pratica con Workday (moduli Talento, Prestazioni, Sviluppo) dal punto di vista aziendale. Acume del sistema aziendale: capacità di tradurre le esigenze aziendali in requisiti di sistema e di collaborare con i team HRIS. Esperto digitale: esperto negli strumenti di creazione di e-learning (ad esempio EasyGenerator, Canva, PowerPoint). Eccellenza operativa: forte impegno per migliorare la qualità e l'efficienza dei processi aziendali e di sistema. Problem-Solving & Proattività: Approccio analitico per identificare e risolvere anomalie di sistema e inefficienze di processo. Gestione dei progetti: capacità di coordinare e gestire progetti, contribuire a iniziative più ampie e gestire più priorità in modo efficace. Abilità comunicative e interpersonali: eccellente comunicazione scritta e orale, con capacità di costruire relazioni. Attenzione ai dettagli: meticoloso nella convalida dei contenuti, nei test del sistema e nella garanzia della qualità dei dati. Mentalità globale: esperienza in un ambiente globale e a matrice. Lingua: inglese fluente, qualsiasi altra lingua costituisce titolo preferenziale. COSA RENDE DIVERSO IL NOSTRO GRUPPO? Il nostro vero potere non risiede nelle nostre somiglianze, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e capacità umane, nonché nella nostra capacità specifica di promuovere il potenziale non sfruttato. - Apprezziamo la libertà, la collegialità, la lealtà e la solidarietà. - Promuoviamo l'empatia, la curiosità, il coraggio, l'umiltà e l'integrità. - Ci prendiamo cura del mondo in cui viviamo. IL TUO VIAGGIO CON NOI Se la tua candidatura viene selezionata, ti contatteremo a breve per una chiamata introduttiva. Come parte del processo di colloquio, garantiamo sempre completa visione e trasparenza, ovvero avrai la possibilità di incontrare le persone che saranno cruciali per il tuo futuro successo nel ruolo. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Lavori simili HRIS Specialist – CDD Save Meyrin, Svizzera Richemont HR MANAGER - PEOPLE OPERATIONS Save Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR, Cina Richemont Senior Manager, Talent Corporate & Early Career, Cartier Save New York, Stati Uniti d'America Richemont

Referenzcode: JR130302 Richemont besitzt einige der weltweit führenden Luxusgüter-Maisons mit besonderen Stärken in den Bereichen Schmuck, edle Uhren und Premium-Accessoires. Jedes Maison repräsentiert eine stolze Tradition in Bezug auf Stil, Qualität und Handwerkskunst und Richemont ist bestrebt, das Erbe und die Identität jedes seiner Maisons zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig engagieren wir uns für Innovation und die Entwicklung neuer Produkte, die im Einklang mit den Werten unserer Maisons stehen, und zwar durch einen Prozess kontinuierlicher Kreativität. WIE KÖNNEN SIE EINE WIRKUNG ERZIELEN? Als Group Talent Systems & Operations Manager sind Sie ein wichtiges Mitglied des Group Talent Teams und berichten an den Group Talent Operations Senior Manager in Genf. Diese Rolle erfordert eine starke Mischung aus operativem Fachwissen und Projektkoordination, wobei der Schwerpunkt auf der Verwaltung von Initiativen im Zusammenhang mit Talent und Leistung liegt. Ihre Hauptaufgabe besteht darin, unsere HR-Talent-Systeme, insbesondere Workday, aus geschäftlicher Sicht zu optimieren, die Datenintegrität sicherzustellen, die Effizienz zu steigern, das Benutzererlebnis zu verbessern und der HR-Community fachkundigen Support zu bieten, während Sie gleichzeitig aktiv zu verschiedenen Projekten beitragen und diese koordinieren, die unsere Talentlandschaft verbessern. Hauptaufgaben •: Systemoptimierung und Projektkoordination: Proaktiv Chancen identifizieren und mit funktionsübergreifenden und HRIS-Teams zusammenarbeiten, um Verbesserungsprojekte innerhalb von Workday zu koordinieren und zu verwalten, wobei der Schwerpunkt auf der Verbesserung der Funktionalität, Effizienz und Benutzererfahrung für Talent-, Leistungs- und Entwicklungsmodule liegt. Fungieren Sie als Hauptansprechpartner und Expertenressource für die Talent-Community in Bezug auf Workday-Nutzung und Optimierungsprozesse. Helfen Sie bei der Implementierung neuer Berichts- und Analysefunktionen und stimmen Sie sich mit den Stakeholdern ab, um sicherzustellen, dass sie die Geschäftsanforderungen erfüllen und zuverlässige Erkenntnisse liefern. • Anforderungen und Rahmenänderungen an. Erforderliche Fähigkeiten: Workday-Expertise: Tiefes Verständnis und praktische Erfahrung mit Workday (Talent-, Performance-, Entwicklungsmodule) aus geschäftlicher Sicht. Geschäftssystem-Scharfsinn: Fähigkeit, Geschäftsanforderungen in Systemanforderungen umzusetzen und mit HRIS-Teams zusammenzuarbeiten. Digital versiert: Beherrscht E-Learning-Autorentools (z. B. EasyGenerator, Canva, PowerPoint). Operational Excellence: Starkes Engagement für die Verbesserung der Qualität und Effizienz von Geschäfts- und Systemprozessen. Problemlösung und Proaktivität: Analytischer Ansatz zur Identifizierung und Lösung von Systemanomalien und Prozessineffizienzen.
