jobs.description: Reference code: JR130552 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Votre Mission : En tant qu’Analyste Opérationnel, vous serez un pilier essentiel pour l’optimisation de nos processus, la fiabilité de nos opérations et le développement de nos équipes. Vous contribuerez activement au succès du département en identifiant les opportunités d’amélioration et en mettant en œuvre des solutions innovantes. Vos Responsabilités : Analyser les flux logistiques (réception, stockage, préparation, expédition, production), réduire les coûts et améliorer la qualité de service. Vous participerez activement à la mise en œuvre de ces améliorations et à la conduite du changement. Définir et optimiser l’organisation quotidienne, gérer la charge de travail, superviser la formation et la mise à jour des procédures. Vous encadrerez les nouveaux arrivants et contribuerez au plan de polyvalence. Vous agirez également comme un soutien clé et un backup pour le manager. Assurer un suivi rigoureux des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI), garantir la collaboration interdépartementale et agir en tant que référent métier et Key User sur votre périmètre d’expertise. Coordonner la préparation et l’exécution des inventaires et des processus de destruction, en garantissant la conformité réglementaire. Votre Profil : Solide compréhension des flux opérationnels et connaissance des principes d’amélioration continue (Lean, Six Sigma). Maîtrise des outils informatiques et des systèmes d’information (ERP SAP), ainsi que des outils avancés d’analyse de données (ex : Excel). Capacités analytiques avérées, excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration, proactivité, esprit d’initiative, force de proposition, rigueur et sens de l’organisation. La connaissance en gestion de projets est un atout. Votre Parcours : Diplôme en Supply Chain ou titre équivalent. Minimum 3 ans d’expérience significative dans un rôle similaire, avec une exposition à l’optimisation des processus, la gestion de projet et l’accompagnement d’équipes. jobs.title: CRM Project Manager
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130574 Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura. Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations. Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation. Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As the CRM Project Manager you will be the owner of CRM tools and solutions from a business perspective, ensuring their continuous evolution, strong market adoption, and effective usage to support client engagement and retention strategies. In this role you will be reporting to the CRM manager based in HQ. Key 
• Responsibilities: CRM Tools Product Ownership: Drive the evolution of our CRM tools (e.g., Clienteling, Salesforce Service Cloud, Looker), identifying business needs and translating them into clear improvement briefs. Prioritize enhancements, ensure timely delivery, and maintain high-quality user acceptance across markets. Identify and integrate new tools, features, and innovations, including AI scoring, defining concrete use cases and ensuring widespread adoption. Market Training & Support: Develop and update comprehensive training materials, guidelines, and best practices for CRM tools. Design and conduct onboarding programs for new CRM team members and provide ongoing market support, managing issue escalations. Coordinate and facilitate CRM community calls, setting agendas and documenting outcomes. Client Data & Insights: Maintain insightful dashboards for retail teams and top management, ensuring clear data performance visibility. Conduct regular client analysis, translating business insights into data-driven action plans. Monitor and enhance data quality, completeness, and enrichment across all markets. Collaborate closely with Regions, Marketing, Retail, Commercial, Customer Service, and key Maison stakeholders to fuel business growth. Client Retention Programs: Define and structure client retention program guidelines, ensuring effective cascade and implementation across markets. Translate strategic objectives into actionable client treatment journeys within available CRM tools. Client Engagement in Partner Network: Define and prioritize client engagement strategies (e.g., data capture, client activations) for our partner network. Collaborate with CRM and partner retail teams to implement these strategies and monitor performance using key CRM KPIs. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Minimum 5 years’ experience in Client, Retail, CRM, Clienteling, and / or digital product management (in luxury sector is a plus) Expertise in Salesforce on several products and clienteling app Excellent project management and organizational skills with high attention to detail Strong ability to translate business needs into clear digital requirements and digital capabilities into business use cases Data centric, proactive, solution-oriented, agile, and innovative Experience in a market’s CRM or retail roles is a plus Fluent in English and French, any other language is a plus STILL WONDERING WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY? A Welcoming Team: Join our friendly, open-minded, and talented team, where your skills will be valued and your contributions will make a real difference. Dynamic and Engaging Work: Experience daily activities that are interesting, challenging, and diverse, keeping you engaged and motivated. Investment in Your Growth: We are passionate about developing our people, and you will have access to various training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. The Piaget culture of encouraging Extra-Care, fostering Mastery and bringing out the Extraordinary in our people, means that we will always go further, doing “what has never been done before”. Together. If you want to become a part of it do not hesitate to apply! descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR130574 Circondato dalla sua famiglia e guidato dalla sua forte mentalità imprenditoriale, Georges-Edouard Piaget decise, nel 1874, di creare un'officina orologiera a La Côte-aux-Fées, un piccolo villaggio al centro delle montagne svizzere della Giura. Da quel giorno, Piaget ha spinto i limiti a “fare ciò che non è mai stato fatto prima” e artigianale orologi sofisticati e fiammeggianti e creazioni di gioielli. All’interno delle mura dei nostri Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, i nostri maestri artigiani continuano a sfruttare rare abilità che sono state conservate e perfezionate di generazione in generazione. Oggi, l’eccezionale maestria di Piaget è celebrata in tutto il mondo, sostenuta da una forte presenza globale e da una rete dedicata di supporto clienti e colleghi retail che portano lo spirito della nostra Maison alla vita ogni giorno. Come fai a fare un'infezione? Come CRM Project Manager sarete il proprietario di strumenti e soluzioni CRM da una prospettiva di business, garantendo la loro continua evoluzione, forte adozione di mercato, e un utilizzo efficace per supportare le strategie di coinvolgimento e di ritenzione del cliente. In questo ruolo verrà segnalato al CRM manager con sede nel quartier generale. Chiave
• Responsabilità: CRM Tools ProprietÃ del prodotto: Guidare l'evoluzione dei nostri strumenti CRM (ad esempio, Clienteling, Salesforce Service Cloud, Looker), identificare le esigenze aziendali e tradurli in chiari brief di miglioramento. Miglioramenti prioritari, garantire la consegna tempestiva e mantenere l'accettazione utente di alta qualità sui mercati. Identificare e integrare nuovi strumenti, caratteristiche e innovazioni, tra cui il punteggio AI, definendo casi di uso concreto e garantendo un'adozione diffusa. Market Training & Support: Sviluppare e aggiornare materiali di formazione completi, linee guida e migliori pratiche per gli strumenti CRM. Progettazione e conduzione di programmi di bordo per i nuovi membri del team CRM e fornire supporto di mercato in corso, gestione escalation dei problemi. Coordinare e facilitare le chiamate della comunità del CRM, impostare gli ordini del giorno e documentare i risultati. Dati cliente & informazioni: Mantenere cruscotti intuitivi per i team di vendita al dettaglio e la massima gestione, garantendo una chiara visibilità delle prestazioni dei dati. Condurre analisi client regolari, traducendo intuizioni aziendali nei piani di azione basati sui dati. Monitorare e migliorare la qualità dei dati, la completezza e l'arricchimento in tutti i mercati. Collabora a stretto contatto con Regioni, Marketing, Retail, Commerciale, Servizio Clienti e le principali parti interessate della Maison per alimentare la crescita del business. Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations. Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation. Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As the CRM Project Manager you will be the owner of CRM tools and solutions from a business perspective, ensuring their continuous evolution, strong market adoption, and effective usage to support client engagement and retention strategies. In this role you will be reporting to the CRM manager based in HQ. Key 
• Responsibilities: CRM Tools Product Ownership: Drive the evolution of our CRM tools (e.g., Clienteling, Salesforce Service Cloud, Looker), identifying business needs and translating them into clear improvement briefs. Prioritize enhancements, ensure timely delivery, and maintain high-quality user acceptance across markets. Identify and integrate new tools, features, and innovations, including AI scoring, defining concrete use cases and ensuring widespread adoption. Market Training & Support: Develop and update comprehensive training materials, guidelines, and best practices for CRM tools. Design and conduct onboarding programs for new CRM team members and provide ongoing market support, managing issue escalations. Coordinate and facilitate CRM community calls, setting agendas and documenting outcomes. Client Data & Insights: Maintain insightful dashboards for retail teams and top management, ensuring clear data performance visibility. Conduct regular client analysis, translating business insights into data-driven action plans. Monitor and enhance data quality, completeness, and enrichment across all markets. Collaborate closely with Regions, Marketing, Retail, Commercial, Customer Service, and key Maison stakeholders to fuel business growth. Client Retention Programs: Define and structure client retention program guidelines, ensuring effective cascade and implementation across markets. Translate strategic objectives into actionable client treatment journeys within available CRM tools. Client Engagement in Partner Network: Define and prioritize client engagement strategies (e.g., data capture, client activations) for our partner network. Collaborate with CRM and partner retail teams to implement these strategies and monitor performance using key CRM KPIs. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Minimum 5 years’ experience in Client, Retail, CRM, Clienteling, and / or digital product management (in luxury sector is a plus) Expertise in Salesforce on several products and clienteling app Excellent project management and organizational skills with high attention to detail Strong ability to translate business needs into clear digital requirements and digital capabilities into business use cases Data centric, proactive, solution-oriented, agile, and innovative Experience in a market’s CRM or retail roles is a plus Fluent in English and French, any other language is a plus STILL WONDERING WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY? jobs.description: Reference code: JR130671 Analytics Engineer – Operations transformation Plan-les-Ouates Fixed-term contract 12 months FOR THOSE WHO WELCOME CONNECTION Join a highly connected community where individual expertise and shared experience combine across disciplines to spark fresh ideas and keep us moving forwards. Play your part in driving our collective success. YOUR ROLE An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Analytics Engineer to join our Operations Department on a 12-month fixed-term contract as part of a Data Transformation Program. This role involves migrating our analytics stack from Power BI to a modern GCP-based platform (dbt, BigQuery, Looker). You will collect, analyze, and validate complex Operational and Manufacturing data, develop Looker visualizations, and translate legacy data into future-ready tools to provide crucial business insights and drive continuous improvement. A proactive, analytical, and communicative approach is essential. PLAYING YOUR PART Data Reporting & Engineering Support: contribute to the dbt/Looker migration, building BigQuery data models, developing Looker Explores, and delivering dashboards. Design and enhance interactive dashboards, translating complex Manufacturing and Operations data into actionable insights. Responsible for data collection, cleaning, validation, and modelling. Stakeholder Collaboration & Strategic Impact: partner with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, deliver high-quality solutions, and contribute to the data analytics project roadmap, ensuring alignment with business objectives. Data Quality & Governance: pphold rigorous standards for data accuracy, integrity, and governance. Implement robust data validation, document reporting logic and definitions, and ensure adherence to data policies and legislation. Process Optimisation & Continuous Improvement: identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement through data-driven analysis. Develop strategies to optimise operations, reduce costs, and enhance efficiency, fostering continuous improvement. Data Storytelling & Communication: effectively communicate complex data findings and insights to diverse audiences via compelling visualisations and clear narratives, enabling informed, data-driven decisions. WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL? Success in this role will require: Master’s degree in Data, Engineering, Business Intelligence, or equivalent experience Good understanding of reporting and analytics processes; Supply Chain and, or Manufacturing Proficiency in advanced analytics tools (e.g. Looker, SQL, Data modelling, BigQuery, Jira, PowerBi..) Ownership mindset, stakeholder management, clear communication, adaptability Excellent communication skills in English and French Vacheron Constantin celebrates 270 years as the world’s oldest watchmaker in continuous production since 1755. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, we operate a global retail network of nearly 200 points of sale across 36 countries. Every member of our exceptional global community of watchmakers, artisans and dedicated professionals share a common devotion to our exceptional heritage and a passion to trailblaze an even brighter future. If this fires your imagination, we welcome your application. IMPIEGO DI TUA PARTE Data Reporting & Engineering Support: contribuire alla migrazione dbt/Looker, costruire modelli di dati BigQuery, sviluppare Looker Esplora e fornire dashboard. Progettare e migliorare cruscotti interattivi, tradurre i dati complessi di produzione e operazioni in insight attuabili. Responsabile per la raccolta, la pulizia, la validazione e la modellazione dei dati. Stakeholder Collaboration & Strategic Impact: partner con gli stakeholder per comprendere le esigenze di reportistica, fornire soluzioni di alta qualità e contribuire alla roadmap del progetto di analisi dei dati, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali. Qualità dei dati & Governance: pphold standard rigorosi per l'accuratezza dei dati, l'integrità e la governance. Implementare la validazione robusta dei dati, documentare la logica e le definizioni, e garantire l'adesione alle politiche e alla legislazione dei dati. Ottimizzazione dei processi e miglioramento continuo: identificare inefficienze e aree di miglioramento attraverso l'analisi basata sui dati. Sviluppare strategie per ottimizzare le operazioni, ridurre i costi e migliorare l'efficienza, favorendo il miglioramento continuo. Data Storytelling & Communication: comunicare in modo efficace i risultati dei dati complessi e le intuizioni ai diversi pubblico attraverso visualizzazioni convincenti e chiare narrazioni, consentendo decisioni informate e basate sui dati. Cosa ti fara' perdonare? Il successo in questo ruolo richiederà: laurea magistrale in Dati, Ingegneria, Business Intelligence o esperienza equivalente Buona comprensione dei processi di reportistica e analisi; Supply Chain e, o Manufacturing Proficiency negli strumenti avanzati di analisi (ad esempio Looker, SQL, Data Modelling, BigQuery, Jira, PowerBi.) Mindset di proprietà, gestione delle parti interessate, comunicazione chiara, adattabilità Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese e francese Vacheron Constantin festeggia 270 anni come orologiaio più antico del mondo in produzione continua dal 1755. Con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, gestiamo una rete globale di vendita al dettaglio di quasi 200 punti vendita in 36 paesi. Ogni membro della nostra eccezionale comunità globale di orologiai, artigiani e professionisti dedicati condividono una comune devozione al nostro patrimonio eccezionale e alla passione per la sciabola di un futuro ancora più luminoso. Se questo accende la vostra immaginazione, accogliamo la vostra applicazione. Data Quality & Governance: strenge Standards für Datengenauigkeit, Integrität und Governance einhalten. Implementieren Sie eine robuste Datenvalidierung, dokumentieren Sie Berichtslogik und Definitionen und stellen Sie die Einhaltung von Datenrichtlinien und -gesetzen sicher. Prozessoptimierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Ineffizienzen und Verbesserungsbereiche durch datengesteuerte Analyse identifizieren. Entwicklung von Strategien zur Optimierung des Betriebs, zur Senkung der Kosten und zur Steigerung der Effizienz, um kontinuierliche Verbesserungen zu fördern. Data Storytelling & Kommunikation: Komplexe Datenergebnisse und Erkenntnisse über überzeugende Visualisierungen und klare Narrative effektiv an unterschiedliche Zielgruppen kommunizieren und so fundierte, datengesteuerte Entscheidungen ermöglichen. Was macht dich erfolgreich? Der Erfolg in dieser Rolle erfordert: Master-Abschluss in Data, Engineering, Business Intelligence oder gleichwertige Erfahrung Gutes Verständnis von Berichts- und Analyseprozessen; Supply Chain und oder Fertigungskompetenz in fortgeschrittenen Analysetools (z. B. Looker, SQL, Datenmodellierung, BigQuery, Jira, PowerBi..) Ownership Mindset, Stakeholder Management, klare Kommunikation, Anpassungsfähigkeit Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und Französisch Vacheron Constantin feiert 270 Jahre als ältester Uhrmacher der Welt in kontinuierlicher Produktion seit 1755. Mit Hauptsitz in Genf, Schweiz, betreiben wir ein globales Einzelhandelsnetzwerk mit fast 200 Verkaufsstellen in 36 Ländern. Jedes Mitglied unserer außergewöhnlichen globalen Gemeinschaft von Uhrmachern, Handwerkern und engagierten Fachleuten teilt eine gemeinsame Hingabe an unser außergewöhnliches Erbe und die Leidenschaft, eine noch bessere Zukunft zu gestalten. Wenn dies Ihre Fantasie anregt, begrüßen wir Ihre Bewerbung. descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence: JR130671 Ingénieur Analytique – Transformation des Opérations Plan-les-Ouates Contrat à durée déterminée 12 mois POUR LES BIENVENUES Rejoignez une communauté très connectée où l'expertise individuelle et l'expérience partagée se combinent entre disciplines pour susciter de nouvelles idées et nous faire avancer. Jouez votre rôle dans la conduite de notre succès collectif. Votre rôle Une occasion passionnante s'est présentée pour qu'un ingénieur en analyse rejoigne notre département des opérations dans le cadre d'un contrat à durée déterminée de 12 mois dans le cadre d'un programme de transformation des données. Ce rôle consiste à migrer notre pile analytique de Power BI vers une plate-forme moderne basée sur GCP (dbt, BigQuery, Looker). Vous recueillerez, analyserez et validerez des données opérationnelles et manufacturières complexes, développerez des visualisations de Looker et traduireez les données héritées en outils prêts à l'avenir pour fournir des informations opérationnelles cruciales et favoriser une amélioration continue. Une approche proactive, analytique et communicative est essentielle. PLAYING VOS PARty Data Reporting & Engineering Support: contribuez à la migration dbt/Looker, construisez des modèles de données BigQuery, développez Looker Explores et livrez des tableaux de bord. Concevoir et améliorer des tableaux de bord interactifs, en transformant les données complexes sur la fabrication et l'exploitation en informations pratiques. Responsable de la collecte, du nettoyage, de la validation et de la modélisation des données. Collaboration des intervenants et impact stratégique : partenariat avec les intervenants pour comprendre les besoins en matière de rapports, fournir des solutions de haute qualité et contribuer à la feuille de route du projet d'analyse des données, en assurant l'harmonisation avec les objectifs opérationnels. Qualité et gouvernance des données : des normes rigoureuses pour l'exactitude, l'intégrité et la gouvernance des données. Mettre en oeuvre une solide validation des données, documenter la logique de déclaration et les définitions, et assurer le respect des politiques et des lois en matière de données. Optimisation des processus et amélioration continue : identifier les inefficacités et les domaines à améliorer grâce à une analyse axée sur les données. Élaborer des stratégies pour optimiser les opérations, réduire les coûts et améliorer l'efficacité, en favorisant une amélioration continue. Récapitulatif et communication des données: communiquer efficacement les constatations et les idées complexes des données à divers publics par des visualisations convaincantes et des récits clairs, permettant des décisions éclairées et axées sur les données. Qu'est-ce qui vous fera réussir ? Le succès de ce rôle exigera : un Master en Data, Engineering, Business Intelligence, ou une expérience équivalente.Une bonne compréhension des processus de reporting et d'analyse. L'esprit de propriété, la gestion des intervenants, la communication claire, l'adaptabilité Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et en français Vacheron Constantin célèbre 270 ans comme le plus ancien horloger du monde en production continue depuis 1755. Basé à Genève, en Suisse, nous exploitons un réseau mondial de détail de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté mondiale exceptionnelle d'horlogers, d'artisans et de professionnels dévoués partagent une dévotion commune à notre patrimoine exceptionnel et une passion pour faire briller un avenir encore plus brillant. Si cela déclenche votre imagination, nous accueillons votre application. jobs.description: Reference code: JR130749 Who are we? A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. Based in Geneva ARE YOU A GOOD MATCH? You have a strong and relevant financial background. You act as a business partner with excellent communication skills. You have a team player attitude, and you like to work with different kinds of teams. Proactive and very agile, you like to propose in a challenging and innovative environment. You are structured, rigorous, problem-solving oriented and have good analytical skills. You have good IT knowledge (Excel and PowerPoint, BI). You speak French & English fluently WHAT ARE OUR EXPECTATIONS? The Senior Operations Controller is a strategic finance partner supporting the Operations departments. He/she drives financial planning, reporting, and performance analysis across operations, while supporting transversal topics such as costing, margin analysis, CAPEX and digital transformation. He/She will also have the mission of establishing, developing and leading the new Customer Service Controlling activity. He/She will report to the Operations Performance Controlling Senior Manager. In this function, you will: Business Partner Operations - Act as the financial business partner to Operations departments (Stones, Purchasing, Innovation, Logistics, etc.) - Produce and analyze consolidated reporting for Operations departments - Ensure reliability and ownership of financial data - Deliver insightful analysis on performance, trends, and risks Operations & Métiers Reporting - Consolidate all financial information related to Operations & Métiers department - Ensure data quality, participate in data collection process improvement - Participate in the elaboration of a "control tower" view of the Operations & Métiers department Controlling leadership for Customer Service - Establish, develop, and lead the controlling function for the Customer Service division, which is currently non-existent in close collaboration with our Retail Customer Service department - Define and implement comprehensive financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes specifically tailored for Customer Service. - Provide in-depth financial analysis of Customer Service performance, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities to support strategic decision-making. - Define and monitor KPIs for Customer Service, ensuring the achievement of financial objectives. B&O and Purchases Controlling - Establish, develop and lead the controlling of the O&M Real Estate cost by ensuring a full understanding of our costs, making sure benchmarks and best practices are clear for stakeholders - Be the single-entry point of contact for Indirect Purchases, both for VCA and Group Controlling Digital & Reporting Transformation - Drive reporting improvements and automation initiatives - Participate in deployment of reporting tools (e.g., Looker, dashboards) - Anticipate business needs and propose innovative solutions MORE THAN A JOB...We recruit for a career! By joining Van Cleef & Arpels you will be part of a Maison where employee career development is at the heart of our ambition. Upon your arrival, you will be immersed into our enchanting world with training on our history, our know-how and our creations. THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS Send your application online. If your profile matches our search, you will be contacted by our HR team for an interview. Along the recruitment process you will meet the Controlling Manager then the Controlling Director. Otherwise, you will receive an email to inform you that your application has not been successful. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR130749 Chi siamo? Una Maison di alta gioielleria con un patrimonio forte che promuove un know-how eccezionale in un ambiente incantevole e creativo. La nostra Maison è alla ricerca di persone di talento che contribuiscono a sviluppare e trasmettere le loro competenze con cura e senza compromessi. A Van Cleef & Arpels sarete circondati da esperti appassionati e contribuirà a numerosi nuovi progetti che permettono alla nostra Maison di reinventarsi regolarmente. A Van Cleef & Arpels, siamo orgogliosi di assumere talenti da diversi background ed esperienze. Crediamo che quando la diversità e l'inclusione sono pienamente abbracciati e potenziati, la creatività e la conoscenza emergono per offrire l'eccellenza. Con sede a Ginevra sei una buona malattia? Hai un background finanziario forte e rilevante. Si comporta come un partner commerciale con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione. Hai un atteggiamento da giocatore di squadra, e ti piace lavorare con diversi tipi di squadre. Proattivo e molto agile, ti piace proporre in un ambiente stimolante e innovativo. Sei strutturato, rigoroso, orientato alla risoluzione dei problemi e hai buone capacità analitiche. Hai una buona conoscenza IT (Excel e PowerPoint, BI). Parli francese e inglese fluentemente che cosa sono le nostre aspettative? Il Senior Operations Controller è un partner finanziario strategico che supporta i dipartimenti Operazioni. Guida la pianificazione finanziaria, il reporting e l'analisi delle prestazioni attraverso le operazioni, mentre supporta argomenti trasversali come costi, analisi dei margini, CAPEX e trasformazione digitale. Egli avrà anche la missione di stabilire, sviluppare e guidare la nuova attività di Customer Service Controlling. Lui/She riferirà al Direttore Senior Operations Performance Controlling. In questa funzione, l'utente: Business Partner Operations - Act as the financial business partner to Operations services (Stones, Purchasing, Innovation, Logistics, ecc.) - Produrre e analizzare report consolidati per i dipartimenti Operativi - Assicurare l'affidabilità e la proprietà dei dati finanziari - Fornire analisi approfondite su performance, tendenze e rischi - Fornire un'analisi finanziaria approfondita delle prestazioni del Servizio Clienti, identificare tendenze, rischi e opportunità per sostenere il processo decisionale strategico. - Definire e monitorare i KPI per il Servizio Clienti, garantendo il raggiungimento degli obiettivi finanziari. B&O e Purchases Controlling - Stabilire, sviluppare e guidare il controllo del costo O&M Real Estate assicurando una piena comprensione dei nostri costi, assicurandosi che i benchmark e le best practice siano chiari per gli stakeholder - Essere il punto di contatto unico per gli acquisti indiretti, sia per VCA e Gruppo Controllo Digital & Reporting Transformation - Drive reporting miglioramenti e iniziative di automazione - Partecipare alla distribuzione di strumenti di reportistica (ad esempio, Looker, dashboard) - Anticipate esigenze aziendali e proporre soluzioni innovative Più THAN A JOB...Noi reclutamo per una carriera! Entrando in Van Cleef & Arpels sarete parte di una Maison in cui lo sviluppo della carriera dei dipendenti è al centro della nostra ambizione. Al vostro arrivo, sarete immersi nel nostro mondo incantevole con la formazione sulla nostra storia, il nostro know-how e le nostre creazioni. PROCESSO DI RICERCA Invia la tua richiesta online. Se il tuo profilo corrisponde alla nostra ricerca, sarai contattato dal nostro team HR per un'intervista. Lungo il processo di reclutamento incontrerete il Controlling Manager e il Controlling Director. Altrimenti, riceverai un'email per informarti che la tua applicazione non ha avuto successo. descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence: JR130749 Qui sommes-nous ? Une Maison de Haute Joaillerie avec un patrimoine fort qui promeut un savoir-faire exceptionnel dans un environnement enchanteur et créatif. Notre Maison recherche des personnes talentueuses qui contribuent au développement et à la transmission de leur expertise avec soin et sans compromis. Chez Van Cleef & Arpels, vous serez entourés d'experts passionnés et contribuerez à de nombreux nouveaux projets qui permettront à notre Maison de se réinventer régulièrement. Chez Van Cleef & Arpels, nous sommes fiers d'embaucher des talents de différents horizons et expériences. Nous croyons que lorsque la diversité et l'inclusion sont pleinement acceptées et habilitées, la créativité et le savoir émergent pour assurer l'excellence. Vous êtes basé à Genève, vous êtes une bonne personne ? Vous avez un contexte financier solide et pertinent. Vous agissez en tant que partenaire d'affaires avec d'excellentes compétences en communication. Vous avez une attitude de joueur d'équipe et vous aimez travailler avec différents types d'équipes. Proactive et très agile, vous aimez vous proposer dans un environnement stimulant et innovant. Vous êtes structuré, rigoureux, orienté vers la résolution de problèmes et avez de bonnes compétences analytiques. Vous avez de bonnes connaissances en TI (Excel et PowerPoint, BI). Vous parlez couramment le français et l'anglais Quelles sont nos attentes? Le contrôleur principal des opérations est un partenaire financier stratégique qui appuie les départements opérationnels. Il dirige la planification financière, l'établissement de rapports et l'analyse du rendement dans l'ensemble des opérations, tout en appuyant des sujets transversaux comme l'établissement des coûts, l'analyse de la marge, le CAPEX et la transformation numérique. Il/elle aura également la mission d'établir, de développer et de diriger la nouvelle activité de contrôle du service à la clientèle. Il relèvera du gestionnaire principal chargé du contrôle du rendement des opérations. Dans cette fonction, vous devrez : Opérations des partenaires d'affaires - Agir en tant que partenaire d'affaires financière des départements des Opérations (Stones, Achats, Innovation, Logistique, etc.) - Produire et analyser des rapports consolidés pour les départements des Opérations - Assurer la fiabilité et la propriété des données financières - Fournir une analyse perspicace sur le rendement, les tendances et les risques Opérations et Métiers Reporting - Consolider toute l'information financière liée au département des Opérations et Métiers - Assurer la qualité des données, participer à l'amélioration du processus de collecte de données - Participer à l'élaboration d'une vue « tour de contrôle » du département des Opérations et Métiers Contrôler le leadership du service à la clientèle - Établir, développer et diriger la fonction de contrôle du service à la clientèle, qui est actuellement inexistante en étroite collaboration avec notre service à la clientèle - Définir et mettre en oeuvre des processus complets de planification financière, de budgétisation, de prévision et de rapport spécifiquement adaptés au service à la clientèle. - Fournir une analyse financière approfondie du rendement du service à la clientèle, en identifiant les tendances, les risques et les occasions d'appuyer la prise de décisions stratégiques. - Définir et surveiller les ICR pour le service à la clientèle, en assurant la réalisation des objectifs financiers. B&O et achats Contrôle - Établir, élaborer et diriger le contrôle des coûts immobiliers de F&M en assurant une compréhension complète de nos coûts, en veillant à ce que les points de repère et les pratiques exemplaires soient clairs pour les intervenants - Soyez le point de contact unique pour les Achats Indirects, à la fois pour VCA et le Contrôle de Groupe Transformation Digitale & Reporting - Inclure des améliorations de rapports et des initiatives d'automatisation - Participer au déploiement d'outils de reporting (par exemple, Looker, tableaux de bord) - Anticiper les besoins des entreprises et proposer des solutions innovantes PLUS QU'UN JOB...Nous recrutons pour une carrière! En vous joignant à Van Cleef & Arpels, vous ferez partie d'une Maison où le développement de carrière des employés est au cœur de notre ambition. À votre arrivée, vous serez immergés dans notre monde enchanteur avec une formation sur notre histoire, notre savoir-faire et nos créations. PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT Envoyez votre demande en ligne. Si votre profil correspond à notre recherche, nous vous contacterons pour une entrevue. Au cours du processus de recrutement, vous rencontrerez le gestionnaire de contrôle puis le directeur de contrôle. Sinon, vous recevrez un courriel pour vous informer que votre demande n'a pas été retenue. jobs.description: Reference code: JR130691 BUSINESS PERFORMANCE INTERN Internship – 6 months, as of August 17 or September 1, 2026 With internship agreement (convention de stage) Plan-les-Ouates FOR THOSE WHO SEEK EXCELLENCE Join one of the most respected Maisons in fine watchmaking where excellence is both a given and a never-ending quest. Play your part in driving our collective success. YOUR ROLE We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented and analytical Business Performance Intern to join our dynamic team. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to business planning, forecasting, performance reporting and data analysis activities within an international luxury environment, providing exposure and cross-functional collaboration across HQ and regional teams. The successful candidate will be eager to learn, possess strong analytical skills, and be proficient in supporting various operational and strategic initiatives. PLAYING YOUR PART BUSINESS PLANNING & FORECASTING You will support the preparation and consolidation of monthly forecasting cycles, budget and strategic plans You will perform data validation and consistency checks, to identify missing information, or inconsistencies before review You will prepare planning templates, trackers and supporting documentation to facilitate forecasting and business planning activities PERFORMANCE REPORTING & ANALYSIS You will prepare recurring analyses to support performance monitoring and provide the analytical foundation for business reviews and performance discussions You will perform first-level variance analyses to identify significant business trends, anomalies and potential performance drivers, highlighting key observations for further review You will prepare charts, tables, and data visualizations for leadership presentations and performance reviews DATA & REPORTING You will support the maintenance and continuous improvement of reporting tools and dashboards You will participate in testing and validating new reports and dashboards developed in Looker You will support the identification of opportunities to automate manual reporting activities and improve reporting efficiency WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL? Success in this role will require: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering or similar A strong interest in commercial performance, business planning and analytics Proven ability to analyze large datasets, identify trends and generate actionable insights Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, knowledge of BI tools (Looker, Power BI, Tableau) is a plus Proactive, enthusiastic, curious and agile personality A collaborative spirit, excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work with multiple stakeholders Fluency in English and French, other languages are a plus Vacheron Constantin celebrates 270 years as the world’s oldest watchmaker in continuous production since 1755. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, we operate a global retail network of nearly 200 points of sale across 36 countries. Every member of our exceptional global community of watchmakers, artisans and dedicated professionals share a common devotion to our exceptional heritage and a passion to trailblaze an even brighter future. If this fires your imagination, we welcome your application. Codice di riferimento: JR130691 BUSINESS PERFORMANCE INTERN Internship – 6 mesi, dal 17 agosto o dal 1 settembre 2026 Con accordo di stage (convention de stage) Plan-les-Ouates for THOSE WHO SEEK EXCELLENCE Unisciti a una delle Maison più rispettate nell'orologeria dove l'eccellenza è una data e una ricerca senza fine. Gioca la tua parte nel guidare il nostro successo collettivo. Il tuo!
• Stiamo cercando un Interno Business Performance altamente motivato, orientato al dettaglio e analitico per unire il nostro team dinamico. Questo ruolo offre un'opportunità unica per contribuire alle attività di pianificazione aziendale, previsione, reportistica delle prestazioni e analisi dei dati all'interno di un ambiente di lusso internazionale, fornendo esposizione e collaborazione interfunzionale tra team HQ e regionali. Il candidato di successo sarà ansioso di imparare, possedere forti competenze analitiche, ed essere abile nel sostenere varie iniziative operative e strategiche. Pianificare la vostra parte BUSINESS PLANNING & FORECASTING Sosterrai la preparazione e il consolidamento di cicli di previsione mensili, budget e piani strategici Effettuerai controlli di convalida e coerenza dei dati, per identificare le informazioni mancanti o le incongruenze prima della recensione Potrai preparare modelli di pianificazione, tracker e documentazione di supporto per facilitare le attività di previsione e pianificazione aziendale Potrai preparare analisi ricorrenti per supportare il monitoraggio delle prestazioni e fornire le basi analitiche per recensioni aziendali e discussioni sulle prestazioni Effettuerai analisi di varianza di primo livello per identificare significative tendenze aziendali, anomalie e potenziali driver di performance, evidenziando le osservazioni chiave per ulteriori recensioni preparerai grafici, tabelle e visualizzazioni dei dati per presentazioni di leadership e recensioni sulle prestazioni Supporterete la manutenzione e il miglioramento continuo degli strumenti di segnalazione e delle dashboard Parteciperai a testare e convalidare nuovi report e dashboard sviluppati in Looker Sosterrai l'identificazione delle opportunità per automatizzare le attività di reportistica manuale e migliorare l'efficienza di reportistica COSA MAGGIO SUCCESSFUL? Il successo in questo ruolo richiederà: laurea o Master in Business Administration, finanza, economia, ingegneria o simili Un forte interesse per le prestazioni commerciali, pianificazione aziendale e analisi Prove capacità di analizzare grandi dataset, identificare le tendenze e generare intuizioni attuabili Avanzata competenza in Microsoft Office Suite, conoscenza di strumenti BI (Looker, Power BI, Tableau) è un plus Proattivo, entusiasta, interessato e agile personalità Ative collaborative Con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, gestiamo una rete globale di vendita al dettaglio di quasi 200 punti vendita in 36 paesi. Ogni membro della nostra eccezionale comunità globale di orologiai, artigiani e professionisti dedicati condividono una comune devozione al nostro patrimonio eccezionale e alla passione per la sciabola di un futuro ancora più luminoso. Se questo accende la vostra immaginazione, accogliamo la vostra applicazione. descriptionByLocale.de: Referenzcode: JR130691 BUSINESS PERFORMANCE INTERN Internship – 6 Monate, ab 17. August oder 1. September 2026 Mit Praktikumsvertrag (convention de stage) Plan-les-Ouates FÜR DIE, DIE SEEK EXCELLENCE Schließen Sie sich einer der angesehensten Maisons in der feinen Uhrmacherei an, in der Exzellenz sowohl eine gegebene als auch eine nie endende Aufgabe ist. Tragen Sie dazu bei, unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg voranzutreiben. IHR ROLLE Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten, detailorientierten und analytischen Business Performance Praktikanten, der sich unserem dynamischen Team anschließt. Diese Rolle bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, zur Geschäftsplanung, Prognose, Leistungsberichterstattung und Datenanalyse in einem internationalen Luxusumfeld beizutragen und eine funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Hauptquartier und regionalen Teams zu ermöglichen. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird gerne lernen, starke analytische Fähigkeiten besitzen und verschiedene operative und strategische Initiativen kompetent unterstützen. PLAYING YOUR PLANUNG UND VORAUSSETZUNG Sie unterstützen die Vorbereitung und Konsolidierung monatlicher Prognosezyklen, Budget- und Strategiepläne Sie werden Datenvalidierungs- und Konsistenzprüfungen durchführen, um fehlende Informationen oder Inkonsistenzen vor der Überprüfung zu identifizieren. Sie werden Planungsvorlagen, Tracker und unterstützende Dokumentation vorbereiten, um Prognose- und Geschäftsplanungsaktivitäten zu erleichtern. Sie erstellen wiederkehrende Analysen, um die Leistungsüberwachung zu unterstützen und die analytische Grundlage für Geschäftsbewertungen und Leistungsdiskussionen zu schaffen Sie führen Varianzanalysen auf der ersten Ebene durch, um signifikante Geschäftstrends, Anomalien und potenzielle Leistungstreiber zu identifizieren und wichtige Beobachtungen für eine weitere Überprüfung hervorzuheben Sie erstellen Diagramme, Tabellen und Datenvisualisierungen für Führungspräsentationen und Leistungsbewertungen DATA & REPORTING Sie unterstützen die Pflege und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Reporting Tools und Dashboards Sie werden am Testen und Validieren neuer Berichte und Dashboards teilnehmen, die in Looker entwickelt wurden Sie werden die Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten zur Automatisierung manueller Berichtsaktivitäten und zur Verbesserung der Berichtseffizienz unterstützen, WAS WIRD SIE ERFOLGEN? Erfolg in dieser Rolle erfordert: Ein Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder ähnliches Ein starkes Interesse an kommerzieller Leistung, Geschäftsplanung und Analyse Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, große Datensätze zu analysieren, Trends zu identifizieren und umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu generieren Erweiterte Kenntnisse in der Microsoft Office Suite, Kenntnisse der BI-Tools (Looker, Power BI, Tableau) sind ein Plus Proaktive, enthusiastische, neugierige und agile Persönlichkeit Ein kooperativer Geist, ausgezeichnete zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mit mehreren Stakeholdern zu arbeiten Fluency in Englisch und Französisch, andere Sprachen sind ein Plus Vacheron Constantin feiert 270 Jahre als der weltweit älteste Uhrmacher in kontinuierlicher Produktion seit 1755. Mit Hauptsitz in Genf, Schweiz, betreiben wir ein globales Einzelhandelsnetzwerk mit fast 200 Verkaufsstellen in 36 Ländern. Jedes Mitglied unserer außergewöhnlichen globalen Gemeinschaft von Uhrmachern, Handwerkern und engagierten Fachleuten teilt eine gemeinsame Hingabe an unser außergewöhnliches Erbe und die Leidenschaft, eine noch bessere Zukunft zu gestalten. Wenn dies Ihre Phantasie befeuert, begrüßen wir Ihre Bewerbung. Talent & Development Partner Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Vacheron Constantin EVENT INTERN Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Vacheron Constantin Supply Chain & Operations Data Intern Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Vacheron Constantin
descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence : JR130691 BUSINESS PERFORMANCE INTERN Stage – 6 mois, à compter du 17 août ou du 1er septembre 2026 Avec accord de stage (convention de stage) Plan-les-Ouates POUR CEUX QUI VIENT EXCELLENCE Rejoignez l'une des Maisons les plus respectées de l'horlogerie où l'excellence est à la fois une quête donnée et une quête sans fin. Jouez votre rôle dans la conduite de notre réussite collective. Votre rôle Nous recherchons un stagiaire hautement motivé, axé sur les détails et analytique pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique. Ce rôle offre une occasion unique de contribuer à la planification des activités, à la prévision, à l'établissement de rapports sur le rendement et à l'analyse des données dans un environnement de luxe international, offrant une visibilité et une collaboration interfonctionnelle entre l'AC et les équipes régionales. La candidate reçue sera impatiente d'apprendre, de posséder de solides compétences analytiques et d'appuyer diverses initiatives opérationnelles et stratégiques. LA PLANIFICATION ET LA PRÉVISION DE VOTRE PARTIE Vous soutiendrez la préparation et la consolidation des cycles prévisionnels mensuels, du budget et des plans stratégiques Vous effectuerez des vérifications de validation et de cohérence des données, afin d'identifier les informations manquantes, ou les incohérences avant l'examen Vous préparerez des modèles de planification, des suivis et de la documentation à l'appui afin de faciliter les activités de prévision et de planification des activités. Vous préparerez des analyses récurrentes pour appuyer la surveillance du rendement et fournirez la base analytique pour les examens d'entreprise et les discussions sur le rendement Vous effectuerez des analyses de variance de premier niveau afin de cerner les tendances, les anomalies et les facteurs de rendement potentiels importants, en mettant en évidence les observations clés à examiner plus avant. Vous préparerez des graphiques, des tableaux et des visualisations de données pour les présentations de leadership et les examens du rendement. Vous soutiendrez la maintenance et l'amélioration continue des outils de rapport et des tableaux de bord Vous participerez à l'essai et à la validation de nouveaux rapports et tableaux de bord développés dans Looker Vous soutiendrez l'identification des occasions d'automatiser les activités de rapport manuel et d'améliorer l'efficacité de rapport. Le succès de ce rôle exigera : un baccalauréat ou un master en administration des affaires, finances, économie, ingénierie ou autre.Un fort intérêt pour la performance commerciale, la planification des affaires et l'analyse Une capacité éprouvée d'analyser de grands ensembles de données, d'identifier les tendances et de générer des idées exploitables Une compétence avancée en Microsoft Office Suite, la connaissance des outils BI (Looker, Power BI, Tableau) est une personnalité plus proactive, enthousiaste, curieuse et agile Un esprit de collaboration, d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et la capacité de travailler avec de multiples intervenants. Basé à Genève, en Suisse, nous exploitons un réseau mondial de détail de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté mondiale exceptionnelle d'horlogers, d'artisans et de professionnels dévoués partagent une dévotion commune à notre patrimoine exceptionnel et une passion pour faire briller un avenir encore plus brillant. Si cela fait tourner votre imagination, nous accueillons votre application. jobs.description: Reference code: JR130693 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. HAVE YOU EVER WONDERED WHAT IS LIKE TO BE PART OF THE CARTIER FAMILY? A UNIQUE RETAIL EXPERIENCE IS WAITING FOR YOU IN OUR OFFICE! WE WELCOME Passionate and enthusiastic students curious about seeing & participating in the day-to-day office projects of high-end luxury brands in the jewelry, timepiece & accessories industries. YOU WILL Join our EUROPE team and play a key role in the performance of our prestige network. As an intern, you will work closely with the 7 European markets (France, United Kingdom, Benelux & Nordics, Northern Europe, Switzerland, South-East Europe, Iberia). YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES: Assortment Optimization: Contribute to the performance of the prestige network by ensuring the quality and quantity of our high-end assortments. Stock performance: Daily monitoring of the business KPIs as well as punctual business reviews Flow Management: Monitor and track pieces within the prestige network, ensuring efficient allocation and rebalancing between boutiques and smooth collaboration with the Operations team Cross-functional Projects: Participate in high-end transversal projects within our HE team, contributing to its smooth operation. YOU ARE Currently enrolled in an accredited Business school and/or a bachelor’s or master’s degree in supply chain Able to provide an internship agreement (compulsory) for a minimum of 6 months Fluent in English, French is a bonus and knowledge of another language is an asset. A team player who can get things done through working collaboratively with cross- functional departments Keen on analysis, dashboard optimization and general affinity with systems Flexible, proactive and eager to assist with various tasks all day long Service oriented and you have a sense of interpersonal skills Able to listen and adapt to the interlocutor, stress management Excited to work in an international environment WE OFFER All our interns have a key role in our day-to-day business success. Moreover, the close collaboration with an engaged and dedicated team is there to support you to succeed in this challenging and exciting role. During your time with us, you will get familiar with our know-how and gain practical insights into different business areas. Best of all, you will grow in a stimulating environment with excellent working conditions and attractive benefits! APPLY NOW! We look forward to hearing from you and welcoming you to the Cartier family. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR130693 La storia di Cartier è fondata su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbiamo abbracciato uno spirito coraggioso e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team di tutti i Métiers dalle nostre boutique ai nostri laboratori e uffici aziendali. I nostri 10.000+ colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e dall’impegno per l’eccellenza, cercando di arricchire continuamente il patrimonio della Maison spingendo i confini della creatività e dell’innovazione. Hai mai pensato a cosa fare parte della famiglia CARTIER? Un'ESPERIENZA DI RETAIL UNICA vi sta aspettando nel nostro UFFICIO! WE WELCOME Studenti appassionati e appassionati curiosi di vedere e partecipare ai progetti di uffici di ogni giorno di marchi di lusso di fascia alta nelle industrie di gioielli, orologi e accessori. Unisciti al nostro team di EUROPA e gioca un ruolo chiave nella performance della nostra rete di prestigio. Come stagista, lavorerai a stretto contatto con i 7 mercati europei (Francia, Regno Unito, Benelux & Nordics, Europa del Nord, Svizzera, Europa del Sud-Est, Iberia). I TUO RESPONSABILITÀ: Ottimizzazione degli Assortimenti: Contribuisci alle prestazioni della rete di prestigio garantendo la qualità e la quantità dei nostri assortiti di fascia alta. Performance: Monitoraggio giornaliero dei KPI aziendali e recensioni puntuali di business Flow Management: Monitorare e tracciare pezzi all'interno della rete di prestigio, garantendo un'efficiente allocazione e riequilibrio tra boutique e una collaborazione fluida con il team Operazioni Progetti cross-funzionali: Partecipa a progetti trasversali di fascia alta all'interno del nostro team HE, contribuendo al suo funzionamento regolare. Sei attualmente iscritto in una scuola di Business accreditata e / o un diploma di laurea o master in supply chain Able per fornire un accordo di stage (obbligatorio) per un minimo di 6 mesi Fluente in inglese, il francese è un bonus e la conoscenza di un'altra lingua è un bene. Un giocatore di squadra che può ottenere le cose fatte lavorando in collaborazione con i dipartimenti interfunzionali Keen sull'analisi, l'ottimizzazione del cruscotto e l'affinità generale con i sistemi Flessibile, proattivo e desideroso di assistere con vari compiti tutto il giorno orientati al servizio e hai un senso delle competenze interpersonali In grado di ascoltare e adattarsi all'interlocutore, gestione dello stress Eccitato per lavorare in un ambiente internazionale Tutti i nostri tirocinanti hanno un ruolo chiave nel nostro successo di affari di giorno in giorno. Inoltre, la stretta collaborazione con un team impegnato e dedicato è lì per aiutarvi a avere successo in questo ruolo impegnativo ed emozionante. Durante il vostro tempo con noi, avrete familiarità con il nostro know-how e ottenere informazioni pratiche in diverse aree di business. Meglio di tutti, crescerai in un ambiente stimolante con eccellenti condizioni di lavoro e benefici attraenti! Adesso! Non vediamo l'ora di sentire da voi e di darvi il benvenuto alla famiglia Cartier. Bezugscode: JR130693 Die Geschichte von Cartier basiert auf Neugier und Leidenschaft. Seit mehr als 170 Jahren haben wir einen mutigen Pioniergeist, der unsere Teams in allen Métiers von unseren Boutiquen bis zu unseren Werkstätten und Firmenbüros inspiriert. Unsere mehr als 10.000 Kollegen aus mehr als 105 Nationalitäten sind durch einen gemeinsamen unabhängigen Geist und Engagement für Exzellenz vereint und streben danach, das Erbe unseres Hauses kontinuierlich zu bereichern, indem wir die Grenzen von Kreativität und Innovation überschreiten. Haben Sie sich jemals darüber gewundert, was Teil der Cartier Family sein könnte? EIN EINZIGES RETAIL ERFAHREN WARTET IN UNSEREM OFFICE AUF SIE! WIR WILLKOMMEN Leidenschaftliche und begeisterte Studenten, die neugierig sind, die täglichen Büroprojekte von Luxusmarken der Schmuck-, Zeitmesser- und Accessoireindustrie zu sehen und daran teilzunehmen. SIE WERDEN unserem EUROPA-Team beitreten und eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Leistung unseres Prestigenetzwerks spielen. Als Praktikant arbeiten Sie eng mit den 7 europäischen Märkten (Frankreich, Großbritannien, Benelux & Nordics, Nordeuropa, Schweiz, Südosteuropa, Iberia) zusammen. IHRE VERANTWORTUNGEN: Sortimentsoptimierung: Tragen Sie zur Leistung des Prestigenetzwerks bei, indem Sie die Qualität und Quantität unserer High-End-Sortiments sicherstellen. Lagerperformance: Tägliche Überwachung der Business-KPIs sowie pünktliche Business-Reviews Flow Management: Überwachen und verfolgen Sie Teile innerhalb des Prestige-Netzwerks, um eine effiziente Allokation und Neuausrichtung zwischen Boutiquen und eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit mit dem Operations-Team sicherzustellen Cross-funktionale Projekte: Nehmen Sie an hochwertigen transversalen Projekten innerhalb unseres HE-Teams teil und tragen Sie zu seinem reibungslosen Betrieb bei. SIE SIND derzeit an einer akkreditierten Business School und / oder einem Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in der Lieferkette eingeschrieben In der Lage, ein Praktikumsabkommen (obligatorisch) für mindestens 6 Monate zu bieten Fließend in Englisch, Französisch ist ein Bonus und Kenntnisse einer anderen Sprache sind ein Gewinn. Ein Teamplayer, der Dinge durch die Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Abteilungen erledigen kann, die sich auf Analyse, Dashboard-Optimierung und allgemeine Affinität zu Systemen konzentrieren Flexibel, proaktiv und eifrig, bei verschiedenen

jobs.description: Reference code: JR130767 Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura. Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations. Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation. Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As a Store Planning and Construction Project Manager, you will spearhead the full lifecycle of Piaget's retail development projects across the Europe Region, from design to post-opening. This pivotal role, blending Headquarters and regional responsibilities, ensures both Brand desirability through design excellence and Brand productivity via operational efficiency, quality, cost control, and sustainability. You will be instrumental in delivering the region's retail development and renovation program, upholding brand desirability, execution quality, project planning, budget, and sustainability commitments. Regular travel across France, Switzerland, Italy, and Nordics is essential for site assessments and project oversight. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Design: Coordinate design development from concept to construction documentation, ensuring consistency with Piaget's architectural standards and Brand identity. Manage external design specialists (architects, 3D artists, consultants). Collaborate with HQ Retail, VM, and Commercial teams to optimize retail experience and operational efficiency. Budgeting, Planning & Construction: Lead projects from investment validation through construction and close-out, developing and controlling budgets, CAPEX, and planning. Drive tendering, technical evaluations, commercial negotiations, and contract awards. Manage procurement, Purchase Orders, Change Orders, and financial reporting. Coordinate permitting, landlord approvals, and local authority relations. Act as a key stakeholder with Group Procurement, Real Estate, Legal, and external partners throughout the project. Manage all construction phases, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to Piaget's quality and sustainability standards. Risk Management: Identify project risks and implement mitigation and recovery plans. Maintenance: Coordinate regional maintenance and post-opening programs, including snagging, retrofit projects, and minor works. Maintain regular communication with Commercial teams and Boutique Directors across Europe. Ensure compliance with Piaget Brand standards, quality, and sustainability objectives. Transversal Management: Act as the primary HQ interface for the Europe Region, coordinating Regional Markets for boutique construction and maintenance. Collaborate closely with internal teams (Retail, Procurement, Real Estate, Legal, Finance, Security, VM, Content) and develop strong relationships with external partners (landlords, consultants, contractors). HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Experience: Minimum 10 years in Architecture, Interior Architecture, or Construction Project Management, with at least 7 years specifically in luxury Store Planning and Construction. Proven track record delivering international retail projects within the luxury industry or premium brands. Solid understanding of luxury design, construction processes, and operational excellence. Extensive experience managing Executive Architects, Quantity Surveyors, General Contractors, and specialist consultants. Strong knowledge of procurement, tender management, commercial negotiations, and cost control. Technical Competencies: Exceptional analytical, planning, and project management skills. Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management abilities. Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, and advanced Microsoft Office Suite knowledge. Professional fluency in English and French is essential; additional languages are a significant asset. Strong commercial awareness, proven negotiation skills, and construction cost expertise. Soft Skills: Creative, solution-oriented, and passionate about luxury retail environments, architecture, and design trends. Excellent collaboration and communication skills, effective in multicultural teams. Agile, adaptable, and adept at managing changing priorities and complex stakeholder landscapes. Strong decision-maker with a high sense of ownership, accountability, and a results-oriented, continuous improvement mindset. Highly organized, proactive, and capable of simultaneously managing multiple strategic projects. STILL WONDERING WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY? A Welcoming Team: Join our friendly, open-minded, and talented team, where your skills will be valued and your contributions will make a real difference. Dynamic and Engaging Work: Experience daily activities that are interesting, challenging, and diverse, keeping you engaged and motivated. Investment in Your Growth: We are passionate about developing our people, and you will have access to various training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. The Piaget culture of encouraging Extra-Care, fostering Mastery and bringing out the Extraordinary in our people, means that we will always go further, doing “what has never been done before”. Together. If you want to become a part of it do not hesitate to apply! descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR130767 Circondato dalla sua famiglia e guidato dalla sua forte mentalità imprenditoriale, Georges-Edouard Piaget decise, nel 1874, di creare un'officina orologiera a La Côte-aux-Fées, un piccolo villaggio al centro delle montagne svizzere della Giura. Da quel giorno, Piaget ha spinto i limiti a “fare ciò che non è mai stato fatto prima” e artigianale orologi sofisticati e fiammeggianti e creazioni di gioielli. All’interno delle mura dei nostri Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, i nostri maestri artigiani continuano a sfruttare rare abilità che sono state conservate e perfezionate di generazione in generazione. Oggi, l’eccezionale maestria di Piaget è celebrata in tutto il mondo, sostenuta da una forte presenza globale e da una rete dedicata di supporto clienti e colleghi retail che portano lo spirito della nostra Maison alla vita ogni giorno. Come fai a fare un'infezione? In qualità di responsabile del progetto Store Planning and Construction, dirigerai il ciclo di vita completo dei progetti di sviluppo retail di Piaget in tutta Europa, dalla progettazione alla post-apertura. Questo ruolo fondamentale, fondendo le competenze del quartier generale e regionale, assicura sia la disabilità del brand attraverso l'eccellenza del design e la produttività del marchio attraverso l'efficienza operativa, la qualità, il controllo dei costi e la sostenibilità. Sarete strumentali nel fornire il programma di sviluppo e ristrutturazione retail della regione, sostenere la disabilità del marchio, la qualità dell'esecuzione, la pianificazione del progetto, il bilancio e gli impegni di sostenibilità. I viaggi regolari in Francia, Svizzera, Italia e Nordics sono essenziali per la valutazione del sito e la supervisione del progetto. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Design: Coordinate lo sviluppo del design dal concept alla documentazione costruttiva, assicurando coerenza con gli standard architettonici di Piaget e l'identità di Brand. Gestire gli specialisti del design esterno (architetti, artisti 3D, consulenti). Collabora con i team HQ Retail, VM e Commercial per ottimizzare l'esperienza di vendita al dettaglio e l'efficienza operativa. Bilancio, Pianificazione & Costruzione: Progetti di piombo dalla convalida degli investimenti attraverso la costruzione e lo close-out, lo sviluppo e il controllo dei bilanci, CAPEX e la pianificazione. Guidare l'appalto, le valutazioni tecniche, i negoziati commerciali e i premi contrattuali. Gestisci gli acquisti, gli ordini di acquisto, gli ordini di cambiamento e la rendicontazione finanziaria. Coordinate permettendo, approvazioni del proprietario, e le relazioni dell'autorità locale. Agire come stakeholder chiave con i partner di Group Procurement, Real Estate, Legale ed Estero in tutto il progetto. Gestisci tutte le fasi di costruzione, assicurando che i progetti vengano consegnati in tempo, all'interno del budget e agli standard di qualità e sostenibilità di Piaget. Gestione del rischio: Identificare i rischi del progetto e implementare piani di mitigazione e recupero. Manutenzione: Coordinare i programmi di manutenzione regionale e post-apertura, inclusi i progetti di snagging, retrofit e le opere minori. Mantenere la comunicazione regolare con i team commerciali e i direttori di boutique in tutta Europa. Garantire il rispetto degli standard, della qualità e degli obiettivi di sostenibilità del marchio Piaget. Transversal Management: Agite come interfaccia principale HQ per la Regione Europa, coordinando i mercati regionali per la costruzione e la manutenzione di boutique. Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team interni (Retail, Procurement, Real Estate, Legale, Finanza, Sicurezza, VM, Contenuti) e sviluppare relazioni forti con i partner esterni (ufficiali, consulenti, appaltatori). Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Esperienza: minimo 10 anni in Architettura, Architettura degli Interni, o Costruzione Project Management, con almeno 7 anni in particolare nella progettazione e costruzione del negozio di lusso. Provato track record che offre progetti di vendita al dettaglio internazionali all'interno del settore di lusso o marchi premium. Solida comprensione del design di lusso, dei processi di costruzione e dell'eccellenza operativa. Ampia esperienza nella gestione di architetti esecutivi, sondaggi quantità, contraenti generali e consulenti specializzati. Forte conoscenza degli appalti, della gestione delle offerte, dei negoziati commerciali e del controllo dei costi. Competenze tecniche: competenze di analisi, pianificazione e gestione del progetto eccezionali. Straordinarie capacità di comunicazione, presentazione e gestione degli stakeholder. Proficienza in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite e conoscenze avanzate di Microsoft Office Suite. La fluenza professionale in inglese e francese è essenziale; le lingue aggiuntive sono un bene significativo. Forte consapevolezza commerciale, comprovate capacità di negoziazione e competenze sui costi di costruzione. Soft Skills: creativo, orientato alla soluzione e appassionato di ambienti di lusso, architettura e tendenze di design. Ottima capacità di collaborazione e comunicazione, efficace in team multiculturali. Agile, adattabile, e adatto a gestire le mutevoli priorità e i paesaggi complessi delle parti interessate. Un decisore forte con un elevato senso di proprietà, responsabilità e una mentalità di miglioramento continuo orientata ai risultati. Altamente organizzato, proattivo e capace di gestire simultaneamente più progetti strategici. Stavo pensando perche' dovresti chiederlo? A Welcoming Team: Unisciti alla nostra squadra amichevole, aperta e di talento, dove le tue abilità saranno valutate e i tuoi contributi faranno una vera differenza. Lavoro dinamico e coinvolgente: sperimentare attività quotidiane che sono interessanti, stimolanti e diversificate, mantenendovi impegnati e motivati. Investimenti nella vostra crescita: Siamo appassionati di sviluppare la nostra gente, e avrete accesso a varie opportunità di formazione e sviluppo per migliorare le vostre abilità e migliorare la vostra carriera. La cultura Piaget di incoraggiare Extra-Care, promuovere la Mastery e far emergere lo Straordinario nel nostro popolo, significa che andremo sempre oltre, facendo “cosa non è mai stato fatto prima”. Insieme. Se si desidera diventare una parte di esso non esitate ad applicare! descriptionByLocale.de: Bezugscode: JR130767 Umgeben von seiner Familie und geleitet von seiner starken unternehmerischen Denkweise beschloss Georges-Edouard Piaget 1874, eine Uhrmacherwerkstatt in La Côte-aux-Fées zu gründen, einem kleinen Dorf inmitten der Schweizer Berge des Jura. Seit diesem Tag hat Piaget die Grenzen für "Tun, was noch nie zuvor getan wurde" erweitert und fertigt anspruchsvolle und extravagante Uhren und Schmuckkreationen. In den Mauern unserer Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire nutzen unsere Handwerksmeister weiterhin seltene Fähigkeiten, die von Generation zu Generation erhalten und perfektioniert wurden. Heute wird die außergewöhnliche Handwerkskunst von Piaget weltweit gefeiert, unterstützt durch eine starke globale Präsenz und ein engagiertes Netzwerk von Kunden- und Einzelhandelskollegen, die den Geist unseres Hauses jeden Tag zum Leben erwecken. WIE WERDEN SIE EINEN AUSWIRKEN SIND? Als Projektmanager für Store Planning und Construction führen Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Einzelhandelsentwicklungsprojekte von Piaget in der gesamten Region Europa an, vom Design bis zur Eröffnung. Diese zentrale Rolle, die den Hauptsitz und die regionalen Verantwortlichkeiten verbindet, gewährleistet sowohl die Markenerwünschtheit durch Design-Exzellenz als auch die Markenproduktivität durch betriebliche Effizienz, Qualität, Kostenkontrolle und Nachhaltigkeit. Sie sind maßgeblich an der Umsetzung des Einzelhandelsentwicklungs- und -renovierungsprogramms der Region beteiligt und halten die Markenerwünschtheit, die Ausführungsqualität, die Projektplanung, das Budget und die Nachhaltigkeitsverpflichtungen ein. Regelmäßige Reisen durch Frankreich, die Schweiz, Italien und die nordischen Länder sind für Standortbewertungen und die Projektaufsicht unerlässlich. SCHLÜSSELVERANTWORTUNGEN: Koordinieren Sie die Designentwicklung vom Konzept bis zur Baudokumentation und gewährleisten Sie die Konsistenz mit den architektonischen Standards und der Markenidentität von Piaget. Verwalten Sie externe Design-Spezialisten (Architekten, 3D-Künstler, Berater). Arbeiten Sie mit den Teams von HQ Retail, VM und Commercial zusammen, um die Einzelhandelserfahrung und die betriebliche Effizienz zu optimieren. Budgetierung, Planung und Bau: Führen Sie Projekte von der Investitionsvalidierung über Bau und Close-Out, Entwicklung und Steuerung von Budgets, CAPEX und Planung. Fahre Ausschreibungen, technische Bewertungen, kommerzielle Verhandlungen und Auftragsvergaben. Verwalten Sie Beschaffung, Kaufaufträge, Änderungsaufträge und Finanzberichterstattung. Koordinieren Sie Genehmigungen, Vermietergenehmigungen und lokale Behördenbeziehungen. Handeln Sie als wichtiger Stakeholder mit Group Procurement, Real Estate, Legal und externen Partnern während des gesamten Projekts. Verwalten Sie alle Bauphasen und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Projekte pünktlich, im Rahmen des Budgets und nach den Qualitäts- und Nachhaltigkeitsstandards von Piaget geliefert werden. Risikomanagement: Identifizieren Sie Projektrisiken und implementieren Sie Minderungs- und Wiederherstellungspläne. Wartung: Koordinieren Sie regionale Wartungs- und Nacheröffnungsprogramme, einschließlich Snagging, Nachrüstprojekte und kleinere Arbeiten. Pflegen Sie regelmäßige Kommunikation mit kommerziellen Teams und Boutique-Direktoren in ganz Europa. Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Standards, Qualität und Nachhaltigkeitsziele der Marke Piaget. Transversales Management: Funktioniert als primäre HQ-Schnittstelle für die Region Europa und koordiniert regionale Märkte für den Bau und die Wartung von Boutiquen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams (Einzelhandel, Beschaffung, Immobilien, Recht, Finanzen, Sicherheit, VM, Inhalte) und Aufbau starker Beziehungen zu externen Partnern (Vermieter, Berater, Auftragnehmer). WIE WIRST IHR ERFAHREN MIT UNS? Erfahrung: Mindestens 10 Jahre in Architektur, Innenarchitektur oder Bauprojektmanagement, mit mindestens 7 Jahren speziell in Luxusgeschäft Planung und Bau. Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung internationaler Einzelhandelsprojekte innerhalb der Luxusbranche oder Premiummarken. Solides Verständnis von Luxusdesign, Bauprozessen und operativer Exzellenz. Umfangreiche Erfahrung im Management von Executive Architects, Quantity Surveyors, Generalunternehmern und Fachberatern. Starke Kenntnisse in Beschaffung, Ausschreibungsmanagement, Handelsverhandlungen und Kostenkontrolle. Technische Kompetenzen: Außergewöhnliche analytische, Planungs- und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten. Herausragende Kommunikation, Präsentation und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten. Kenntnisse in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite und erweiterten Kenntnissen der Microsoft Office Suite. Professionelle Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch und Französisch sind unerlässlich; zusätzliche Sprachen sind ein wichtiger Vorteil. Starkes kommerzielles Bewusstsein, nachgewiesenes Verhandlungsgeschick und Baukosten-Know-how. Soft Skills: Kreativ, lösungsorientiert und leidenschaftlich für Luxus-Einzelhandelsumgebungen, Architektur und Designtrends. Hervorragende Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, effektiv in multikulturellen Teams. Agile, anpassungsfähig und geschickt im Management sich verändernder Prioritäten und komplexer Stakeholder-Landschaften. Starker Entscheidungsträger mit hohem Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Verantwortlichkeit und einer ergebnisorientierten, kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmentalität. Hoch organisiert, proaktiv und in der Lage, gleichzeitig mehrere strategische Projekte zu verwalten. WUNDERUNG WARUM SIE ANWENDEN SOLLTEN? Ein Willkommensteam: Treten Sie unserem freundlichen, aufgeschlossenen und talentierten Team bei, in dem Ihre Fähigkeiten geschätzt werden und Ihre Beiträge einen echten Unterschied machen. Dynamische und engagierte Arbeit: Erleben Sie tägliche Aktivitäten, die interessant, herausfordernd und vielfältig sind und Sie engagiert und motiviert halten. Investition in Ihr Wachstum: Wir sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, unsere Mitarbeiter zu entwickeln, und Sie haben Zugang zu verschiedenen Schulungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Fähigkeiten zu verbessern und Ihre Karriere voranzutreiben. Die Piaget-Kultur der Förderung von Extra-Care, der Förderung der Meisterschaft und der Hervorbringung des Außerordentlichen in unserem Volk bedeutet, dass wir immer weiter gehen und tun werden, "was noch nie zuvor getan wurde". Gemeinsam. Wenn Sie ein Teil davon werden wollen, zögern Sie nicht, sich zu bewerben!
